author: Akingbade Tope Olatidoye
title: Humor Is Not A Joke: A Situation Analysis of Artistic Freedoms in Nigeria – A Cartoon Draws Blood!
content:
In March 2025, I posted a single-panel cartoon on a civic WhatsApp group that caricatured the Supreme Court: a judge in full wig, a smiling, hulking anarchical figure beside a broken gavel. It was meant as a provocation — a civic jab that asked whether a court’s public trust can survive repeated, controversial decisions.  In this case, I was questioning the role Nigeria’s apex court had played in preparing the illegal grounds for the unconstitutional suspension of the elected governor of Rivers State in the oil-rich Niger Delta region which had been the scene of many conflicts around resource control and rival politics. The reaction was immediate. Group messages ranged from sarcasm to outright threats. One respondent typed,  “Go commit a crime and let your case get to the Supreme Court — I want to check something.” 

The joke had not landed as a joke; it was a test. 




That exchange is not an isolated outrage; it’s a tiny weather vane. The barrage of abuse, the quick escalation from critique to menace, and the invocation of criminality as a retort reveal how fragile public satire has become. 




In Nigeria, mocking power — even in a small civic space — can trigger legal alarms, social shaming, and organized campaigns of trolling that function as a form of extra-judicial censorship. The cartoon and the reaction around it are a microcosm: creative dissent colliding with legal instruments, moral outrage, and digital mobs down the timeline of Nigeria’s nationhood.




From satire to statute: the long shadow of the law




Suppression of artistic expression first appeared against Nigerian theatre’s early pillars. Hubert Ogunde, a dramatist who frequently used ethnic Yoruba folklore and oral traditions in his plays to critique colonial rule and later government corruption, was one of the earliest targets of creative suppression His play 

Yoruba Ronu

 (

Yorubas, Think!

), staged in 1964, was such a searing political statement that it was banned in the Western Region of Nigeria in the post-colonial era. The ban was lifted only in 1966 after a change of government. Ogunde’s other works — 

Strike and Hunger, Otito Koro

 (

Truth is Bitter

) — similarly tackled political themes. 




Also, when Wole Soyinka – another leading dramatist who was imprisoned for his civic activism to prevent the escalation of the Nigerian Civil War in 1967 – published his experience in a memoir, 

The Man Died

 (1972), one of the figures named in the book 

brought a libel suit

 against him that was as much about silencing political memory as protecting reputations. Military regimes (which had governed the country for 29 years since its independence in 1960) largely suppressed and constrained artistic expression. One of the earliest and most vivid examples of suppression comes from the case of 

Fela Anikulapo Kuti

, the pioneer of Afrobeat, a musical genre he used for strong social activism and commentary. In 1970, Fela Kuti founded the 

Kalakuta Republic

, declaring it a space independent of Nigeria’s military regime. His music, increasingly political, exposed government brutality, corruption, and hypocrisy. The raid of Kalakuta in 1977 is infamous: approximately 1,000 soldiers stormed his compound, burned down Kalakuta, destroyed his recording studio, beat Fela up, and fatally injured his mother, Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti after throwing her from a second-floor window. Fela’s instruments, master tapes, and the infrastructure of his commune were destroyed. Fela channelled this atrocity into music, penning 

Coffin for Head of State

 and 

Unknown Soldier

. His 1977 album 

Zombie

, in particular, used satire and metaphor to indict the military.




Censorship tightened under successive military regimes, targeting platforms that enabled artistic expression. In 1978, a special News Agency of Nigeria was created to 

vet content

 to be broadcast on radio and television and, after the 1983 coup, the army itself took charge of monitoring information (Generals don’t read novels”, one writer 

observed

). Set up in 1993, the National Film & Video Censors Board began banning movies 

deemed indecent or subversive

. 




Fast-forward to the 2020s and the pattern of suppression of artistic expression in Nigeria continues, albeit with a different dynamic because of the expansion of internet-based technologies and increasing globalization. Moreover, the legal instruments for constraining artistic expression — libel suits, criminal defamation, sharia-based blasphemy charges, broadcasting codes — have continued to raise the cost of creative social commentary and public opinion. Even copyright law has played a role. For example, Nigeria’s 

new Copyright Act

 does not fully restore “freedom of panorama”, the principle that allows citizens to photograph, share, or remix images of public artworks and buildings without fear of infringement claims. According to 

Free Knowledge Africa

, this gap means that murals, monuments, or architectural works visible in public can still be restricted from circulation, undermining both digital creativity and civic memory.  In effect, even where the streets become galleries of protest, the law lingers in ways that can chill their reproduction or global reach.










During the #EndSARS protests by Nigerian youths against police brutality (particularly the excesses, extortion and high-handedness of the Special Anti-Robbery Squad [SARS], a notorious unit of the Nigerian Police Force created supposedly to curb violent crimes like armed robbery) in  October 2020, art broke out of studios and spilled onto the streets. Protesters used murals, banners, graffiti, and punchy slogans as visual calls to action. 

Sòrò-Sókè

 (Yoruba for 

Speak Up

) became 

not only a rallying cry but also a slogan

 painted on walls and placards, later adapted to chants, songs, and even digital memes. Murals in Lagos and Abuja depicted clenched fists, bloodied flags, and the faces of victims of police brutality, transforming cityscapes into living canvases of grief and defiance. Protest lyrics too — whether improvised chants or remixed pop songs, including classic tunes from Fela Anikulapo Kuti — blurred the lines between performance and protest, echoing Nigeria’s longer tradition where music and visual art become civic weapons when institutions fail to protect.










Nationwide protests caused by widespread economic hardship, including the removal of fuel subsidies, staggering inflation, and the rising cost of living broke out in August 2024. Going by the hashtags #EndBadGovernance or #EndBadGovernanceInNigeria, the protests were driven in large part by artistic expressions using a variety of mediums such as music, poetry, and visual art. For example, there was a 

call for poems

 by a state chapter of the Association of Nigerian Authors for an anthology capturing “the emotions, experiences and thoughts of Nigerians on #EndBadGovernance”. Street anthems such as 

Nigeria Jaga Jaga

, a reference to a popular protest song by 

Eedris Abdulkareem

 critiquing the country’s mismanagement and corruption, appeared again to strengthen the voices of discontent (

Tell Your Papa

, Eedris Abdulkareem’s sequel release addressing the same issue, was 

banned

 by NBC, the broadcasting regulator, in April 2025). The mood of the #EndBadGovernance or #EndBadGovernanceInNigeria was also captured through a mix of visual expressions, from cartoons on the 

front pages of leading newspapers

 to street graffiti.







For the average Nigerian, artistic freedom is both celebrated and feared. On the one hand, there is pride in how murals, music, and poetry have amplified protest movements, from Fela’s Afrobeat to Eedris AbdulKareem’s serial protest hits to the chants of 

Sòrò-Sókè

 in 2020. Nigerians value art as a mirror of society and as a way of “speaking truth to power” when institutions fall short. But at the same time, many citizens are conscious of the risks that come with bold expression. In northern states, for example, comedians and musicians know that a skit or song judged “blasphemous” can attract heavy penalties — as in the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, who was sentenced to death by a Sharia court in Kano on accusations of sharing an alleged religiously offensive song on a WhatsApp group in 2020, a case that 

UN experts continue to condemn

. Even secular laws like the Cybercrimes Act (amended in 2024) are widely perceived as tools that allow the state to criminalize “offensive” posts, leading ordinary Nigerians to self-censor online. The result is a cautious appreciation of the power of art — citizens often celebrate defiant artists in private, while hesitating to defend them openly for fear of social or legal backlash.




Moral and cultural pressures also shape everyday attitudes towards creative expression. Many Nigerians are protective of art that respects faith and tradition, but conservative clerics or advocacy groups can quickly mobilize against works they deem indecent or offensive. The case of Kano TikTok star Murja Ibrahim Kunya, who was 

arrested

 in 2023 after clerics demanded her detention, illustrates how public opinion can be swayed against artists through moral campaigns. Even in the south, cultural groups like the Muslim Rights Concern often threaten lawsuits against musicians or filmmakers whose works “offend religious sensibilities”. For many Nigerians, this creates a climate of double consciousness: they enjoy satire, protest songs, or daring murals when these works affirm frustrations with the government, but they also instinctively police boundaries around religion, sexuality, or community image. This ambivalence means that artistic freedom in Nigeria is not just constrained by law or state power, but also by the unwritten rules of society itself.




To address these systemic attitudes, Unchained Vibes Africa, an art collective, launched the 

Free the Vibes

 project in December 2021. 

Free the Vibes

 is a monthly series of conversations and performances hosted at Freedom Park in Lagos that puts artistic freedom at the centre of civic debate. It mixes performances — from hip-hop acts to poetry and drumming — with robust conversations about censorship, hate speech laws, and government clampdowns. This initiative  is unique in that it isn’t just a showcase of talent; it is designed as a living forum where artists, activists, and audiences connect the dots between creativity and democracy. Its founder, Ayo Ganiu, frames the project as 

both advocacy and intervention

, stepping in when musicians, comedians, or filmmakers are harassed, and using the platform to remind Nigerians that the right to create freely is not a luxury but a constitutional guarantee.




Free the Vibes

 responds to a culture of repression that artists know all too well: the quick arrests of performers who critique politicians, the silencing of songs branded “defamatory”, and the weight of old military-era trauma that still lingers in Nigeria’s creative industries. Speakers at the opening of 

Free the Vibes

 pointed to how artists often self-censor out of fear of fines, bans, or backlash from religious and cultural authorities. Veteran performers like Ade Bantu and Hilda Dokubo used the stage to call on artists to reclaim their voice as educators and agitators, and not just as entertainers. By linking the art of performance with the politics of freedom, 

Free the Vibes

 has carved out a space that is both cultural and political, a reminder that creativity in Nigeria is never just about glamour, but about survival and solidarity in the face of censorship.




The post 

Humor Is Not A Joke: A Situation Analysis of Artistic Freedoms in Nigeria – A Cartoon Draws Blood!

 first appeared on 

The Elephant

author: Unknown
title: Botan: Disarmament is a precondition for peace, not peace itself - Part One
content:
Politician Lezgin Botan said that disarmament alone is not sufficient to resolve the Kurdish question, stressing that a lasting solution requires democratisation, legal reforms and guarantees for the political and cultural rights of Kurds.




The current stage of the Peace and Democratic Society Process has raised expectations among the Kurdish public regarding the direction and scope of the process and the steps to be taken next. Alongside discussions centred on security and disarmament, how to address the political, legal and social dimensions of the Kurdish question has also become a prominent issue.




Politician Lezgin Botan spoke to ANF about how the process is viewed by the Kurdish public, political and legal expectations, the relationship between disarmament and democratisation, and possible developments in the coming period.




Botan said that addressing the Kurdish question solely in terms of security and armed conflict was insufficient to explain all its dimensions, stressing the need to consider its political, social, legal and cultural aspects together.




Botan said: “Of course, ending armed conflict and removing weapons from the equation are important. However, it would be wrong to equate this with the Kurdish question itself. We must also distinguish between the concepts of ‘Terror-Free Turkey’ and the ‘Peace and Democratic Society Process’. The former can be understood primarily in terms of security and disarmament, while the perspective of a democratic society and peace requires addressing the political and social dynamics that gave rise to the question.




A lasting solution requires guarantees for the political, cultural and collective rights of Kurds, opening the way for democratic politics and implementing the necessary legal reforms. For this reason, disarmament and democratisation must not be separated from one another.”




‘The Kurdish question cannot be reduced to a security issue’




Botan said the security dimension of the process must not be separated from its democratic solution dimension, stressing that the silencing of weapons alone does not amount to lasting peace.




Botan said: “We need to distinguish between negative peace and positive peace. Negative peace means the end of conflict and armed violence. In other words, weapons fall silent, people stop dying and conflict comes to an end. This is important, but it is not sufficient on its own. Positive peace, however, means eliminating the causes that gave rise to the conflict.




If people in a society cannot freely express their identities, languages, cultures and political will, if mechanisms of democratic representation do not function and legal guarantees are absent, the mere silencing of weapons does not mean lasting peace. For this reason, disarmament must be seen not as peace itself, but as a precondition for peace.




The real question is what happens next. Once the weapons fall silent, will the political and democratic dimensions of the Kurdish question be addressed? Will the demands of Kurds be met? Will the space for democratic politics be expanded? Will legal guarantees be established? These are the decisive questions.”




Botan also drew attention to the report of the National Solidarity, Fraternity and Democracy Commission established in parliament, saying that the legal and democratic reforms discussed following the report were important for the future of the process.




Botan continued: “The commission's report must also be considered within this framework. The report released in February 2026 sparked new discussions on legal reforms and democratisation. The fundamental question is whether a lasting legal and democratic framework that goes beyond security policies can be established.




If the process moves forward solely through disarmament and security measures, the political and social dimensions of the Kurdish question will once again be postponed. Steps must therefore be taken to open the way for democratic politics. Issues such as freedom of expression and association, the right to engage in political activities, local governments and constitutional citizenship cannot be excluded from the process.” 




‘The Kurdish public expects concrete steps’




Lezgin Botan said expectations among the Kurdish public were not limited to ending the conflict, stressing that the process must be supported by legal and political measures.




Botan also said: “There is a very clear expectation among the Kurdish public today. People want not only the silencing of weapons but also concrete legal and political steps to follow. The status of the Kurdish language, education in the mother tongue, cultural and collective rights, strengthening local governments, removing obstacles to political representation, a democratic constitution, reconsidering the definition of citizenship, ending the appointment of trustees, and guaranteeing freedom of expression and association are among the main issues.




It would therefore be incomplete to limit these expectations solely to ending the conflict. People want a legal framework in which they can freely express their identities, languages and collective existence through democratic politics.”




‘The demand for constitutional status for Kurds cannot be ignored’




Botan addressed the debate over the constitutional status of Kurds and citizenship, drawing attention to the following issues: “One of the fundamental issues of the Kurdish question is the constitutional status of Kurds. The question of how citizenship is defined in Turkey and how the state relates to different identities must be discussed again. We are not simply talking about changing a term. The real issue is restructuring the relationship between the state and society. The political, cultural and collective rights of Kurds must be constitutionally guaranteed.




A democratic constitution should enable different identities within society to express themselves as equal citizens. The resolution of the Kurdish question cannot be considered separately from this. If constitutional guarantees are not established, the issues currently being discussed in the context of disarmament may re-emerge in different forms in the future.”




‘Self-determination does not simply mean establishing a state’




Botan said the debate over Kurds defining themselves as an “autochthonous people” should be addressed not only in its historical and social dimensions but also within the framework of international law. He drew attention to provisions concerning the right of peoples to self-determination: “The definition of Kurds as an autochthonous people reflects an understanding of their historical and social existence. In this debate, we must also consider the right of peoples to self-determination under international law. This right is enshrined in the common Article 1 of the United Nations International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights and the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights. The right to self-determination should not be understood solely as establishing a state or separating from an existing state. Internal self-determination is also important in this respect.




The ability of peoples to express their identities, cultures, languages and political will through democratic means within existing state borders is also part of this debate. The Kurdish question must be considered within this framework. Recognition of the collective identity and rights of Kurds is an important issue for the democratisation of Turkey.”




‘Mother-tongue education and the status of Kurds must be discussed’




Botan said language rights were among the fundamental issues of the Kurdish question: “The status of the Kurdish language and the issue of education in the mother tongue are not merely cultural matters. Language is one of the fundamental elements of a people's identity and collective memory. The demand for mother-tongue education should not be regarded simply as a technical adjustment within the education system. It is also a cultural and social right. Greater visibility for Kurdish in the public sphere, its use in education and people's ability to use their own language freely are all part of democratisation.




The state must recognise different languages and cultures as a natural richness of society rather than viewing them as a threat.”

title: Utamara Women's Foundation celebrates its 20th anniversary
content:
The Utamara Women's Foundation celebrated its 20th anniversary on 10 October at the Utamara Meeting Centre. The event brought together numerous women from different nationalities, as well as representatives of Germany's Social Democratic Party (SPD), the Greens and the Left Party, alongside equal opportunities officers from Neuwied and surrounding areas.







 







The programme began with opening speeches by the foundation's board members and staff, followed by discussions of Utamara's work, experiences and projects over the past two decades. A video documenting the foundation's history and activities was also screened.




Equal opportunities officers and the mayor who addressed the gathering highlighted Utamara's importance in the region. They stressed that the foundation had provided counselling and support to numerous women over the years and implemented various projects aimed at empowering women and promoting gender equality.




Utamara has served as a meeting place and centre of solidarity and support for women from diverse backgrounds for two decades, working to strengthen women's participation in social life and foster solidarity among them.




The celebration continued with a buffet featuring traditional dishes and live music. Participants shared their experiences and celebrated the foundation's 20th anniversary together.

title: Özsoy: The state still takes a tactical approach to the Kurdish question
content:
The future of the Peace and Democratic Society Process continues to be debated, with the issue occupying an important place not only in Turkey's domestic political landscape but also in regional developments and international diplomacy. Dr. Hişyar Özsoy spoke to ANF about the political and diplomatic dimensions of the process, assessing how the state's approach, regional dynamics and the positions of international actors could influence its next stages.




Özsoy said the government was deliberately proceeding as slowly as possible with the Peace and Democratic Society Process.




Özsoy said: “The government is moving this process forward as slowly as possible. It takes considerable pressure before it makes even a small move. Only then does it take a minor step, after which the process appears to reach another deadlock. The government is trying to move forward while keeping control over the pace and substance of the process firmly in its own hands. So far, the process has advanced largely thanks to the patient and persistent steps taken by the Kurdish side.”




Özsoy said the state would take regional and international developments into account when determining the pace of the process. He explained how these developments could influence its calculations: “There are elections ahead in Israel and the United States. They may want to see how the regional cards are reshuffled, whether the Netanyahu government will fall and whether Trump will become weaker. Iran's future and the direction of tensions between Israel, the United States and Iran are also part of these calculations. These developments will directly affect Iraq and Syria as well.”




Özsoy stressed that the Kurdish side continued to take unilateral steps to clear the way for the process. He said: “The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) continues to take unilateral steps to move the process forward. It is calling for the necessary conditions to be established so that Abdullah Öcalan, whom it has designated as its chief negotiator, can advance the process and fulfil his coordinating role. It continues to press these demands.”




‘Parliament must establish an observation and monitoring commission without delay’




Özsoy said Parliament had yet to fulfil its responsibilities, criticising the shortcomings of the framework law and the absence of monitoring mechanisms. Özsoy also said: “Parliament needs to establish mechanisms to monitor the Peace and Democratic Society Process, but it has not yet reached that point. A framework law with numerous shortcomings has been passed. Moreover, this law has placed the legislature under the tutelage of the National Security Council, effectively leaving its implementation to the council's discretion. Parliament must establish an official observation and monitoring commission without delay.”




‘The US is not withdrawing from the region, but repositioning itself’




Özsoy said the US withdrawal from Iraq did not mean it was leaving the region entirely. He commented on Washington's regional military presence: “The United States has withdrawn from Iraq and moved the centre of its coordination in the fight against ISIS to Jordan. However, this does not mean it is withdrawing from the region. The US is repositioning itself. It may also withdraw from some of its bases damaged during the war with Iran. Although it is reducing its ground forces, it has no intention of relinquishing its regional military dominance, which it maintains through intelligence, technological capabilities, and air and naval power.”




‘The US has persuaded both countries over Shengal and Bashiqa’




Özsoy said an agreement had been reached between Shengal and the Iraqi central government. He also assessed developments concerning the Bashiqa military base: “The Bashiqa-Zilkan base was established in 2015 to train local forces around Mosul under the pretext of fighting ISIS. In the following years, it became one of the main centres of Turkey's military presence in Iraq. Turkey's excessive deployment of troops there even became a major source of tension with the Iraqi government. Developments concerning the transfer of the base to Iraqi authorities emerged alongside discussions about the future of armed forces in Shengal and security arrangements in the region. Many groups within the Popular Mobilisation Forces (Hashd al-Shaabi) have also put forward Turkey's withdrawal from Iraq as a precondition for their integration into the regular army.




An agreement has been reached between Shengal and the central government. Therefore, Turkey has little reason left to insist on maintaining the Bashiqa base. It is clear that the Americans have also persuaded Turkey on this issue. However, we will have to see to what extent this agreement is implemented in practice and how it is put into effect.”




‘Every part of Syria is a minefield’




Özsoy said the crises in Syria remained unresolved and the country had become a minefield, drawing particular attention to forces seeking to provoke tensions in cities across Rojava.




He said: “None of the problems have been resolved. Everyone, including Damascus, has adopted temporary positions because much larger wars involving all the regional powers are taking place. Syria is currently not even in a position to sustain itself or pay salaries.”




Özsoy warned that developments in Syria carried the risk of ethnic tensions and said: “There are numerous forces in Hasakah (Hesekê) that periodically mobilise Arabs against Kurds. These should not be regarded as spontaneous incidents. Dozens of intelligence groups are operating in these areas. There is a risk that economic and social anger will be directed against Kurds and transformed into ethnic tensions.”




‘The steps taken have yet to reach a strategic level’




Özsoy stressed that the ongoing process in Turkey was also influencing developments in Syria and Iraq, but that the government's steps had not yet reached a strategic level.




Özsoy said: “The state has also taken some steps; it would be wrong to say it has done nothing. Ultimately, they named the process ‘Terror-Free Turkey’. There are many aspects of the law that I consider problematic. However, the fundamental question is whether the state can develop a more political and diplomatic approach to the substance of the Kurdish question without engaging in conflict or war with the Kurds, and particularly without pushing them into opposing camps within the regional balance of power. Looking at the evidence available so far, I see that this remains a tactical initiative for the state and government rather than something that has developed into a strategy.”




Özsoy underlined the need for a structural transformation in relations with the Kurds and said: “Could a strategic transformation take place over time? If the first stage is completed, the PKK disarms and the Kurdish question becomes easier to discuss, could the state establish a more constructive basis for its relations with Kurds in Turkey, Rojava, the South and even Rojhilat? This is what I mean by strategy and structural transformation.”




‘The seeds of dozens of wars are already being sown in the new Middle East’




Özsoy pointed to the risks facing the Middle East in the coming decades and said: “The seeds of dozens of wars that could take place over the next century are already being sown in the new Middle East. Regional disputes are laying the groundwork for much larger conflicts in the decades ahead. Could the state make peace with the Kurds and move towards an alliance with them in the face of the ethnic, sectarian and economic conflicts that may unfold in the Middle East over the coming decades, perhaps even the next hundred years? I believe this is the real strategic question. At this stage, I do not see such a willingness within the state.”




Hişyar Özsoy said that if the process progressed successfully, the Kurdish question could be brought to the negotiating table. Özsoy also said: “If the deadlock surrounding Mr. Öcalan's situation and how PKK members will be integrated into political life is resolved in exchange for the PKK's disarmament, the Kurdish question, which is fundamentally political, could be taken out of the context of violence and brought to the negotiating table. If the first stage is successfully completed, the shift towards a political process could also create the possibility of the state reassessing its relations with the Kurds at a more strategic level.”

author: Duda Sousa
title: Fim da escala 6×1 pode ir a votação no Senado, mas aliados de Flávio tentam barrar
content:
O Senado deve votar em primeiro turno, nesta semana, a Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) 221/2019, que prevê o fim da escala de trabalho 6×1 e a passagem gradual da jornada semanal de 44 para 40 horas, sem redução salarial. A possibilidade foi anunciada pelo presidente da Casa, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), após três sessões de discussão realizadas na última semana, entre terça-feira e quinta-feira, 8 de outubro. 

A tramitação foi marcada por críticas de aliados do senador e candidato a presidente da República Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) ao momento escolhido para a análise da proposta

, em meio ao segundo turno das 

eleições presidenciais.




Pelo rito regular, são necessárias cinco sessões de discussão antes da votação em primeiro turno e outras três antes do segundo. Na última terça-feira, 6 de outubro, Alcolumbre afirmou a jornalistas que pretende cumprir integralmente as etapas regimentais, sem acelerar a tramitação. Se as cinco sessões de discussão forem concluídas, a matéria poderá ser submetida ao plenário em primeiro turno. A PEC precisa de pelo menos 49 votos favoráveis, entre os 81 senadores, em cada turno de votação.




A líder do governo Lula no Senado, Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), articula a apresentação de um requerimento de calendário especial para acelerar a tramitação da proposta.

 A senadora informou que estava recolhendo assinaturas para apresentar o pedido, que permitiria reduzir as etapas regimentais e viabilizar a votação em dois turnos em um intervalo menor, ainda nesta semana. 




Em entrevista na quarta-feira, 7 de outubro, Alcolumbre afirmou que “se o requerimento aparecer, eu vou colocar para deliberação, e o Plenário é soberano, a vontade da maioria vai prevalecer”. Sem a aprovação de um calendário especial ou a dispensa dos intervalos regimentais, a votação em segundo turno dependerá do cumprimento das três sessões adicionais de discussão. 




A discussão ocorre após a aprovação da proposta pela Comissão de Constituição e Justiça (CCJ) do Senado, em setembro. O texto prevê uma redução gradual da jornada semanal, inicialmente para 42 horas e, posteriormente, para 40 horas, além de garantir dois dias de repouso remunerado, sendo um deles, preferencialmente, o domingo.




Na oposição, o líder Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, classificou a discussão como “oportunista” e acusou o presidente Lula (PT) de tentar recuperar apoio eleitoral com a pauta. A jornalistas, após reunião do bloco Vanguarda, formado por parlamentares conservadores, Marinho afirmou que o grupo quer o cumprimento do regimento antes de definir sua atuação na votação. Ele também criticou a falta de discussão sobre produtividade, qualificação profissional e diferenças entre as categorias de trabalhadores.




“Nós não somos contra nem a favor do fim da escala 6×1. Nós somos a favor de que haja uma jornada flexível”, afirmou Marinho. O senador defendeu que trabalhadores e empregadores tenham liberdade para negociar as condições de trabalho e argumentou que a imposição de um mesmo modelo para diferentes atividades pode prejudicar setores com regimes específicos, como plataformas de petróleo, aviação, segurança e saúde. Ao final da entrevista, contudo, ao ser questionado sobre a proposta em discussão, indicou que seria contrário ao texto nos moldes apresentados.




A posição defendida por Marinho se aproxima da proposta de flexibilização das jornadas apresentada por Flávio Bolsonaro, que também critica o momento da discussão e sustenta que as condições de trabalho devem considerar a negociação entre empregados e empregadores. O fim da escala 6×1 é uma pauta considerada positiva para o presidente Lula, candidato à reeleição, junto com Flávio Bolsonaro, no segundo turno. A alternativa se diferencia da PEC em análise no Senado, que estabelece limites constitucionais para a jornada e prevê dois dias de descanso remunerado. Apesar das críticas, a oposição ainda não havia anunciado uma posição conjunta definitiva sobre a votação. 




A senadora Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF), aliada de Flávio Bolsonaro, também acusou o governo de utilizar a pauta eleitoralmente. “Todos nós aqui queremos o melhor para o trabalhador. Agora, o que o PT está fazendo é ridículo”, afirmou após a reunião do bloco. Para ela, a crítica não está relacionada à defesa do fim da escala 6×1, mas ao momento escolhido para a discussão. A senadora questionou por que a proposta não avançou antes do primeiro turno e acusou o governo de tentar associar a pauta à imagem de Lula como defensor dos trabalhadores.




Corrida eleitoral




As últimas tratativas sobre o fim da escala 6×1 ocorrem em meio à disputa presidencial do segundo turno, que terá novos confrontos entre Lula (PT) e Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Além de acompanhar a tramitação da PEC no Senado, a semana ainda será marcada por entrevistas dos candidatos e pela preparação para os últimos debates antes da votação, marcada para 25 de outubro. 

Na quinta-feira, 15 de outubro, Lula será entrevistado no Jornal Nacional, e Flávio Bolsonaro participará do mesmo programa na sexta-feira, 16.

 As entrevistas serão exibidas após o telejornal.




Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro foram convidados para um debate organizado pelo grupo O Momento da Decisão, formado por 11 veículos de comunicação, entre eles CNN Brasil, SBT, SBT News, Metrópoles, RedeTV! e VEJA+ na mesma quinta-feira, 15. No domingo.18 de outubro, às 20h, os candidatos têm outro debate marcado, desta vez promovido pela TV Band, com transmissão também por veículos parceiros.




Estão na agenda da semana de 12 a 18 de outubro:




TSE







Propaganda eleitoral no segundo turno (9 a 23/10):

 Candidatas e candidatos que disputam o segundo turno voltam a ter propaganda eleitoral gratuita no rádio e na televisão. A veiculação começou na sexta-feira (9) e segue até 23 de outubro, dois dias antes da votação.




Certidão de quitação eleitoral (12/10):

 Data-limite para o reinício da emissão de certidões de quitação eleitoral pela internet, pelo Sistema ELO e pelo e-Título.




Relatórios de auditoria do primeiro turno (14/10):

 Prazo final para os Tribunais Regionais Eleitorais encaminharem ao TSE os relatórios individuais de auditoria referentes ao primeiro turno das eleições.




Prestação de contas de campanha (15/10):

 Último dia para órgãos da Receita Federal e secretarias estaduais e municipais de Fazenda enviarem ao TSE arquivos com notas fiscais eletrônicas relativas a bens e serviços fornecidos às campanhas. A data também marca o prazo para o envio de informações sobre permissões de serviços públicos concedidas no período previsto no calendário eleitoral.




Restrição à prisão de candidatos (9 a 27/10):

 Desde sexta-feira (9), candidatas e candidatos que disputam o segundo turno não podem ser presos ou detidos, salvo em caso de flagrante delito. A regra vale até 27 de outubro.







DIREITOS HUMANOS







Câmara







Inclusão de pessoas com deficiência no trabalho (CICS, 13/10, 15h):

 A comissão também analisa o PL 6218/2025, que prevê medidas para incentivar a inclusão e a permanência de pessoas com deficiência no mercado de trabalho, além do empreendedorismo em igualdade de condições.




Orientação acessível em edifícios públicos (CDU, 14/10, 10h):

 A comissão também analisa o 

PL 1233/2026, que propõe tornar obrigatórios sistemas de orientação por proximidade e realidade aumentada em edifícios públicos federais, para ampliar a autonomia de pessoas com deficiência e idosas.



















Senado







Direitos das meninas (CDH, 15/10, 9h):

 Comissão debate os direitos das meninas, em referência ao Dia Internacional da Menina, celebrado em 11 de outubro. A audiência deve discutir desafios, avanços e lacunas nas políticas públicas voltadas à proteção integral de meninas no Brasil.













MEIO AMBIENTE







Câmara







Proibição de penas e plumas de origem animal (CICS, 13/10, 15h):

 A Comissão de Indústria, Comércio e Serviços analisa o PL 1097/2019, que proíbe em todo o país o uso de penas e plumas de origem animal na produção de fantasias e alegorias.




Transparência no reúso de água (CDU, 14/10, 10h):

 Parlamentares analisam o 

PL 6715/2025, que prevê a divulgação periódica de informações operacionais sobre o reúso de água realizado por condomínios.













POLÍTICA







STF







Contribuição previdenciária de produtores rurais (ADI 4395):

 A ação discute a constitucionalidade da contribuição previdenciária de produtores rurais pessoas físicas sobre a receita da comercialização da produção, conhecida como Funrural, e a responsabilidade das empresas compradoras pelo recolhimento do tributo. 
















Agenda da semana da

 

Pública

 

é um serviço apresentado aos leitores, concebido com base nas informações dos portais da Câmara, Senado e STF.

title: Mutual aid is core infrastructure
content:
Mutual aid is a core infrastructure of resilient communities when systems fail, in disaster and crisis, and in normal times. It provides assistance and builds relationships, trust, collective capacity, and solidarity, before and after the crisis. Resilience takes infrastructure and equipment, and it takes people organizing and taking care of one another.




From the "Mutual Aid Disaster Relief Search and Rescue" workshop at the 2026 International Workshops.




A Radical Guide is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that builds movement infrastructure, including a global directory of radical spaces, mutual aid programs, and educational resources for people doing liberation work around the world.

author: radical.guide
title: Rejecting the technocratic idea of resilience
content:
The speaker rejects the narrow, technocratic version of resilience. It does not mean enduring injustice, adapting to ecological collapse or stabilizing extractive systems. Communities should not be asked to survive within conditions that undermine their dignity, autonomy, and ecological foundations. Resilience here means building systems that reduce vulnerability at their roots, with no return to an old normal.

author: webadmin
title: David Cameron Defends Trail Hunting: Four Days Later The Heythrop Kill A Fox
content:
On 14 September 2026, former Prime Minister David Cameron joined the Countryside Alliance in another performance of defending so-called trail hunting at an event in Westminster.




Kennel Huntsman Josh Tierney looks back to see who is watching before retrieving the body of the fox that is being killed in front of him. Image: Three County Hunt Sabs




Four days later, on 18 September, the Heythrop Hunt – a hunt Cameron has ridden with and was seen attending earlier this year – was out near Lower Swell in Gloucestershire.







Three Counties Hunt Sabs were there when the Heythrop’s hounds killed yet another fox, before members of the hunt carried its mauled body away.




Tierney legging it with the fox remains: Image: Three County Hunt Sabs




Cameron’s association with the Heythrop goes back decades. Most recently, on 28 February this year, Three Counties Sabs photographed the former Prime Minister attending a joint Heythrop and Tynedale meet at Dean Manor in Oxfordshire.




Cameron is spotted at a Heythrop meet in February 2026. Image: Three County Hunt Sabs




Cameron’s connections to hunting go beyond the Heythrop. His stepfather-in-law, Viscount Astor, is the chairman of the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA), the governing body for registered hunts in Britain.




Astor recently made the news when his 

plot to “hoodwink” government ministers

 over the proposed trail hunting ban made The Times newspaper.




William Waldorf Astor III, 4th Viscount Astor, stepfather-in-law of David Cameron and Chairman of the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA). Image: Bristol Hunt Saboteurs




Another senior figure at the BHSA has an even more direct connection to the Heythrop. It is the BHSA’s executive director, Julian Barnfield.




Barnfield is the former huntsman of the Heythrop, and he has history with Cameron.




Quadruple-convicted former Heythrop Huntsman, now the executive director of the BHSA Julian Barnfield.




In 2008, Barnfield was charged with three offences under the Hunting Act over allegations he had hunted foxes with hounds. At the time Cameron was Leader of the Opposition and the Heythrop was his local hunt. Cameron was also Barnfield’s constituency MP.




Following a private meeting between the two, Cameron intervened personally and wrote to the Attorney General on his constituent’s behalf, reportedly questioning whether prosecuting the Heythrop huntsman was 

“really a productive use of police time?”

 The case was subsequently discontinued.




Attempts to obtain a copy of the letter under the Freedom of Information Act were unsuccessful. 

Did the CPS cave to pressure from Cameron?




Four years later, Barnfield was back before the courts for illegal hunting. In December 2012, Barnfield pleaded guilty to four charges of illegally hunting foxes with dogs. Heythrop senior master Richard Sumner also pleaded guilty to four offences, as did Heythrop Hunt Ltd itself.




The case made history, as the Heythrop became the first hunt to be convicted as a corporate body under the Hunting Act.




Barnfield, the quadruple-convicted huntsman, on whose behalf David Cameron had personally intervened during the earlier prosecution, would go on to become the executive director of the organisation responsible for governing hunts in Britain.




On the morning of 18 September 2026, Three Counties Hunt Sabs were with the Heythrop when its hounds entered woodland.




WATCH THE VIDEO










The hunt had surrounded the woodland while hounds were pushed through the covert – classic cub hunting. Riders can be heard slapping their saddles – a tactic used to scare fleeing foxes back towards the hounds.




The fox was killed just inside the fenceline.




Kennel huntsman Josh Tierney was filmed climbing into the woodland and emerging carrying the fox’s mauled body, before running away with it.




When the sabs were able to reach the kill-site, they found blood and internal body parts – including the fox’s liver, left behind.







Blood on the fence where the fox’s body had been dragged (top) and liver and intestines (bottom)




Before joining the Heythrop, Tierney had been huntsman of the South Dorset Hunt. On 24 July 2024, he was convicted of racially/religiously aggravated intentional harassment, alarm or distress.




The Heythrop’s current master and huntsman Oliver Dale received a police caution after an 

assault on a female sab

 in November 2024. Dale was also 

charged with three Hunting Act offences

 whilst master and huntsman of the North Cotswold Hunt. Those charges were subsequently discontinued by the Crown Prosecution Service.




The Heythrop’s political connections are not confined to former Conservative leaders. In January this year the current Tory party leader, Kemi Badenoch, appeared at the Cocklebarrow Point-to-Point, a fundraiser for the Heythrop.







While there, Badenoch used her speech to attack the proposed ban on so-called ‘trail hunting’. She was pictured with a grinning Oliver Dale.




By the time Badenoch stood up in defence of trail hunting, the Heythrop hunt already had 12 guilty counts for illegal hunting. Furthermore, another former Heythrop huntsman, 

Chris Woodward

 – who had himself been convicted of a Hunting Act offence committed while he was huntsman of the Wynnstay Hunt – was at the centre of an incident that resulted in the Heythrop being issued a Community Resolution by Gloucestershire Rural Crime Team after he lost control of its hounds near Bourton-on-the-Water.




Heythrop Hunt kill a fox in 2023 at Eyford Park with Chris Woodward present.




Woodward also arrived at the Heythrop with convictions for interfering with a badger sett and harassment.




Over the years, individuals who have gone on to serve as Heythrop huntsmen have accumulated strings of offences ranging from harassment and badger sett interference to illegal hunting. None of this history was hidden.




The Heythrop and its hunt staff are also under further police investigations for events during the 2025/2026 season which we will report more on when we are able.




A spokesperson for the HSA said:







“Once again the Heythrop Hunt have been caught killing a fox. Its roll call of convicted huntsmen should be enough to make any politician steer well clear. Instead, politicians who aspire to govern this country continue to associate with, promote and defend the smokescreen of ‘trail hunting’.




Cub hunting is particularly indefensible. Young hounds are taken into woodland and taught to hunt foxes, whilst riders surround a covert and try to prevent foxes from escaping. There is no trail to follow, and no plausible excuse when a fox ends up dead.”







Three Counties Hunt Saboteurs said:







“Cub hunting and holding up (i.e stopping young foxes escaping hounds) continues as it did pre ban”.







You can support Three Counties Hunt Saboteurs 

here

 and follow them 

here



















The post 

David Cameron Defends Trail Hunting: Four Days Later The Heythrop Kill A Fox

 appeared first on 

Hunt Saboteurs Association

.

author: Unknown
title: Serokên nû yên baroyên Amed, Riha û Şirnexê hatin hilbijartin
content:
Di çarçoveya Civata Giştî ya 38emîn a Baroya Rihayê de, ji bo diyarkirina serokê baroyê yê serdema nû, parêzeran li ser sindoqan dengên xwe dan.




Li gorî nûçeya Ajansa Welat di hilbijartina ku li avahiya Baroya Rihayê hat kirin de parêzer Serdil Îzol, parêzer Mehmet Ejder, parêzer Faruk Dogan û parêzer Cuma Eroglu ketin hilbijartinê. Piştî bidawîbûna proseya dengdanê hejmartina dengên parêzeran dest pê kir.




Riha




Di hilbijartina ku hezar û 402 deng hatin bikaranîn de, piştî hejmartina denga parêzer Serdil Îzol bi girtina 906 dengan ango ji sedî 46an bû Serokê nû yê Baroya Rihayê.




Piştî bidawîbûna hilbijartinê Serokê nû yê Baroyê Serdil Îzol axivî û got:







“Ez vê erkê ne tenê wekî baweriyeke beramberî kesayeta xwe, lê wekî berpirsiyariyeke mezin dibînim. Ji ber ku Serokatiya Baroyê ne tenê meqamek e. Ev erke; parastina rûmeta pîşeya me ye, bihêzkirina parastina serbixwe ye û têkoşîna biryardarane ya ji bo serweriya hiqûqê ye.”




Îzol da zanîn ku ew dixwazin Baroya Rihayê ne ya kesan, lê ya prensîban, ne ya taybetmendiyan, lê ya wekhevî û keda hevpar bidin jiyandin û wiha pê de çû: “Ez bi taybetî dixwazim diyar bikim ku em ê pir bixebitin da ku vê baweriya li hemberî me vala dernexînin, em ê ji rexneyan re vekirî bin û em ê vê erkeyê tevî hevalên xwe yên pîşeyê bi rê ve bibin.”







Amed




Di çarçoveya Lîjneya Giştî ya 50emîn a Baroya Amedê de hilbijartina serokatiyê bi dawî bû.




Di hilbijartina ku li Navenda Çand û Kongreyê ya Çand Amedê pêk hat de, Sertaç Bûlûttekîn û serokê heyî Abdulkadir Guleç bibûn namzet. Pêvajoya dayîna dengan ku di saet 09.00an de dest pê kiribû, di saet 17.00an de qediya. Piştî jimartina dengan de Sertaç Bûlûttekîn 839, Abdûlkadîr Guleç jî 821 deng girtin. Bi vî encamî re Sertaç Bûlûttekîn weke serokê nû yê Baroya Amedê hat hilbijartin.




Şirnex




12emîn Lijneya Baroya Şirnexê li Eywana Civînê ya Zaningeha Şirnexê hat lidarxistin.




Di hilbijartinên serokatiya baroyê de Metîn Tatar û Abdullah Findik weke namzet xwe eşkere kiribûn. Di encama hilbijartinê de parêzer Metîn Tatar bû serokê Baroya Şirnexê.

author: Unknown
title: İddia: Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanvekili Büşra Özdemir AKP’ye geçiyor
content:
Fotoğraf: Antalya Büyükşehir Belediyesi

Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı Muhittin Böcek’in tutuklanmasının ardından Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkan Vekilliğine seçilen CHP’li Büşra Özdemir’in AKP’ye katılacağı öne sürüldü.

AKP'nin yerel seçimlerde kazanamadığı belediyeleri transferler ile ele geçirmesi tartışmalarına ilişkin yeni bir iddia gündeme geldi. Gazeteci Sinan Burhan, CHP yönetimindeki Antalya Büyükşehir Belediyesi’nde başkan vekilliği görevini yürüten Büşra Özdemir AKP'ye katılma hazırlığında olduğunu iddia etti.

Gazeteci Sinan Burhan, sosyal medya hesabı üzerinden yaptığı açıklamada, "Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı AK Parti’ye katılacak bilgisi var. Merakla beklenen o isim kim? İşte cevabı: Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkan Vekili Büşra Özdemir’in AK Parti’ye katılması bekleniyor" ifadelerini paylaştı.

Söz konusu iddia, AKP'den gelen dikkat çekici açıklamaların hemen ardından gündeme geldi. AKP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Hasan Basri Yalçın, geçtiğimiz günlerde partiye yeni katılımların gerçekleşeceğini duyurmuş ve özellikle bir büyükşehir belediyesini işaret etmişti.

Yalçın açıklamasında, "Cumhurbaşkanımız 'kapımız açık' dedi, bekliyoruz. İsim vermeyeyim ama sırada bir büyükşehir var. En kısa sürede inşallah göreceğiz" diyerek yeni bir trasnferin sinyalini vermişti.

Antalya Büyükşehir Belediye Başkanı Muhittin Böcek’in tutuklanmasıyla belediye meclisinde 11 Temmuz 2025 tarihinde seçim yapılmıştı. Meclisteki oylamada, CHP’nin Kepez ve Büyükşehir Belediye Meclis Üyesi olan 37 yaşındaki avukat Büşra Özdemir oy çokluğuyla başkan vekilliği görevine seçilmişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

content:
spirit-of-science

:

batsandboba

:

do not start gambling. go outside and locate a bug. now post it on inaturalist. bam. nature’s gacha game

The “gambling” reward pathway aka the inconsistent reward pathway literally evolved for things like this! Foraging! Trying new recipes! Experimenting with a new technique while crafting! Any essential human activity that 

might

 get you something useful, but also might just make some trash. 

There is nothing inherently unhealthy about that reward feeling! 

You can have that same feeling in a healthy way!!!! 

Corporations are taking advantage of it for profit, don’t let them!!!!!!

Mushroom hunting! Birding! Trying a new technique in a craft you’re already familiar with! Mixing random sauces in your fridge to see if any of them taste good!!! 




There’s also plenty of video games that will give you that little reward feeling without consistently asking you to input new money. 

I don’t find that as satisfying as doing shit with my hands, but also it’s cold and late and I’m tired. A cute indie video game that asked for my money once and then never again (because I own it now) will do fine.

author: Unknown
title: Appel à la grève et la manifestation aux côtés des lycéen•es et étudiant•es en lutte !
content:
Le gouvernement joue le pourrissement. Opposons-lui la joie de la lutte

 

!




L'Union régionale parisienne des syndicats 

CNT

 appelle l'ensemble des travailleuses et des travailleurs à se réunir en assemblées générales et, comme le font les lycéen•nes et étudiant•es, y construire les modalités de la lutte et au premier rang desquelles, la grève.




Mobilisons-nous en grève et en manifestation, non seulement le 13 octobre, aux côtés des lycéen·nes et des étudiant·es, ou encore le 5 novembre, comme y appellent également d'autres confédérations syndicales, mais chaque fois qu'il le faudra d'ici là et ensuite

 

!




Certains prétendaient que la jeunesse ne se mobilisait plus : elle leur a cloué le bec

 

! Depuis des semaines, jour après jour, elle se rassemble devant les lycées pour exiger les moyens humains et matériels nécessaires à une école publique de qualité. Jour après jour, elle descend dans la rue pour dénoncer le tri social et algorithmique à l'université, dont Parcoursup est le symbole.




Face à ce mouvement de révolte, le gouvernement a d'abord répondu par un nombre record d'interpellations et une répression d'une violence inouïe. Mais cette stratégie n'a pas suffi à étouffer la colère ni à faire rentrer les élèves dans le rang. Le gouvernement passe alors à l'étape suivante : interdire les rassemblements devant les établissements et imposer la poursuite des cours à distance. Et pour mieux enfumer tout le monde, il promet quelques remplacements de professeur•es et la mise en scène d'une «

 

démocratie interne dans les lycées

 

»… le temps d'une demi-journée. Mais la jeunesse ne tombe pas dans le panneau

 

! Elle amplifie la mobilisation dans la rue et sur les blocus. Elle y fait vivre une véritable démocratie directe en organisant des assemblées générales, d'où émergent de nouvelles revendications et s'inventent de nouveaux modes d'action.




Et le rapport de force qu'elle y construit ne sert pas seulement à défendre ses intérêts et à faire entendre ses exigences. Il ouvre aussi une perspective qui concerne l'ensemble des travailleurs et des travailleuses : combattre la résignation face à un ordre capitaliste qui creuse les inégalités et détruit la planète. En s'attaquant frontalement et avec enthousiasme à la machine austéritaire d'un gouvernement qui prépare 54 milliards d'euros d'«

 

économies

 

» sur les services publics, la culture, l'éducation et la santé, tout en augmentant de plus de 6 milliards le budget de l'armée, la jeunesse ouvre la voie à un mouvement social d'ampleur. Et en effet, puisque tout se dégrade pour tout le monde sauf pour les capitalistes qui battent les records de profits, l'heure est désormais à la convergence de l'ensemble des travailleuses et des travailleurs, du public comme du privé, et d'emboîter le pas à la révolte de la jeunesse.




C'est pourquoi l'Union régionale parisienne des syndicats 

CNT

 appelle l'ensemble des travailleuses et des travailleurs à se réunir en assemblées générales et, comme le font les lycéen•nes et étudiant•es, y construire les modalités de la lutte et au premier rang desquelles, la grève.




Mobilisons-nous en grève et en manifestation, non seulement le 13 octobre, aux côtés des lycéen·nes et des étudiant·es, ou encore le 5 novembre, comme y appellent également d'autres confédérations syndicales, mais chaque fois qu'il le faudra d'ici là et ensuite

 

!




Lycéen•nes, étudiant•es, salarié•es : faisons front ensemble

 

!




L'Union régionale parisienne des syndicats 

CNT


À Paris, le 11 octobre 2026

author: groundxero
title: “ভোট আমাদের অধিকার, তা এত সহজে কেড়ে নেওয়া যাবে না” – কলকাতার মিছিলে যন্তর-মন্তরের বহুস্বরের প্রতিধ্বনি
content:
মুখ্য নির্বাচন কমিশনার জ্ঞানেশ কুমারের পদত্যাগ ও এসআইআর প্রক্রিয়া বাতিলের দাবিতে আটটি বাম ছাত্র সংগঠনেরর উদ্যোগে ১১ অক্টোবর, কলকাতার শিয়ালদহ থেকে ধর্মতলা পর্যন্ত এক দীর্ঘ মিছিল সংঘটিত হয়।




 




সুদর্শনা চক্রবর্তী 

প্রতিবেদন




 




একটা মিছিল মানে জনরাশি। যেখানে প্রতিটি ব্যক্তি মানুষের চিন্তাচেতনা কোথাও গিয়ে একটি সাধারণ বিন্দুতে মিলেছে বলেই তারা পা মেলাচ্ছেন জোটবদ্ধ হয়ে, মুষ্ঠিবদ্ধ হাত উঠছে আকাশে, সমবেত কন্ঠের স্লোগান শোনা যাচ্ছে দূর থেকে দূরে। সারা দেশের নজর যখন দিল্লির যন্তর-মন্তরে দেশের ছাত্র-যুবদের নাছোড়, জীবনপণ লড়াইতে, যেখানে শামিল সব বয়সের মানুষ, তখন মুখ্য নির্বাচন কমিশনার জ্ঞানেশ কুমারের পদত্যাগ ও এসআইআর প্রক্রিয়া বাতিলের দাবিতে আটটি বাম ছাত্র সংগঠন ও অন্যান্য বাম সংগঠনের উদ্যোগে ১১ অক্টোবর, কলকাতার শিয়ালদহ থেকে ধর্মতলা পর্যন্ত এক দীর্ঘ মিছিল সংঘটিত হয়।




ছবি: অর্ক




এই মিছিলেই কথা বলা গেল কয়েক জন ছাত্র-যুবদের সঙ্গে তাঁদের রাজনৈতিক ভাবনার স্পষ্ট ছবি বোঝার জন্য। তাঁদের কাছে প্রশ্ন ছিল দিল্লির যন্তর-মন্তরের আন্দোলনের প্রতি প্রতিক্রিয়া, তাঁদের প্রতি রাষ্ট্র ও পুলিসের দমন-পীড়ন, মহিলা আন্দোলনকারীদের প্রতি ঘটা সহিংসিতা ও রাজ্য তথা দেশে বিজেপি সরকারের বিষয়ে তাঁদের মনোভাব সংক্রান্ত।




 




স্নাতকোত্তর স্তরের ছাত্রী কলকাতার পার্ক সার্কাসের শবনম খাতুন বললেন, “যেভাবে জ্ঞানেশ কুমার এত জন ভোটারের নাম বাদ দিয়েছেন, আমরা চাই, যে ভুল্ভাবে তারা এই কাজটা করছেন, সেই প্রক্রিয়াটা বন্ধ করা হোক, জ্ঞানেশ কুমার নিজের অ্যাকাউন্টিবিলিটি নিন, আর যদি তিনি তা না মেনে নেন, তাহলে তাকে ইস্তফা দিতেই হবে। অউর হাম তামাম জনতা কি এঁহি রায় হ্যায় কে উনহে ইস্তিফা দেনা পড়েগা, হর হাল মে দেনা পড়েগা।







 




দিল্লি পুলিস পুরোপুরি বিক্রি হয়ে গেছে। তারা জানেও না যে সামনে দাঁড়িয়ে আছে সে কে। শুধু সরকারের কথা শুনে জনতার উপর লাঠি চালানোই তাদের কাজ হয়ে গেছে। আমরা জানি যে, তাদের উপরে অর্ডার আছে। কিন্তু তার মানে এই নয় যে, তারা নিজের বিবেক ভুলে গিয়ে সব আন্দোলনকারীদের উপর এমন জুলুম করবেন। এর জবাব ওদের দিতেই হবে।




 




দেখুন, ভোটারদের কাছে, আমাদের মূল জিনিস হল ভোট। যদি আমাদের থেকে আমাদের ভোটই ছিনিয়ে নেওয়া হয়, তাহলে কীকরে বলব যে এই সরকার সিস্টেম মেনে গঠিত না কি ভোটচুরি করে তৈরি হয়েছে। সামনের নির্বাচনে কে থাকবে না থাকবে তা তো জানি না, কিন্তু আমি চাই যেন একটা সঠিক প্রক্রিয়া, সঠিক সিস্টেম মেনে কাজ হোক। ভোটচুরি, গদ্দারি যেন না হয়।




 




ভোট হামারা অধিকার হ্যায় অউর হামারা অধিকার ইতনি আসানি সে ছিনা নেহি যা সকতা। আর যখনই আমাদের অধিকার কেড়ে নেওয়ার চেষ্টা করা হবে তামাম জনতা একজোট হয়ে রুখে দাঁড়াবে। 




 




বিজেপি ধর্মের ভিত্তিতেই দেশ চালাতে চায়। হিন্দু থাকবে, মুসলমানদের হঠাতে হবে। এইভাবে যারাই শাসন করতে চেয়ে ইতিহাসে দেখুন, তাদের পরিণতি খারাপই হয়েছে। হিন্দুস্তানকে চালানোর জন্য, আমাদের সংবিধান যেভাবে বলে সেভাবেই একটি সরকারের উচিৎ দেশ চালানো, ধর্মের ভিত্তিতে নয়।”




 




যাদবপুর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পদার্থবিদ্যা বিভাগের প্রথম বর্ষের ছাত্র কৌশিক মন্ডল মনে করেন, “ছাত্রছাত্রীদের উপর যে অত্যাচার নামিয়ে আনছে…জ্ঞানেশকুমার আজ শুধু গণতন্ত্রের উপির একটা বড় আঘাত নামিয়ে আনছে তাই নয়, সব রকমভাবে আমাদের অধিকার কেড়ে নিতে চাইছে। উচ্চশিক্ষার উপর চরম আঘাত আনা হচ্ছে। কলেজ-বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পড়াশোনার ক্ষেত্রেও একটা অবৈজ্ঞানিক সিস্টেম চালু করেছে। এই কারণেই গোটা দেশ জুড়ে আন্দোলন শুরু হয়ে গেছে।







 




দিল্লিতে ছাত্র-যুবদের আন্দোলনে প্রবল রাষ্ট্রীয় দমন-পীড়ন দেখে ভয় তো একেবারেই পাচ্ছি না, বরং মনে করছি বাঁধন যত শক্ত হবে, সে বাঁধন তত তাড়াতাড়ি টুটে যাবে। আমরা এই আন্দোলনকে আরো দীর্ঘতর, আরো শক্তিশালী করার জন্য আমরা লাগাতার চালিয়ে যাব। 

আমি বাঁকুড়া থেকে যাদবপুর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে পড়তে এসেছি, এবং এখানে যে গণতান্ত্রিক পরিবেশ আছে তা হরণ করার প্রক্রিয়া হিসাবেই তার উপরেও আঘাত নামিয়ে আনা হচ্ছে।”

 




 




কলকাতার যোগমায়া দেবী কলেজ-এ ভূতত্ত্ববিদ্যার স্নাতক স্তরের চূড়ান্ত বর্ষের ছাত্রী পূর্ব মেদিনীপুরের মণীষা প্রধান স্পষ্টই জানালেন, “শুধু আজকে নয়, আমরা ইতিহাসের ধারাপথে এটা দেখে এসেছি যে, রাষ্ট্রের বিরূদ্ধে কোনো আন্দোলন করলে রাষ্ট্র নারী-পুরুষ নির্বিশেষে তাঁদের উপর এক বর্বরোচিত আক্রমণ নামিয়ে আনে। বিভিন্ন বাম সংগঠনের মহিলা কমরেডরা তাঁদের জান-প্রাণ দিয়ে এই লড়াইটা শেষ তক লড়ছেন। তাঁদের উপর যে ধরনের আক্রমণ পুলিসের তরফ থেকে করা হচ্ছে তা অত্যন্ত ঘৃণ্য ও নিন্দনীয়। কিন্তু তা সত্ত্বেও আমরা দমে যাইনি। বরং দেশ জুড়ে এই আন্দোলন আরোও বেড়ে চলেছে। জ্ঞানেশ কুমার ও নির্বাচন কমিশনের অবৈধভাবে ১৩ কোটি নাগরিকের নাগরিকত্ব বকলমে হরণ করা এসআইআর-এর মাধ্যমে – তার আমরা তীব্র বিরোধীতা করছি, জ্ঞানেশ কুমারের অপসারণ চাইছি। বৈধ নাগরিকদের নাগরিকত্ব হরণ করার যে চক্রান্ত তার জন্য আমরা এস আই আর-কে নিষিদ্ধ ঘোষণা করার দাবি করছি।




বাঁ দিক থেকে প্রথম মণীষা প্রধান




বিজেপি-আরএসএস-এর যে আদর্শ তা একেবারেই মনুবাদের আদর্শ, এবং তারা পিতৃতন্ত্রকেই একমাত্র বলে মনে করে যেখানে তারা মহিলাদের ভোগ্যপণ্যবস্তু হিসাবে দেখে। মহিলাদের তারা মানুষ বলে মনে করে না। তাদের কাজকর্মে তাই যে এটাই প্রতিফলিত হবে তা খুব স্বাভাবিক ব্যাপার। তাদের আক্রমণ, তাদের ভাষা প্রয়োগে এটাই বারংবার ফুটে উঠছে যে তারা মহিলাদের গায়ে হাত দেওয়া থেকে তাদের উপর নৃশংস আক্রমণ করছে। এটা বিজেপির আদর্শের সঙ্গে ওতপ্রোতভাবে জড়িত। বাম মহিলা কমরেডরা এদের মোকাবিলা করার সাহস রাখেন।




 




পশ্চিমবঙ্গের বর্তমান রাজনৈতিক প্রেক্ষাপটে ভয় পাওয়ার তো কোনো প্রশ্নই নেই। বাংলার সংগ্রামী বামপন্থী চেতনার সমস্ত মানুষ, তাঁরা সরকার ও রাষ্ট্রের চোখ রাঙানিকে মোকাবিলা করতে প্রস্তুত।”




 




দশম শ্রেণীর পড়ুয়া সুমি, নিজেকে আরশোলা বলতে আপত্তি নেই, তবে তারচেয়েও বেশি উৎসাহী নিজেকে চরম বামপন্থী হিসাবে পরিচয় দিতে। “পশ্চিমবঙ্গের কথা বলতে গেলে বলতে হয়, খুবই হতাশাজনক। কারণ দেশের বাকি শহরগুলোতে যেখানে সবাই বিজেপিকে তাড়াতে চাইছে সেখানে এ বছর এখানে বিজেপিকে জিতিয়ে দিল! এটা হতাশাজনক শুধু নয়, খুবই লজ্জাজনক।







বিজেপি-আরএসএস হিন্দুত্ব মানে। তারা উগ্র পিতৃতান্ত্রিক। তাই আন্দোলনকারী মেয়েদের সঙ্গে এমনটা হবে এটা জানা কথাই ছিল। দেখবেন উচ্চবর্ণের হিন্দুরাই মূলত বিজেপিকে সমর্থন করে, কারণ তারাই সবচেয়ে বেশি সুযোগ-সুবিধা পায়, এখনো পর্যন্ত। ভবিষ্যতে তাদের উপরেও প্রভাব পড়বে, কিন্তু এখন পড়ছে না, তাই তারা সমর্থন করছে।




 




পুলিসরা আসলে নিজেদের কাজের সুবিধা লুটছে। সরকার তো তাদের বিরূদ্ধে কোনো ব্যবস্থা নেবে না। পুরুষ পুলিস মহিলা আন্দোলনকারীদের যেভাবে হেনস্থা করছে, তারপরেও তাদের কিচ্ছু বলা হচ্ছে না, তাই তারা এটা চালিয়ে যাচ্ছে। ওদের (পুলিস) মধ্যে কোনো ভয় নেই, কোনো ভয় নেই।




 




সবকিছু দেখে রাগ হচ্ছে, আর সেটাই স্বাভাবিক। নাহ, ভয় পাচ্ছি না। কারণ কতজন মানুষকে আটকাবে? আমরা যখন একসঙ্গে আসব, ওরা কিচ্ছু করতে পারবে না। ব্যস শুধু রাস্তায় নামার সময়টুকুর অপেক্ষা।




 




আমার কথা হল, এই সরকারকেই ফেলে দাও। কারণ এই সরকারটাই ঠিক নয়। আমাদের সকলের একজন ঠিকঠাক প্রধানমন্ত্রী প্রয়োজন। জ্ঞানেশ কুমারকে সরালে যেটা হবে দায়বদ্ধতা স্বীকারের একটা ‘ট্রেন্ড’ চালু হবে। কেউ যখন কিছু ভুল করবে আমরা ‘অ্যাকাউন্টেবিলিটি’ দাবি করব। যা প্রয়োজন। কারণ এত বছর ধরে যে যা করেছে আমরা অ্যাকাউন্টিবিলিটি চাইনি। তারা ভুল করেও পার পেয়ে গেছে। সবাই বলে জেন-জি ট্রেন্ড ফলো করে। তাহলে যদি অ্যাকাউন্টিবিলিটি নেওয়ার ট্রেন্ড চালু হয়, তাহলে তা খুব সঠিক একটা কাজ হবে।” 




  




যাদবপুর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের পড়ুয়া অনুষ্ণার বক্তব্য, “গত প্রায় ৭২ ঘন্টা ধরে আমরা দিল্লিতে যা দেখছি, সেখানে বাস, ট্রেন থেকেই আন্দোলনে অংশগ্রহণ করতে আসছে যারা তাদের আটক করা হল। এবং যখন দিল্লিতেও আটক করা হচ্ছে তখন দেখা যাচ্ছে পুরুষ পুলিসরা মহিলাদের আটক করছে, অনেক ম্যানহ্যান্ডলিং হচ্ছে। রাস্তায় লোহার স্পাইক ফেলে রাখা হয়েছে, যাতে কোনো গাড়ি না ঢুকতে পারে। এইটা একটা সরকারের প্রস্তুতি। কাদের বিরূদ্ধে? ছাত্রছাত্রীদের! আমরা তো লেখাপড়া করি। আমরা তো দেশের সো কলড ভবিষ্যৎ। তাহলে আমাদের এত ভয় কেন? আমরা গত এক দেড় মাসে দেখেছি পশ্চিমবঙ্গে প্রচুর কলেজে একটা গুন্ডা বাহিনী, মব ঢোকানো হচ্ছে, তারা ভাঙচুর করছে। খুব সরলভাবে বোঝা যায় তারা কেন শিক্ষার বিরূদ্ধে, কারণ, আমরা ছাত্রছাত্রীরা শিক্ষিত যখন হই, তখন প্রশ্ন করতে শিখি। নানা অস্বস্তিদায়ক প্রশ্ন। তাদের প্রশ্ন পছন্দ নয় আদপেই।







বোঝা দরকার বিজেপি বা আর-এস-এস-এর কাছে মহিলার সংজ্ঞাটা কী। তারা তো আসলে মনুস্মৃতিকে ফলো করে। সেখানে, একজন মহিলা রাস্তায় বেরিয়ে এইভাবে প্রতিবাদ করছে, নিজেদের অধিকারের কথা জোর স্বরে বলছে, স্বাভাবিক সেটা রাষ্ট্রের পছন্দ হবে না। তারা সেই প্রতিবাদী মহিলা সবরকমভাবে দমিয়ে রাখার চেষ্টা করবে। তাতে যদি তাঁদের টেনে-হিঁচড়ে রাস্তা থেকে সরিয়ে দিতে হয়, তাই করবে তারা।




 




গত তিন দিন ধরে ছাত্রছাত্রীদের সঙ্গে যে ধরনের ট্রিট্মেন্ট-এর ভিশ্যুয়াল দেখছি, যেন আতঙ্কবাদীদের সঙ্গে করা হয় তেমন কিছু, যেন অপরাধীদের রাস্তা দিয়ে টেনে নিয়ে যাওয়া হচ্ছে। আমরা যারা শিক্ষিত হচ্ছি, আমাদেরই অ্যাটাকের মুখে পড়তে হচ্ছে কারণ আমরা কিছু বেসিক প্রশ্ন জিজ্ঞেস করছি। যে – এই সরকারের বৈধতা কোথায়? 

যদি লক্ষ, লক্ষ, কোটি, কোটি মানুষের ভোটাধিকার কেড়ে নেওয়া হয় এমন একটি প্রসেস-এর থ্রু দিয়ে যে প্রসেসে সেই বডিরই লোকেদের তিন জনের মধ্যে দু’জনের সম্মতি ছিল না নানা কিছুতে, তাহলে আমাদের বুঝতে হবে, আসলে গোটাটাই অবৈধ হচ্ছে। এবং সরকার যদি নিজের বৈধতা নিয়ে এতটাই কনফিডেন্ট থাকত তাহলে তো সে এত মেশিনারি নামিয়ে এত কিছু করত না। তাহলে বুঝতে হবে – দ্য ফিয়ার ইজ ভেরি রিয়্যাল।”

author: winter oak
title: Our righteous struggle
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article 

here




You’ve got to fight for what you want

For all that you believe

It’s right to fight for what we want

To live the way we please

As long as we have done our best

Then no-one can do more

And life and love and happiness

Are well worth fighting for




These lyrics, together with the stirring tune to which they are set, made a great impression on me when I was a boy.




The song 

Fight

 by The Musketeers, released as a single in 1969, was the 

theme music

 for 

The Flashing Blade

, the English version of a French TV series called 

Le Chevalier Tempête

. [1]




The story is based on historical events during the 17th century War of the Mantuan Succession between France and Spain, but I do not think the details of the plot interested me much – it was the song that I loved!




I knew somehow – in my bones, in my blood, in my guts – that what the words were saying was both true and important.










The song’s message was still ringing in my ears when I first launched myself, as a teenager, into my ongoing – but so far unsuccessful – efforts to bring down the venal and usurious globalist system.




I must have already come across the same spirit in the tales of Robin Hood, William Tell and other heroes and so I suppose one could argue that the outlook had been implanted in me by the cultural environment in which I grew up.




But I would say, rather, that it was already there at my birth – in the innate pattern of my mind, heart and soul – and that external stimuli like the song merely activated a thought that was waiting to be thought, provided the means by which an unconscious attitude became conscious.




And, even though not everyone thinks that way, I would say that we are looking here at an idea – a principle, rather – that generally forms part of our collective culture, in Europe and elsewhere.




We see it, for instance, in medieval Norse culture, in the 

Elder Edda

 of Saemund Sigfusson:




“A cowardly man thinks he will ever live, if warfare he avoids; but old age will give him no peace, though spears may spare him”.

 [2]
















It is also present, of course, in the Arthurian legends, as I noticed when re-reading a book that I have kept hold of since my childhood – 

King Arthur and His Knights of the Round Table

 by Roger Lancelyn Green (1918-1987), a friend and 

biographer

 of the author C.S. Lewis. [3]




Although this was published by Penguin under the “Puffin” label aimed at younger readers, it is a serious and eloquent re-telling based on Sir Thomas Malory’s famous account and weaving in material from various other sources.




I was amused to see the title of the aforementioned TV series make an appearance when Merlin the magician/druid announces, regarding young Arthur: “In Avalon the elves are forging Excalibur to be the sword of his right – the clean flashing blade that shall be raised only in the cause of right, shining on the earth until the time comes when they shall call it back again”. [4]




Likewise, Sir Launcelot of the Lake tells Sir Percivale of Wales: “Not in great deeds of arms lies the true worth of knighthood – rather in the heart of the doer of such deeds: if he be pure and humble, doing all things to the glory of God and to bring that glory and that peace throughout our holy kingdom of Logres”. [5]




At the inauguration of the Round Table, Merlin declares: “All of you, and those who shall sit afterwards at this Table, are the Knights of Logres, and for the glory of Logres, the Realm of Righteousness, do not ever depart from the high virtues of this realm.
















“Do no outrage nor murder nor any cruel or wicked thing; fly from treason and all untruthfulness and dishonest dealing; give mercy unto those who seek it – or sit no more at this Table.




“And always give all the help in your power to ladies and damsels, go out to succour gentlewomen and widows, turn from all else to right any wrong done to any woman in the world – and never, on pain of death and eternal disgrace, do you any ill thing to a woman, or suffer it to be done. Nor, for love or gain, fight in any quarrel that is not just and righteous”. [6]




By the way, the sign of Logres – “the land of true good and piety, nobleness and right living” [7] – is described by Lancelyn Green as being a five-pointed star [8] like the one that forms the organic radical logo below, together, in our case, with the rising sun of renewal and the greenery of life.




We are certainly not (still or yet) in the glorious times of Logres – indeed, power is currently in the hands of an evil zionist gang following a six-pointed star, whose moral stance is the exact opposite of that of Arthur and his knights.




They are far from being pure and humble, they delight in murder and cruelty, believe in showing no mercy at all to their enemies and consider they have the God-given right to rape any unchosen woman they want to.




Their supremacist cause is inherently unjust and they specialise in treason, untruthfulness and dishonest dealing, considering that being what 

they term

 “artful and shrewd” [9] makes them somehow superior to the rest of us.










A population sharing a strong sense of right and wrong, of ethics and honour, can unfortunately easily fall victim to a “trickster” [10] tribe whose machinations, crimes and lies hardly seem 

possible human behaviour

 to those with any sense of decency.




So what is the answer? To act likewise, to lower ourselves to their level and fight them on the terrain that suits them best?




No, of course not. We need to understand clearly what they have been doing to us and then rediscover, nurture and activate that righteous courage that lies within us.




The Knights of the Round Table never hesitate to charge into battle, even when the odds seem to be heavily stacked against them.




We should do the same and remember “a knight’s duty ever to defend the weak and punish the cruel and evil” [11] as we act “in pureness of heart and in obedience to the law of Heaven”. [12]




We might also heed that 

rebel wild and free

 Edward Abbey, when he declares: “Win or lose, the important thing is resistance. Defiance. Rebellion. Better to die on our feet than live on our knees”. [13]




Or we could hearken another verse of The Musketeers’ inspiring song:




And we should never count the cost

Or worry that we’ll fall

It’s better to have fought and lost

Than not have fought at all

King Arthur and His Knights of the Round Table

 (Harmondsworth: Penguin, 1970), p. 23.

The Jewish Century

 (Princeton & Oxford: Princeton University Press, 2019), p. 24, cit. Paul Cudenec, ‘Invisible imperialism’, 

https://winteroak.org.uk/2026/04/23/invisible-imperialism/

Hayduke Lives!

 (New York: Little, Brown and Company, 1990), p. 234, cit. Paul Cudenec, ‘A rebel wild and free’,

title: Το δολοφονικό χέρι του φασισμού ξαναχτύπησε στην Ελευσίνα! – Συγκέντρωση Δευτέρα 12/10 18:30 Καμάρα
content:
ΑΝΤΙΦΑΣΙΣΤΙΚΗ ΚΙΝΗΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ- ΚΑΤΑΓΓΕΛΙΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΠΙΘΕΣΗΣ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΛΕΥΣΙΝΑ




Το δολοφονικό χέρι του φασισμού ξαναχτύπησε στην Ελευσίνα! Λαός και νεολαία θα το τσακίσουν!




Με πολύ πρόσφατη την αποφυλάκιση και την επανεμφάνιση στο πολιτικό σκηνικό του αρχιναζί Κασιδιάρη και λίγο μόλις καιρό μετά τις επιθέσεις φασιστοειδών σε μετανάστες στην Αθήνα και στη Λάρισα, και σε νέους ανθρώπους στην Αμοργό, το δολοφονικό χέρι του φασισμού ξαναχτύπησε. Στην Ελευσίνα αυτή τη φορά, όπου δύο άτομα, (μέλη, όπως αναφέρεται, της νεοναζιστικής οργάνωσης Propatria) μαχαίρωσαν έναν αντιφασίστα, νέο άνθρωπο, στήνοντάς του καρτέρι έξω από το σπίτι του το απόγευμα της Πέμπτης 8/10. Ευτυχώς γλύτωσε η ζωή του, αφού αστόχησαν να τον μαχαιρώσουν στην κοιλιά, ωστόσο φέρνει σοβαρά τραύματα στα πόδια, για τα οποία διακομίστηκε στο νοσοκομείο. Οι δράστες δεν έκρυψαν τη μαύρη ιδιότητά τους, δηλώνοντάς του πως «είναι φασίστες». Χαρακτηριστική ήταν η στάση του αστικού Τύπου, που προσπάθησε αρχικά να παρουσιάσει το γεγονός ως μια «απόπειρα ληστείας», αποκρύπτοντας τον χαρακτήρα της φασιστικής επίθεσης, όπως είχε συμβεί και στο παρελθόν με τις δολοφονίες Φύσσα και Γρηγορόπουλου.




Το φονικό χέρι των κάθε είδους νεοναζί το οπλίζει η ίδια η πολιτική του συστήματος της εξάρτησης και της εκμετάλλευσης. Η εντεινόμενη φασιστικοποίηση της πολιτικής ζωής, η εξυπηρέτηση των δολοφονικών σχεδίων ΗΠΑ-ΝΑΤΟ-ΕΕ-Ισραήλ, τα εθνικιστικά και σοβινιστικά κηρύγματα ενάντια στους γείτονες λαούς, η στοχοποίηση των προσφύγων και των μεταναστών, αλλά και των νέων ανθρώπων και των αγωνιστών, όλων όσων τολμούν να αμφισβητήσουν τη συστημική πολιτική της ντόπιας άρχουσας τάξης και των ξένων ιμπεριαλιστικών αφεντικών. Το οπλίζει η εξυπηρέτηση των πολεμικών σχεδίων των ισχυρών του πλανήτη, η στρατιωτικοποίηση των οικονομιών, η πολιτική της φτώχειας της εξαθλίωσης, της περιθωριοποίησης.




Η νέα αυτή δολοφονική φασιστική επίθεση δεν πρέπει να μείνει αναπάντητη! Το φασιστικό φίδι σηκώνει ξανά κεφάλι. Να μην το αφήσουμε! Μόνο ο λαός, οι εργαζόμενοι και η νεολαία μπορούν να το τσακίσουν







ΘΑΝΑΤΟΣ ΣΤΟ ΦΑΣΙΣΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΟΝ ΙΜΠΕΡΙΑΛΙΣΜΟ!




ΤΟ ΦΑΣΙΣΜΟ ΤΣΑΚΙΖΟΥΝ ΑΓΩΝΕΣ ΛΑΙΚΟΙ!




Η ΤΡΟΜΟΚΡΑΤΙΑ ΔΕΝ ΘΑ ΠΕΡΑΣΕΙ – ΤΟΥ ΛΑΟΥ Η ΠΑΛΗ ΘΑ ΤΗΝ ΣΠΑΣΕΙ!

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 12 octobre
content:
Le 12 octobre, on ne passe pas loin de se voir libéré-e-s d'un horrible personnage : Maggie Thatcher passe en effet à deux doigts d'un cadeau de l'IRA. Mais ce n'est pas tout ce qui se passe aujourd'hui, loin de là ! 

Le sabotage

 porte ses fruits.




1492 :

 Christophe Colomb met le pied en Amérique, marquant le déclenchement de plus de 

5 siècles de pillages effrénés et de massacres

 en tout genre sur l'ensemble du continent commis par les colons et les exploiteurs.




1860 :

 En Aveyron, naissance d'Emile Pouget, auteur notamment du "

Sabotage

".




1892 :

 A 

Marseille

, explosion rue d'Alger chez l'anarchiste Camoin.




1898 :

 A Virden dans l'Illinois, des affrontements à la mitrailleuse ont lieu entre des gréviste et des briseurs de grève.




1977 :

 - A Rome, un local de la Démocratie Chrétienne (DC, le parti au pouvoir depuis l'après-guerre) est attaqué par un groupe de militants de gauche.




 A Frascati, une bombe explose devant un local du MSI, le nouveau parti fasciste italien.




1984 :

 Margaret Thatcher survit à une bombe de l'IRA Provisoire dans un hôtel de Brighton : celle-ci explose en effet dans ses toilettes deux minutes après que celle-ci l'utilise. Le Congrès du parti Conservateur se tenait alors dans la ville. Dans son communiqué de revendication, l'IRA précise à Maggie :


"

Aujourd'hui, nous n'avons pas eu de chance. Mais souviens-toi que nous n'avons qu'à être chanceux une seule fois - toi, tu devras toujours l'être.

"




 

 

 

L'hôtel le lendemain de l'explosion de la bombe de l'IRA Provisoire.


 

 




1985 :

 A Charleroi en Belgique, les Cellules Communistes Combattantes (CCC) attaquent simultanément le siège régional de Fabrimetal (association patronale de la métallurgie) et l'Office des Contributions Directes. Voir 

le communiqué

 de l'action.




 

 

 

 




1988 :

 En Italie, fin du procès "Moro ter", qui aboutit à 153 condamnations contre des militants des Brigades Rouges entre 1977 et 1982 : 26 peines de perpétuité (Susanna Berardi, Barbara Balzerani, Vittorio Antonini, Roberta Cappelli, Marcello Capuano, Renato Di Sabbato, Vincenzo Guagliardo, Maurizio Iannelli, Cecilia Massara, Paola Maturi, Franco Messina, Luigi Novelli, Sandra Padula, Remo Pancelli, Stefano Petrella, Nadia Ponti, Giovanni Senzani, Paolo Sivieri, Pietro Vanzi, Enrico Villimburgo, les fugitifs Rita Algranati et Alessio Casimirri et les mis en cause encore en liberté Eugenio Pio Ghignoni, Carlo Giommi, Alessandro Pera et Marina Petrella) et plus de 1800 ans de prison distribués au total.




1992 :

 A Londres, l'IRA fait sauter une bombe dans un bar.




1999 :

 - A "

Satra, près de Stockholm, Björn Sôderberg, âgé de 41 ans, militant anarcho-syndicaliste de la S.A.C suédoise, est assassiné de trois balles dans la tête, en sortant de son domicile. L'assassinat de ce militant anti-fasciste est lié à son travail. Il venait, en effet, d'empêcher le responsable d'un groupe néo-nazi de se faire nommer comme délégué du personnel dans l'entreprise où il travaillait.


Le 23 octobre 1999, plusieurs rassemblements ont eu lieu : à Stockholm, ainsi qu'à Paris devant l'ambassade de Suède, pour marquer la solidarité internationale des anarchistes dans la lutte anti-fasciste."




Repris de 

l'éphéméride anarchiste

.




 Le même jour, on aurait atteint les 6 milliards d'êtres humains sur terre. Les comptes ont-ils été faussés du fait de la mort d'un camarade ?




2014 :

 A Genève, quatre fourgons banalisés de la police sont entièrement détruits par un incendie volontaire.
