title: Группа Русских анархистов Заграницей. Редакция «Дела Труда». - БЕСПРОГРАММНАЯ ПРОГРАММА АНАРХО-ХАОТИКОВ
content:
Автор

: Группа Русских анархистов Заграницей. Редакция «Дела Труда».

Название

: 

БЕСПРОГРАММНАЯ ПРОГРАММА АНАРХО-ХАОТИКОВ

Подзаголовок

: (

По поводу «ответа» на организационную платформу Волина и других

)

Дата

: сентябрь 1927, написана 18 августа 1927.

Источник

: Дело Труда, №28




 Вышедший вначале августа «Ответ нескольких русских анархистов на организационную платформу»

[1]

 представляет собой попытку дать критику и полное опровержение организационной платформы, изданной Группой Русских Анархистов Заграницей. Авторы «ответа» заявляют свое несогласие не с отдельными местами платформы. Нет, самую 

сущность, дух, и идею

 платформы они «считают неприемлемыми» (с. 39 «Ответа») и находят эту сущность, дух и идею выражением не анархизма, а большевизма. (с. 30, 37) «Сущность у большевизма и у «анархистов из платформы» одна и та же» – говорят они на странице 37 своего «ответа». …«Авторы платформы – говорится на 30 странице ответа – несомненно стоят на точке зрения организации 

руководящего политического центра

 и находящейся в его распоряжении 

армии и полиции

, то есть по существу организации переходной политической власти государственного типа»…И много еще подобных сногсшибательных утверждений разбросано в «ответе». 




 Мы полагаем, что подобные утверждения 

обязывают

 авторов их дать исчерпывающие доказательства этим своим утверждениям. Ибо в противном случае анархическое движение попадет под угрозу наводнения нечистоплотными поступками, против чего каждый подлинный анархист должен решительно восстать. 




 В своем дальнейшем изложении мы увидим, 

насколько

 авторы «ответа» обосновали свои утверждения и тогда станет ясным смысл и ценность «ответа». 




 Авторы начинают с заявления, что они в «в корне несогласны с рядом основных или весьма существенных положений платформы». На самом же деле они оказываются несогласными со 

всеми

 принципиальными и организационными положениями платформы. Притом, свое несогласие они обосновывают с большой натяжкой, прибегая к софизмам, притаскивают аргументы за волосы. В такое положение они попали главным образом потому, что ни по одному из затронутых в платформе вопросов они не имеют самостоятельного мнения и в то же самое время относятся заранее враждебно ко всей платформе в целом. Мы убедимся в этом, рассмотрев основные возражения авторов «ответа». Более того: мы параллельно увидим, что авторы «ответа», опровергая то или иное положение платформы, сплошь и рядом списывают затем это положение, выдают за свое и противопоставляют его платформе. 




 Оговоримся: лучшим ответом на сделанные возражения является сама платформа, где по всем затронутым вопросам читатель найдет четкое и ясное мнение. Здесь же мы остановимся лишь на некоторых пунктах платформы, опровергаемых авторами ответа, дабы иллюстрировать тот дух, то направление, которым живут эти последние. 




 1. 

О причинах слабости анархического движения

. 




 Как на «самую большую и главную» причину слабости анархического движения, Платформа указала на «отсутствие в анархическом мире организационных начал и организационных отношений», ведущих к «общей хронической дезорганизованности» анархического движения. Платформа добавила тут же, что сама «дезорганизованность гнездится в некоторых уродствах идеологического порядка». Такими уродствами мы считаем внесение в анархизм целого ряда мелко-буржуазных начал, ничего общего с анархизмом не имеющих. Дезорганизованность царит в наших рядах, но она получает пищу себе в идеологической дезорганизованности и неразберихе. И чтобы преодолеть практическую и идеологическую дезорганизованность, Платформа выдвинула идею создания общей организации на почве 

однородной

 программы. Таким образом, Платформа кладет начало общей организации анархистов и ведет их к идеологической однородности. Созданная таким путем организация своими коллективными силами окончательно освобождает анархизм от идеологических противоречий и от организационных недочетов и тем самым прокладывает путь для мощного анархического движения, идущего под знаменем однородных принципов. Иного пути для развития и укрепления анархизма в массах мы не видим. Платформа при этом отметила, что метод объединения различных течений в «одну дружную семью» не только не оздоровляет анархического движения, но, наоборот, запутывает и ослабляет его. 




 Наши критики из «ответа» полностью отвергают развитое в платформе положение о причинах слабости анархического движения. Как на главную причину они в свою очередь указывают на 

неясность ряда основных наших идей

 (напр. понятия социальной революции, понятия насилия, понятия творчества масс, переходного периода, диктатуры, организации и других) – страница 4. В других местах «ответа» авторы его указывают ряд иных вопросов, по которым анархисты также не имеют общего мнения. Получается картина, будто анархисты 

ни по одному вопросу

 не имеют общего мнения и будто все вопросы надо заново разрабатывать, «теоретизировать» и так далее, а уж потом думать об организации. Эти мысли и эти обещания многие из нас давно слышали. Вместо того, чтобы пугать нас в сто первый раз «глубокой теоретической работой», авторам «ответа» следовало бы лучше попросту взяться за нее, приготовить и выдвинуть, как противовес платформе. 




 Мы, однако, иного мнения об основных положениях анархизма. Мы считаем, что и по вопросу «понятия социальной революции» и по вопросу «понятия насилия», «творчества масс», «диктатуры», «организации» и так далее 

основное ядро анархистов

 сходится между собой. Те же, кто по сию пору являются принципиальными противниками социальной революции, революционного насилия, организации и так далее, те этими противниками останутся навсегда, несмотря ни на что, и было бы наивно из за них начинать всю историю анархизма сначала. Сегодня в анархическую среду придет один и заявит, что он не согласен с идеей социальной революции, завтра придет другой и скажет, что он против революционного насилия, третий скажет, что он недоволен самой идеей анархического коммунизма, четвертый скажет, что он против классовой борьбы и так далее. Кричать во всех этих случаях о неясности «

основных идей анархизма

» значит по истине не уметь мыслить теоретически. Ведь у нас были Бакунин, Кропоткин, Малатеста, достаточно ясно осветившие основные положения анархизма. У нас были 

анархические движения

 в разных странах, выросшие на этих основных положениях. Как же можно заявлять, что они у нас неясны? 




...

author: Unknown
title: Litvanya’da kitle imha silahları bulundurma yasağının kaldırılmasına ilk onay verildi
content:
Fotoğraf: Augustas Didžgalvis/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

Litvanya Ulusal Radyo ve Televizyonunun (LRT) haberine göre, Litvanya topraklarında kitle imha silahlarının bulundurulmasını yasaklayan anayasa hükmünün kaldırılmasını öngören değişiklik bugün parlamentoda görüşüldü.

Parlamento Başkanı Juozas Olekas, oylama öncesinde yaptığı açıklamada, yasağın kaldırılmasının Litvanya’nın dayanıklılığını ve caydırıcılık kapasitesini güçlendireceğini söyledi. Olekas, yasağın kaldırılmasıyla Litvanya’nın kitle imha silahlarının konuşlandırılmasına ilişkin anayasal kısıtlamasının diğer AB ve NATO ülkelerindeki hukuki durumla aynı hale geleceğini vurguladı.

Litvanya Savunma Bakanı Robertas Kaunas da ülkesinin stratejik silahlara sahip ülkelerle çevrili olduğunu belirterek, Rusya’nın en batısında yer alan Kaliningrad eksklavı ile Belarus’a işaret etti. Önerilen anayasa değişikliğini Moskova’nın eylemlerine verilen bir yanıt olarak nitelendiren Kaunas, “Rusya, Ukrayna’da savaşı başlatmasaydı bugün yaptığımız tartışmaları muhtemelen yapmıyor olurduk” dedi.

Yapılan oylamada milletvekilleri değişikliğe 106 oyla destek verirken, 18 milletvekili karşı oy kullandı, 6 milletvekili ise çekimser kaldı.

Anayasa değişikliğinin kabul edilmesi için parlamentoda bir oylama daha yapılması gerekiyor. Parlamento Başkanı Olekas, kitle imha silahlarının Litvanya’da bulundurulmasını yasaklayan anayasa hükmünün kaldırılmasıyla ilgili nihai oylamanın 12 Ocak 2027’de yapılmasının planlandığını açıkladı.

Litvanya’daki tartışmalar, Fransa Cumhurbaşkanı Emmanuel Macron’un Avrupa için yeni bir nükleer caydırıcılık sistemi kurulması yönündeki önerisi ile ABD’nin bazı ilave NATO ülkelerine nükleer silah konuşlandırma seçeneğini değerlendirdiğine ilişkin haberlerin ardından yoğunlaştı.

Kremlin Sözcüsü Dmitriy Peskov, Litvanya’da nükleer silah konuşlandırılması durumunda bu ülke topraklarının Rus nükleer silahlarının hedefi olacağını belirterek, “Bu, durumu ciddi şekilde gerginleştirecek” ifadelerini kullanmıştı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Mourinho'dan Fenerbahçe ve hakemler hakkında açıklama: “Türkiye'de benzer bir skandal patlak verdi”
content:
Real Madrid Teknik Direktörü Jose Mourinho, Fenerbahçe'de görev yaptığı döneme ve hakemlerle yaşadığı tartışmalara ilişkin açıklamalarda bulundu. Mourinho, Türkiye'de “benzer bir skandal” yaşandığını söyledi.

Real Madrid Teknik Direktörü Jose Mourinho, İtalyan basınından Corriere dello Sport'a verdiği röportajda kariyerindeki önemli dönemeçleri ve hakemlerle ilgili tartışmaları değerlendirdi.

Fenerbahçe'de 2024-2025 sezonunda görev yapan Mourinho, sarı-lacivertli kulübün kendisi için özel bir yeri olduğunu söyledi.

Mourinho, Fenerbahçe'de yalnızca 13-14 ay görev yaptığını belirterek, “Fenerbahçe'nin benim için özel bir yeri var ancak orada sadece 13-14 ay kaldım” dedi.

Portekizli teknik direktör, Real Madrid'e dönüşünü ise “eve dönmek” olarak nitelendirdi.

Mourinho, “Real Madrid'e dönmek de eve dönmek gibi. Burada 3 yıl kalmıştım ama kulüple kurduğum bağ sayesinde sanki 30 yıl gibi geldi” ifadelerini kullandı.

Mourinho, kariyeri boyunca hakemlerle yaşadığı sorunların kendi hatasından kaynaklanmadığını savundu.

Yaşananları “şanssızlık” olarak değerlendiren Mourinho, farklı liglerde benzer durumlarla karşılaştığını söyledi.

Mourinho, “Bunun benim hatam olduğunu düşünmüyorum, şanssızlık olduğunu düşünüyorum. Real Madrid'e ilk geldiğimde Barcelona'nın altın yıllarını yaşadık, sonra Premier Lig'e gittim ve şimdi bu durumlar ortaya çıkıyor” dedi.

Fenerbahçe'deki dönemine gönderme yapan Mourinho, sözlerini şöyle sürdürdü:

“Ardından Türkiye'de benzer bir skandal patlak verdi. Sık sık benzer durumlar yaşadım.”

Mourinho'nun açıklamaları, Fenerbahçe'de görev yaptığı dönemde hakem kararları üzerinden yaptığı tartışmalı açıklamaları yeniden gündeme getirdi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: L214
title: Végétalisation des menus des cantines scolaires : l’état des lieux de L214
content:
Au lendemain de la rentrée scolaire 2026, L214 dresse l’état des lieux de la végétalisation des menus des cantines scolaires dans 40 villes de France. Ce bilan, le premier depuis la prise de fonction des nouveaux élus à l’issue des élections municipales de mars 2026, révèle des situations contrastées : là où certaines villes se contentent du minimum imposé par la loi, d’autres font preuve de plus d’ambition, indépendamment de leur couleur politique.

La végétalisation des menus dans les cantines scolaires constitue un levier puissant et efficace à disposition des maires pour contribuer à réduire le nombre d’animaux tués pour l’alimentation en France. C’est pourquoi L214 propose trois mesures de végétalisation dans sa charte d’engagement du Sauvetage du siècle à destination des maires : instaurer une option végétarienne quotidienne, deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires et un plat végétalien hebdomadaire.

Ce début d’année scolaire révèle de fortes disparités d’une ville à l’autre sur la mise en place de deux journées végétariennes par semaine. Sur les 40 villes de plus de 100 000 habitants étudiées par L214 :

14 villes proposent deux journées végétariennes par semaine ou plus,

12 villes proposent 5 à 7 journées végétariennes par mois,

14 villes se contentent d’une journée végétarienne par semaine, le minimum légal imposé par la loi EGalim.

Concernant la mise en place d’une option végétarienne quotidienne, le tableau est là aussi très contrasté : 11 villes proposent déjà cette option, alors que 24 villes proposent une option « sans viande » ou « sans porc » pouvant contenir du poisson, une alternative qui n’est donc pas végétarienne. Cinq villes ne proposent aucune alternative végétarienne quotidienne.

Certaines villes comme Bordeaux, Grenoble, Lyon, Montpellier et Paris font figure de bonnes élèves en cumulant d’ores et déjà une option végétarienne quotidienne et deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires. D’autres villes vont même au-delà des mesures portées par L214, à l’image de Saint-Denis, qui propose 3 journées végétariennes chaque semaine dans ses cantines, ou de Montpellier, qui propose deux plats végétaliens chaque mois.

À l’inverse, Boulogne-Billancourt, Limoges et Le Mans notamment se limitent à une journée végétarienne par semaine, le minimum prévu par la loi.

→ Découvrir la charte d’engagement du Sauvetage du siècle

Cet état des lieux montre que la volonté de végétaliser les menus dans les cantines scolaires n’est pas portée par un seul parti politique. Parmi les cinq villes qui cumulent une option végétarienne quotidienne et deux journées végétariennes hebdomadaires, Bordeaux est dirigée par une majorité du centre, Grenoble et Lyon par des majorités écologistes, et Montpellier et Paris par des majorités de gauche.

Plusieurs villes affiliées à droite renforcent elles aussi la végétalisation de leurs cantines. Aix-en-Provence propose désormais deux journées végétariennes une semaine sur deux, et Metz en propose 5 à 7 par mois.

Pour Erwin Goeller, chargé d’affaires publiques de L214 : « La végétalisation des menus dans les cantines scolaires est un choix politique concret à la portée de chaque maire. L’enjeu a été pris au sérieux par plusieurs municipalités, mais les efforts restent très disparates selon les villes. Nous appelons les nouveaux élus à se saisir pleinement de ce sujet pour contribuer, à leur échelle, à réduire de moitié le nombre d’animaux tués pour l’alimentation en France ! »

author: anred
title: Río Negro: la Cámara de Bariloche confirmó el desalojo de la Lof Inalef y la comunidad anuncia que seguirá resistiendo
content:
La Cámara de Apelaciones en lo Civil de Bariloche confirmó la sentencia que ordena el desalojo de la Lof Inalef, en la Rinconada de Inalef, paraje Mallín Ahogado, Río Negro. «Informamos que la Cámara de Apelaciones en lo Civil de Bariloche ha dictado un fallo desfavorable para nuestro Lof. Se confirmó la sentencia anterior y sigue en pie el pedido de desalojo sobre nuestro territorio», informó la comunidad este miércoles 7 de octubre. La comunidad denunció, además, falencias en su primera defensa técnica y anunció que continuarán apelando y sosteniendo la permanencia territorial: «esto no termina acá. Seguiremos con los recursos y acciones que correspondan, defendiendo nuestra permanencia en el territorio». El nuevo fallo se produce en un escenario de creciente conflictividad territorial en la Patagonia y días después de que la Corte Suprema reactivara la derogación de la Ley de Tierras Rurales impulsada por el gobierno de Javier Milei. 

Por ANRed.







La 

Lof Inalef vuelve a quedar frente a una orden de desalojo

 sobre un territorio que reivindica como ancestral, luego de que la 

Cámara de Apelaciones en lo Civil de Bariloche confirmó la sentencia que ordena el desalojo del territorio mapuche ubicado

 

en la Rinconada de Inalef, paraje Mallín Ahogado, El Bolsón, Río Negro.




La comunidad informó este miércoles 7 de octubre que recibió un nuevo revés judicial y cuestionó tanto la decisión como el desempeño de la primera defensa técnica: «informamos que la Cámara de Apelaciones en lo Civil de Bariloche ha dictado un fallo desfavorable para nuestro Lof. 

Se confirmó la sentencia anterior y sigue en pie el pedido de desalojo sobre nuestro territorio»

, comunicaron desde la Lof Inalef, que anticipó que continuará recurriendo la resolución: «esto no termina acá. 

Seguiremos con los recursos y acciones que correspondan, defendiendo nuestra permanencia en el territorio

«.




El conflicto tiene antecedentes de larga data. En mayo de este año, la jueza 

Paola Bernardini

 había dictado una 

sentencia de desalojo en favor de Juan Lux Auroux

, mientras en otra causa 

el exintendente de El Bolsón Félix Argentino Merino había obtenido una resolución similar sobre tierras de la familia Inalef

. La comunidad sostiene que se trata de un territorio ancestral y que distintos procesos judiciales desconocen esa historia.




Foto del aniversario de el Bolsón del 28 de enero del 2026. Se lo ve al gobernador Alberto Weretilneck, al intendente Bruno Pogliano y el hijo de Félix Argentino Merino, el abanderado.




La propia documentación judicial incorpora antecedentes sobre esa ocupación: en la causa vinculada a Auroux consta que 

el Consejo de Desarrollo de Comunidades Indígenas (CODECI) reconoció en 2018 la conformación de la Lof Inalef y tuvo por acreditada “la posesión ancestral, tradicional, actual y pública” sobre tierras de sus abuelos José Antonio Inalef y María Antonia Leviu, registradas por el Estado desde 1907

. El expediente también señala que la tramitación del relevamiento territorial de la Comunidad Newenche, de la que forma parte la Lof Inalef, se inició en 2012.




El comunicado de este miércoles cuestiona además la actuación de quienes ejercieron inicialmente la representación legal de la comunidad: «sabemos cómo está jugando la política hoy en día. Además, 

la primera defensa técnica presentó graves falencias no incluyó nuestros testigos ni nuestras pruebas y no ejerció la defensa en etapas clave

«, denunciaron. En este marco, 

la Lof anunció que continuará utilizando las herramientas judiciales disponibles y convocó a las comunidades y organizaciones que históricamente acompañaron su lucha

.







El antecedente reciente muestra que esa red de solidaridad ya tuvo una expresión concreta en junio de este año, cuando la Lof Inalef convocó a un trawn frente a la amenaza de desalojo y recibió el 

acompañamiento de comunidades mapuche, organizaciones de derechos humanos, sindicatos, movimientos sociales y organizaciones ambientales de la Comarca Andina

. Entre otras, acompañaron Lof Coronado-Inalef, Lof Pu Huayteka, Lof Che Buenuleo, Lof Quemquemtrew, la APDH, la CTA, organizaciones docentes y asambleas ambientales.




La disputa territorial se encuentra además atravesada por una historia de violencia: 

en agosto de 2024, Juan Carlos Villa fue asesinado a tiros por un efectivo de la Policía de Río Negro durante un operativo en la zona de Rinconada de Inalef y su hijo Emanuel resultó gravemente herido

. La Coordinadora del Parlamento Mapuche de Río Negro vinculó en aquel entonces la violencia policial con la persecución territorial y con los procesos de desalojo que afectan a comunidades de la región.




Imagen: La Política Ambiental.




El nuevo fallo de la Cámara de Bariloche llega, además, en un contexto nacional marcado por la 

decisión de la Corte Suprema de dejar vigente la derogación de la Ley 26.737 de Tierras Rurales mediante el DNU 70/2023

, una resolución que 

volvió a abrir la puerta a la adquisición sin los límites establecidos anteriormente para capitales extranjeros

 y que, tras el fallo, organizaciones indígenas, campesinas, ambientales, sindicales y sociales volvieron a plantear la 

necesidad de responder nuevamente en las calles

.
sourceTags: Cámara de Apelaciones en lo Civil de Bariloche
Ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada

author: Unknown
title: Yoksulluğa değil, savaşa bütçe: Savunma harcaması 2027’de yüzde 229 artacak
content:
Merkez Bankası’nın İstanbul Finans Merkezi'nde düzenlediği İstanbul Ekonomi Forumu başladı. Dünyanın farklı ülkelerinden merkez bankası başkanları ve üst düzey politika yapıcıların katıldığı forumun açılış konuşmasını Hazine ve Maliye Bakanı Mehmet Şimşek yaptı.




Konuşmasında küresel ekonomide yaşanan sorunlara değinen Şimşek, tedarik zincirlerindeki aksamalara, emtia fiyatlarındaki artışa ve yükselen enerji maliyetlerine dikkat çekti. Şimşek, ekonomik krizin kontrol altında olduğunu savundu.




Savunma harcamalarına yüzde 229 artış




Şimşek'in konuşmasında en dikkat çekici başlıklardan biri ise 2027 yılı bütçesine ilişkin açıklaması oldu.




Türkiye'nin caydırıcılığını güçlendirmeye devam ettiğini belirten Şimşek, çatışmaların yaşandığı bir dünyada savunma alanına yatırım yapılmasının zorunluluk olduğunu söyledi.




Şimşek, kısa süre önce hazırlanan ve TBMM'ye sunulması beklenen 2027 yılı bütçesinde savunma harcamalarının yüzde 229 artırılacağını duyurdu.




Türkiye'nin son 20 yılda savunma sanayisine önemli yatırımlar yaptığını söyleyen Şimşek, 1990'lı yıllarda dünyanın en fazla savunma sanayisi ürünü ithal eden beş ülkesi arasında bulunan Türkiye'nin bugün en büyük 10 ihracatçı arasına girmeye yaklaştığını ileri sürdü.




Savunma projelerindeki AR-GE büyüklüğünün 100 milyar doların üzerinde olduğunu belirten Şimşek, yaklaşık 1400 ürün geliştirme projesinin yürütüldüğünü de açıkladı.







2026’da Milli Savunma Bakanlığına ayrılan bütçe 822 milyar 930 milyon 177 bin TL’ydi.




Şimşek'in sözünü ettiği 2027 yılı için yüzde 229'luk artış doğrudan Milli Savunma Bakanlığı’nın bütçesine uygulanırsa kurumun ödeneği yaklaşık 2,71 trilyon TL’ye yükselecek.




Ancak Şimşek'in yüzde 229 artışla Milli Savunma Bakanlığı bütçesini mi, yoksa daha geniş kapsamlı savunma harcamalarını mı kastettiği bilinmiyor. Savunma ve güvenlik için ayrılan toplam kaynak, yalnızca bakanlığın bütçesinden ibaret değil.




Öte yandan Stockholm Uluslararası Barış Araştırmaları Enstitüsü’nün (SIPRI) 2025 verilerine göre Türkiye’nin askeri harcamaları son 10 yılda yüzde 94 artarak 30 milyar dolara ulaştı. Bu da Türkiye'yi dünya en yüksek askeri harcama yapan ülkeler arasında 18. sıraya soktu.



















Ülkeler silahlanmaya 2025’te 2,9 trilyon dolar harcadı




27 Nisan 2026










86 milyon 92 bin kişilik nüfus düşünüldüğünde hükümet kişi başına yaklaşık 375 dolarlık (yaklaşık 18 bin 500 TL) askeri harcama yapıyor.




Milyonlarca kişi yoksulluk riski altında, çocuklar öğün atlıyor




Savunma harcamalarındaki artış açıklaması, Türkiye'de milyonlarca yurttaşın geçim sıkıntısıyla mücadele ettiği bir dönemde geldi.




Türkiye İstatistik Kurumunun (TÜİK) 2025 yılı Yoksulluk ve Yaşam Koşulları Araştırması'na göre nüfusun yüzde 27,9'u, yani yaklaşık 24 milyon kişi, yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında bulunuyor. Medyan gelirin yüzde 50'si esas alınarak hesaplanan göreli yoksulluk oranı ise yüzde 13. Bu da yaklaşık 11 milyon kişiye karşılık geliyor.




Çocuklarda ise tablo daha çarpıcı. TÜİK verilerine göre 0-17 yaş grubundaki çocukların yüzde 36,8'i yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında. Başka bir ifadeyle Türkiye'de her üç çocuktan birinden fazlası bu riskle karşı karşıya.




Aynı araştırmaya göre nüfusun yüzde 35,1'i, yani yaklaşık 30 milyon kişi, ekonomik nedenlerle iki günde bir et, tavuk veya balık içeren bir öğünün masrafını karşılayamıyor. Yurttaşların yüzde 19,6'sı ise evinin yeterince ısınma ihtiyacını ekonomik olarak karşılayamadığını belirtiyor.



















"Her üç çocuktan biri yoksulluk riski altında”




13 Temmuz 2026










Öte yandan TÜRK-İŞ'in Eylül 2026 araştırmasına göre dört kişilik bir ailenin sağlıklı ve dengeli beslenebilmesi için yapması gereken aylık asgari gıda harcaması 37 bin 801 TL'ye yükseldi. Gıda dışındaki zorunlu giderleri de kapsayan yoksulluk sınırı ise 123 bin 130 TL'ye ulaştı.




2026 yılında net asgari ücretin 28 bin 75 TL olduğu düşünüldüğünde, tek asgari ücretle geçinen dört kişilik bir hanenin aylık geliri yalnızca gıda için hesaplanan açlık sınırının bile yaklaşık 9 bin 725 TL altında kalıyor.




Çocukların beslenme sorunu eğitim hayatına da yansıyor. Ekonomik İşbirliği ve Kalkınma Örgütünün (OECD) PISA 2022 araştırmasına göre Türkiye'deki 15 yaşındaki öğrencilerin yüzde 19,3'ü, yiyecek alacak yeterli para bulunmadığı için haftada en az bir kez öğün atladığını bildirdi.




Milli Eğitim Bakanlığının 2025-2026 istatistiklerine göre resmi okullarda yaklaşık 15,2 milyon öğrenci eğitim görüyor. Bu öğrencilerin tamamına yılda 180 gün boyunca ücretsiz bir öğün yemek verilmesi durumunda, öğün başına varsayımsal 100 TL maliyet üzerinden yıllık yaklaşık 273 milyar TL kaynağa ihtiyaç duyuluyor. Bu tutar, Milli Savunma Bakanlığının 2026 bütçesinin yaklaşık üçte birine karşılık geliyor.



















"Tüm öğrencilere bir öğün yemek vermenin maliyeti MEB bütçesinin yüzde 13'ü"




4 Kasım 2025













(HA)

author: Izzy Knowles
title: Don’t Let Barbie Out of the Glovebox – An OCD Account
content:
W

hen I was in fifth grade, I convinced myself I was pregnant. I had never even kissed a boy. A slight stomachache after guzzling down my morning glass of milk became the beginning of early-onset morning sickness. A fleeting urge for bacon at a time that wasn’t breakfast suddenly meant that I was experiencing a full-fledged pregnancy craving. I would look around the band room and stare at the other girls in my class, wishing so deeply I was them so I wouldn’t have to deal with this phantom baby.




The following summer, I was certain I had developed a powerful addiction to making my little sister’s Barbie doll, a foxy brunette called Nancy, do back walkovers. During a sixteen-hour road trip from Chicago to Vermont, I picked up Nancy and mindlessly began kicking her leg back over her head and onto my thigh. As I flipped her in circles over and over, I started to worry I would never be able to stop. I pictured a future bound to this motion alone, where the only escape would be a bedridden life with my hands permanently restrained to my sides. Terrified of the fate ahead of me, I cried and pleaded with my mother to hide the Barbie in the glovebox, out of sight.







By the end of sixth grade, I convinced myself that I was going blind (I couldn’t see in the dark), that my lung had collapsed (I realized I could breathe manually), that I was dying of cancer (I discovered a mole on my chest), and that I was passionately suicidal (I got too close to the edge of my father’s balcony). I slept with the lights on, went to the emergency room when I felt my breaths were too shallow, and spent every other night on a mattress in my mother’s room on the off chance I’d sleepwalk to the kitchen and stab myself in the heart.




Of course, none of these fears came true. My imagined due date rolled around with no contractions, I didn’t suffer from any Barbie-related withdrawals, and I learned to trust the doctors who told me I was healthy. But despite the high turnover rate of my neuroses, I lacked the essential concoction of insight and perspective to realize they would eventually fade.




For most of my life, I chalked up my intolerance for uncertainty as a symptom of being a “worrywort.” My parents seemed to tie my perpetual doom to my capacity for empathy, telling me that I “just cared too much.” My middle school therapist, an older woman who sat me down with a mound of clay and a mug of lemonade each session, labeled my disposition as “irrational.” Though I can’t quite disagree with them, my concerns were operating along an axis far more penetrating than worry alone.




By the time I was a seasoned high schooler, the themes of my fears had morphed from absurd to abhorrent. My wide-eyed childhood irrationality turned inward, shifting into existential questions aimed at navigating the liminal space between truth and delusion. I cycled through the more universal dilemmas: 

Is this all a simulation? Are dreams our reality? Is everything you see, everyone you love, merely a figment of your imagination?

 Each question would surge me into obsessive contemplation, driving a wedge between the life around me and the doubt that threatened to squash it.




Sometime in my sophomore year amidst a weed-induced existential rant with my best friend, a question of my 

own

 mortality crept out from the depths of my “what ifs.” 

Am I immortal?

 It was a fleeting idea that turned over in my brain one too many times—causing that deep sense of doom to slither out and turn a hypothetical into an actuality.




Later that night in the safety of my bathtub, I gave myself an ultimatum: to conquer this new reality before I got out of the tub. I leaned back, avoiding the faucet, and questions and doubts and guilt over my questions and doubts seemed to cloud over the colorful splotches behind my eyelids. The waterline moved up and down my thighs and I wondered how I would cope with seeing everyone I love die over and over again. I decided that if I was right, and my life never ended, I would put myself in a sort of anesthetized state—like Woody Allen did in the movie 

Sleeper

.




The next bout of fears shifted my focus from mortality to morality, casting doubt on the substance of my personhood. 

Are your morals authentic or manufactured? How can you trust your ethics if they are determined by a world that is simulated, synthetic, or nonexistent? Are you a sociopath? Are you a deviant?

 The urgency to internalize the weight of these questions escalated as they threatened to crumble the parts of myself I held most close. I knew I was a good person, in action. I had a big group of friends, a solid love life, an endless pit of empathy, and an unwavering drive to make my loved ones giggle. Still, I wasn’t convinced that the “good” parts of me were enough to make up for the darkness that could be lurking behind them.




In attempts to prepare for a life in case my fears were, in fact, true, I spent most nights planning for my latent demise. 

If you ever feel out of control, like hurting yourself or hurting someone else, drop everything and check yourself into a psych ward. If everyone you love turns against you, do everything you can to make amends… if that fails and you have no choice but to cut your life short, take comfort in your condemned fate with the knowledge that underneath it all, you mean well.

 I clung to reading, writing, and cooking for comfort as I ruminated over the probably impossible possibility of a horrifying timeline. In my final high school English class, a Shakespeare elective, a sliver of my anxiety was assuaged upon the realization that I could read Hamlet in the confines of a cell if it came to that. At least then, I wouldn’t be alone in my madness.




It was sometime soon after my prison delusion that I finally sought out an official explanation for my propensity to catastrophize (one with greater jurisdiction than merely a worried temperament or a Reddit speculation). In the spring before I started college, I met a psychiatrist who diagnosed me with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder. I sat across from her on a cold couch in a room covered in chevron-framed inspirational quotes as she listed off a series of resoundingly familiar statements. She was nodding enthusiastically with each affirmative, jotting down notes in a fancy turquoise binder. It was strange, seeing the test resting daintily on her lap, as if it wasn’t about to determine my neurological shortcomings.




“Concerns or disgust with bodily waste or secretions,” the psychiatrist said.




Besides the obvious ones?


“Um… never,” I responded unsteadily.




“Need to reread or rewrite a sentence, phrase, or passage until ‘just right’.”




I can’t finish reading a sentence until each letter moves along the perfectly horizontal imagined axis that extends to my periphery. If the letters run askew, I must blink five times.


“Current.”




“Fear might harm self.”




I avoided balconies all through middle school.


“Past.”




“Fear might harm others.”




10949253 search results for: does childhood bed-wetting mean I am a sociopath?


“Current.” I felt my cheeks burning up.




“Fear involving homosexuality.”




Turned out to just be denial.


“Past.”




“Need to touch, tap, or rub.”




I tap each side of the doorknob while entering and exiting any room, even this one.


“Current.”




The diagnosis itself was not much of a surprise, but the clarification that I fell into a subtype of the disorder that is often overlooked was more relieving than I could have hoped. In what is known colloquially as Pure OCD, a sufferer’s obsessions are abstract and ego-dystonic while their compulsions are invisible and ruminative. 

Pure

 stands for purely obsessional, meaning that the fabric of its diagnostic criteria shows up in thought and not in action. As opposed to scrubbing hands until they bleed or checking that the stove is off fifty-five times in a row, the compulsions of the Pure OCD sufferer are to think and think and think until they can breathe again.




I knew I never fit into the standard obsessive-compulsive mold, with my messy room, strong stomach, and penchant for spontaneity. I can stick my hand in an arm’s length of dirty dishwater without grimacing and leave the house with the door unlocked without a second thought. But inside my mind, every sentiment and every conviction is filed neatly into a system that allows me to keep my feet on the ground and not float miles and miles from it. I explained this to my psychiatrist after she deemed me purely obsessional, which prompted a reply more graceful than I could have expected: 

Your brain is as organized as their closets

.




It’s easy to cling to my diagnosis for comfort. In fact, externalizing obsessions the way you would an alien invasion or a metastasized tumor is a foundational part of OCD’s gold standard of treatment. One of my therapists even asked me to give my thoughts a name, a request that initially caught me off guard but ultimately led to months of discussion over a monstrous entity in my head we called Patricia. I created a narrative for Patricia, a woman who caught wind of my propensity to doubt, crawled into my brain, hooked onto all the wiring that made me weary, and bent it, over and over again. It was Patricia’s sole purpose to tinker with my mind—to solder happy memories into guilty ones, to tether love to fear and joy to shame, pain to merit and truth to lie. I was her puppet, her prisoner, her pawn, trapped in an invisible cage with a key she dangled just out of reach. Supposedly, hating Patricia was more productive than hating myself.




Yet in all honesty, the line that divided “me” from “it” only added fuel to the fire. I stopped obsessing over my obsessions and focused my attention on the legitimacy of my diagnosis. Was I to chalk up visceral intrusions or philosophical questions as mere symptoms of a supposed chemical imbalance? 

Where did the bounds of the self end and where did the nonself begin? Was I to forever inhabit the bleeding mess that lay between them?

 I’ve never been able to answer those questions. And recently, I’ve decided to stop trying to.




Since my diagnosis, I’ve ghosted two therapists and broken up with two more. I’m not proud of this, but I have begun to realize why I can’t help but run when the sessions begin to get serious. The standard “evidence-based” treatment for clients with OCD is called Exposure and Response Therapy (ERP). In it, the client is gradually exposed to their deepest and darkest fears, under the assumption that they will begin to tolerate distress without engaging in counterproductive behaviors. If someone is afraid of contamination, their therapist might take them to a park to touch a dirty slide. If someone is afraid of harm, their therapist might show them crime scene photos or have them hold a knife for the length of the session. I sought out ERP therapists for years because Google and the DSM told me to. Some of these therapists were helpful, particularly in solidifying the belief that my thoughts weren’t always to be trusted. However, I always left these sessions feeling worse than when I entered them. Maybe that is because I didn’t try hard enough or wait long enough or give up enough of my sanity to see it through.




It wasn’t until I found my current therapist that I was able to ease into the life my brain has carved out for me. My therapist does not practice ERP, but rather a fluid form of therapy built upon the belief that the radical acceptance of every distressing possibility within an OCD mind is more important than the eradication of one source of distress. For me, this radical acceptance has allowed me to linger peacefully in the purgatorial space between reverie and nightmare. While I am afraid of worst-case scenarios, on the other side of the bridge (or the rainbow or inside another chocolate in the box) are all of the other possibilities that may feel too good or too simple to trust. I have learned to lean into the bountiful possibilities just as much as the scary ones.




I can’t remember a time when my thoughts weren’t whirring constantly and catastrophically. Sure, a diagnosis provided me with a reason and medication quieted them just a little. It’s easy to patch on a clinical bandaid over gaps in ourselves, but diving headfirst into a narrative that seeks to suppress human turbulence under the guise of treatment has never felt right. We do not have to barricade our curiosities. We do not have to brand our idiosyncrasies. We do not have to scoop out our sensitivities and tame them. We can hold all of our mess and our aches and our doubts as we would a crying child who has seen too much. Rather than push it away for security, I welcome my pendulum-like mind, taking with me both the stress and the gratification that comes with uncertainty. I like to hope that in my dying breaths, I will be glad I lived a hundred lives more than just the one I can see and touch.




The post 

Don’t Let Barbie Out of the Glovebox – An OCD Account

 appeared first on 

Mad In America

.

author: Stelinsky
title: Οι θάνατοι στις φυλακές είναι κρατικές δολοφονίες (τοποθέτηση από τις έγκλειστες συντρόφισσες Μαριάννα Μανουρά και Δήμητρα Ζαραφέτα)
content:
Σε διάστημα τριών μηνών σημειώθηκαν δέκα θάνατοι κρατουμένων στις φυλακές του Αγίου Στεφάνου στην Πάτρα. Οι θάνατοι έλαβαν χώρα σε έναν χώρο εγκλεισμού με κοινό παρανομαστή τις σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη. Δέκα άνθρωποι που έχασαν τη ζωή τους πίσω από τα τείχη, εκεί όπου το κράτος έχει τον απόλυτο έλεγχο πάνω στη ζωή και την καθημερινότητα των κρατουμένων. Η πρόοδος στην υγεία όμως δεν αποτελεί για το κράτος προτεραιότητα, αλλά αντιμετωπίζεται ως προνόμιο, ως κομμάτι της καλής λειτουργίας της εκάστοτε φυλακής. Ο Άγιος Στέφανος, όπως και οι περισσότερες φυλακές, δεν αποτελεί εξαίρεση.

Η έλλειψη μόνιμων ιατρών είναι ο κανόνας, ενώ κατά το παρελθόν έχουν χρειαστεί ακόμα και ομάδες εθελοντών γιατρών, προκειμένου να παρέχεται έστω και υποτυπώδης περίθαλψη στους κρατούμενους. Την ίδια απάνθρωπη αυτή συνθήκη, την ίδια ανεπαρκή ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη, δυσχεραίνει συνεχόμενα ο αυξανόμενος υπερπληθυσμός. Στον Άγιο Στέφανο, μια φυλακή χωρητικότητας περίπου 340 με 370 ανθρώπων, κρατούνται σήμερα γύρω στους 700. Είναι 700 άτομα, τα οποία δεν αρκεί να τραφούν και να στεγαστούν, αλλά πρέπει και να εξεταστούν, να έχουν πρόσβαση σε αξιοπρεπή ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη, σε γιατρούς, νοσηλευτική φροντίδα, ψυχιατρική υποστήριξη και σε νοσοκομείο όταν αυτό απαιτείται. Αντ’ αυτού έρχονται αντιμέτωπα με την ανυπαρξία κάθε είδους πρόνοιας, την έλλειψη υποδομών και ιατρικής φροντίδας, μια συνθήκη που μετατρέπει την υγεία από αναφαίρετο δικαίωμα σε προνόμιο που χρήζει διεκδίκησης.

Και ενώ οι ελληνικές φυλακές δεν προσφέρουν ούτε τα βασικά, βρίσκονται τα τελευταία χρόνια σε μια συνθήκη ακραίου υπερπληθυσμού. Ενός υπερπληθυσμού, αποτέλεσμα της συνεχούς αυστηροποίησης του ποινικού και σωφρονιστικού κώδικα, με την πιθανότητα φυλάκισης να αυξάνεται και της αποφυλάκισης να μειώνεται. Η εικόνα αυτή επαναλαμβάνεται και στις γυναικείες φυλακές της Θήβας. Με αφορμή τον πρόσφατο θάνατο συγκρατούμενής μας τον Αύγουστο, ήρθαν ξανά στην επιφάνεια οι σοβαρές ελλείψεις στην ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη.

Στη Θήβα δεν υπάρχει μόνιμος παθολόγος, η κάλυψη των αναγκών πραγματοποιείται από γυναικολόγο. Γιατροί άλλων ειδικοτήτων επισκέπτονται τη φυλακή κάθε τρεις μήνες, γεγονός που τους δίνει τη δυνατότητα να εξετάζουν μόνο κάποιες ελάχιστες από τις εκατοντάδες που έχουν αιτηθεί επίσκεψη. Παράλληλα, δεν υπάρχει εφημερεύον γιατρός, ενώ απουσιάζει και οργανωμένη ψυχιατρική πτέρυγα. Το τεράστιο αυτό κενό καλύπτουν οι ίδιες οι κρατούμενες, που αναλαμβάνουν να υποστηρίξουν η μία την άλλη, να φροντίζουν τις άρρωστες συγκρατούμενές τους και να καλύπτουν, όσο μπορούν, τα κενά ενός συστήματος που όφειλε να τους παρέχει τα απαραίτητα για μία αξιοπρεπή διαβίωση. Η παραπάνω συνθήκη αντικατοπτρίζει τη θέση του κρατικού και κατασταλτικού μηχανισμού απέναντι στους χιλιάδες κρατούμενους και κρατούμενες. Θέση που δεν είναι άλλη από την απόλυτη απαξίωση και αδιαφορία.

Οι ανεπιθύμητοι, οι ασυμβίβαστες, οι μικροπαραβάτες, οι τοξικοεξαρτημένοι και οι μετανάστριες πετάγονται κυριολεκτικά στη χωματερή του σωφρονιστικού συστήματος. Ένας πληθυσμός που προέρχεται κατά κύριο λόγο από το πιο εξαθλιωμένο κομμάτι της κοινωνικής βάσης, αορατοποιείται, αφήνεται στην τύχη του και στοιβάζεται στις ασφυκτικά γεμάτες ελληνικές φυλακές. Άνθρωποι αποκλεισμένοι βρίσκονται πίσω από τα κάγκελα των φυλακών, χωρίς καμία στήριξη ή βοήθεια. Στο πρόσωπό τους ξεδιπλώνεται η κυβερνητική στρατηγική περί πάταξης εγκληματικότητας και ασφάλειας του πολίτη, την ίδια ώρα που εφοπλιστές, πολιτικοί, βιομήχανοι χρήζουν ποινικής ασυλίας, παραμένοντας στο απυρόβλητο. Ο ιδιοκτήτης και υπεύθυνος για τη δολοφονία των πέντε γυναικών εργαζομένων του εργοστασίου Βιολάντα, κ. Τζιωρτζιώτης, ο βουλευτής και πρώην υπουργός Μάκης Βορίδης για την εμπλοκή του στο σκάνδαλο του ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ, οι επιχειρηματίες Ντίλιαν, Μπίτζιος, Λαβράνος και Χάμου για την εμπλοκή τους στο σκάνδαλο των υποκλοπών, είναι μερικά από τα παραδείγματα που η αστική δικαιοσύνη γύρισε το βλέμμα της αλλού.

Προφανώς δεν περιμένουμε να βρούμε το δίκαιο στις δικαστικές αίθουσες, ούτε στοχεύουμε σε μια πιο αντικειμενική δικαιοσύνη. Είναι ξεκάθαρο εξάλλου πως ο θεσμός έχει δημιουργηθεί για να εξυπηρετεί κράτος και κεφάλαιο, για να διαιωνίζει την εκμετάλλευση και την καταπίεση, για να επιβάλλει την κρατική βία και τον έλεγχο. Η εναντίωσή μας στο δικαστικό και σωφρονιστικό σύστημα είναι αδιαμφισβήτητη.

Ξέρουμε όμως πως ως κρατούμενες αλλά και ως αναρχικές δεν θα μείνουμε με τα χέρια σταυρωμένα ενώ οι άνθρωποι στερούνται ακόμα και το βασικό δικαίωμα στην υγεία. Είναι χρέος μας να αγωνιστούμε και να διεκδικήσουμε αξιοπρεπείς συνθήκες κράτησης για όλους και όλες, χωρίς όμως να περιορίσουμε τον αγώνα αυτό στη διεκδίκηση καλύτερων συνθηκών κράτησης. Οι αγώνες μας στρέφονται ενάντια στον θεσμό του εγκλεισμού γενικά, με αδιαπραγμάτευτο πρόταγμα το γκρέμισμα κάθε φυλακής.

title: Spagna: morte di Maricarmen, verso lo sciopero generale dell’11 novembre
content:
In Spagna continua la mobilitazione per il diritto all’abitare. 




da 

Radio Blackout




Ieri sera è giunta la tragica notizia della morte di Maricarmen, la donna che a seguito dello sfratto a Madrid ha avuto complicazioni di salute ed era stata ricoverata. Questo evento ha scatenato un’ondata di proteste molto significative in Spagna e alla notizia della sua morte la prima reazione è stata quella di una donna uccisa dalla violenza di un sistema. In questo contesto si prepara lo sciopero generale dell’11 novembre. 




Questo scenario ha delle ripercussioni importanti anche sul piano della politica istituzionale: a partire dalle elezioni anticipate e dalla crisi di governo per Sanchez si apre una prospettiva di incertezza. A fare saltare il tavolo sono stati i voti che hanno bocciato i due decreti sulla casa, redatti proprio a seguito delle proteste. I voti che hanno determinato questo risultato sono stati quelli del Partito Popolare di estrema destra Vox e di Juntos, partito indipendentista catalano. 




Gli sviluppi di questo tornante avranno ricadute anche su un piano più generale in merito alla politica europea e al ruolo del governo spagnolo in questa fase di riarmo e guerra. 




Ne parliamo con Victor Serri, giornalista in Spagna e curatore dello spazio informativo “

Barcellona chiama Italia

“







Di seguito un audio di Aniello Lampo, compagno di base a Madrid, sempre a cura dell’informazione di 

Radio Blackout







Di seguito un testo di 

Cronache Ribelli

 in ricordo di Maricarmen 




Maricarmen Abascal è morta oggi, 7 ottobre 2026, nell’ospedale Gregorio Marañón di Madrid. Aveva 87 anni.




Dal 1956 viveva nella stessa casa, nel quartiere madrileno di Retiro. Aveva 17 anni quando suo padre aveva preso in affitto quell’appartamento. Lì aveva vissuto tutta la sua vita, li erano morti i suoi genitori, lì sarebbe voluta morire anche lei.




Ma non glielo hanno permesso.




La sua storia ormai la conosciamo tutti. Per decenni Maricarmen aveva abitato quella casa con un contratto di affitto a canone storico, pagando regolarmente. Nel 2018 l’edificio passò a un fondo d’investimento. In seguito la proprietà dell’appartamento è arrivata a Urbagestión, che alla fine di un lungo contenzioso legale le ha imposto un affitto pari a 1650 euro al mese, più di quanto percepiva con la sua pensione.




Per mesi i movimenti per il diritto alla casa, avvocati, amici hanno cercato di difenderla, portando la vicenda fino all’ONU, che aveva chiesto di bloccare lo sfratto.




Ma il 23 settembre arrivò il giorno dell’esecuzione. Maricarmen uscì su una barella, espulsa da casa sua come fosse una criminale.




Le immense proteste dei giorni successivi avevano cambiato tutto. Il 29 settembre Maricarmen aveva riacquisito la possibilità di tornare nella sua casa con un affitto compatibile col suo reddito.




Ma non ce l’ha fatta, è morta prima.




Di fatto sfrattandola l’hanno uccisa.




Perché quando una persona di 87 anni, con una disabilità, che ha pagato per settant’anni il proprio affitto, viene espulsa dalla casa nella quale ha trascorso tutta la sua vita per permettere alla proprietà di perseguire un profitto sproporzionato, siamo davanti a un omicidio.




Quante altre Maricarmen dovranno morire prima che si possa dire che la casa è un diritto?




Perché ciò non accada dobbiamo seguire le sue parole: “Luchad. Seguid luchando por lo que es vuestro”.




Lottiamo per ciò che è nostro, lottiamo per tutte le Maricarmen del mondo.

author: Equality Now
title: Domestic violence under the Taliban’s rule: Afghanistan failed Hasina and millions of women and girls
content:
8th October 2026










Domestic violence under the Taliban’s rule: Afghanistan failed Hasina and millions of women and girls
















11 min read



















News and Insights




End sexual violence




Africa


























































A young Afghan woman’s death exposes the devastating consequences of systemic violence




On Tuesday, 11th August 2026, Hasina, a 22-year-old Afghan woman, lost her life after approximately a year of severe domestic violence at the hands of members of her husband’s family. The unbearable, prolonged abuse she experienced eventually led her to take her own life after she saw no other way to escape the situation she had been forced to endure.




At first glance, Hasina’s death may appear simply as suicide. However, a closer look at what happened changes this perspective: Was that truly her only choice? In other words, if Hasina had any other way out of the prolonged physical and psychological abuse she had been continuously subjected to, would she have made the same decision? 




“I do not see Hasina’s death as simply a suicide,” says Jamil Bedil, Hasina’s uncle, who describes her death as “the tragic result of violence, oppression and a complete failure to protect her.”




In that sense, he sees Hasina’s death as “a killing caused by violence and oppression, even if the final act was carried out by her own hand.”




Afghan women have no safe way out of an abusive marriage




“Hasina had her whole life ahead of her. She was going to school and had dreams and ambitions, like millions of other Afghan girls. But when the Taliban took power and banned girls from secondary education, her future was taken away from her,” Bedil says. 




In February 2026, the Taliban’s De Facto Authorities (

DFA) 

issued the “

Criminal Procedure Regulation of the Courts

,”

 

which effectively legitimises certain forms of domestic violence, allowing husbands to physically punish their wives as long as the violence does not result in “broken bones or serious visible injuries.”




The regulation comes alongside other measures that make marriage and separation increasingly unequal for women. In May 2026, the Taliban’s de facto Ministry of Justice published 

Decree No. 18, the “Code on Judicial Separation of Spouses”

, regulating how marriages may be dissolved, without establishing a minimum age for marriage. 




In his 

report

 to the UN Human Rights Council on the situation of human rights in Afghanistan in July 2026, UN Special Rapporteur Richard Bennett noted that Decree No. 18 traps women in violent households by establishing “almost insurmountable barriers for women seeking separation, particularly those experiencing intimate partner or family violence.” 




Under such a decree, a woman who seeks separation to leave an abusive marriage faces mandatory arbitration and is denied separation if courts decide the abuse can be prevented through other means. These conditions, according to Bennett, “make it almost, if not entirely, impossible for women, especially those in abusive relationships, to obtain separation.”




The legal Advisor for South Asia at Equality Now, Michelle Shahid, believes that in the past five years, the Taliban have dismantled nearly every protection Afghan women had against violence, including violence inside the home. “Decree No. 12, issued earlier this year, criminalises severe beatings by a husband against his wife, but only where they cause a ‘fracture, wound or bruising on the body’, with a penalty of mere 15 days’ imprisonment”, she said. “A wife must prove her claim before an all-male court, accompanied by a male guardian who is often the very husband she is trying to escape. The Taliban have also closed women’s shelters. Practically, this means that Afghan women have almost no way out of abusive marriages”. Accordingly, psychological and sexual violence within marriages remain unaddressed. 




With these compounding gender-discriminatory regulations, married women (and girls) are left with almost no way out. Rather, the law itself has become another barrier to their ability to break the cycle of an abusive marriage.




For Hasina, these restrictions had devastating consequences. Like many other Afghan girls, she was pushed towards marriage, where she was subjected to constant domestic violence that may have left her

 

feeling that “death was her only way out”, according to her uncle. 




The patriarchal society is also part of the picture




Social pressure also plays a role, as divorce can be treated as a source of shame or dishonour, not only for the woman but for the whole family. Families may therefore pressure a daughter to remain in an abusive marriage rather than support her decision to leave. 




“Afghanistan is also a deeply patriarchal society in which women are often expected to tolerate abuse, violence and humiliation in silence to preserve a marriage,” Bedil adds. “The wider political situation made this even more difficult for Hasina. A woman escaping abuse, therefore, has far fewer realistic options and protections.”




“That is what makes her death so heartbreaking. It was not simply that she chose to die. It was the violence, social pressures, lack of protection and loss of freedom that had made her feel that living was no longer possible”, Bedil lamented.




Systemic oppression leaves Afghan women under severe mental health crisis




Hasina’s story cannot be separated from the wider conditions faced by many Afghan women and girls, who are experiencing serious mental health concerns. UN’s  

Afghanistan country profile 2024

 reports that 68% of respondents in a survey conducted in 2023 knew at least one woman or girl who had experienced anxiety or depression, while 8% knew at least one woman or girl who had attempted suicide since the Taliban takeover in 2021. Additionally, up to 80 % of people who died by suicide in Afghanistan in 2018 were women. 




The report primarily attributes the increase in suicide or suicidal ideation rates among Afghan women and girls to psychological distress due to restrictions on their rights and freedoms, in addition to domestic violence, absence of sufficient support for women survivors of abuse, and poverty as reasons for individual suicides. 




Another recent set of data released by the UN indicated that 7 in 10 women in Afghanistan describe their mental health as “bad” or “very bad”.




The question is therefore not only how Hasina died, but what made a young woman feel that death was her only way out.




“At such a young age, she had already gone through so much. She should have been studying, growing and preparing for a brighter future. Instead, she found herself in circumstances where, from her perspective, ending her life appeared to be the only escape”, says Hasina’s uncle, who believes that his niece was trapped and failed by everyone.




Five years of Taliban rule erases decades of progress for women and girls in Afghanistan




In the 20 years before the Taliban’s return to power, Afghanistan established a legal framework to advance gender equality, including the 2004 constitution which guaranteed equality between men and women, and the 

2009 law

 that criminalised several forms of violence against women and girls, including child marriage, rape and beating, among 22 other forms of violence. 




However, with the Taliban back

 in power in 2021, this progress has been completely erased. 

Over the last five years, the Taliban’s De Facto Authorities have issued over 100 decrees primarily restricting “nearly every aspect of women and girls’ lives”, according to Equality Now’s reflection on “

5 years of Taliban rule: Generations of progress erased for women and girls

”. By imposing limitations on education, freedoms, healthcare access, and other aspects of life, the Taliban’s measures are systematically erasing women from public life.

 




In July 2024, the de facto authorities issued the so-called law on promotion of virtue and prevention of vice (PVPV law), commonly known as the “

Morality Law

” which reinforced the systemic oppression of women and girls across Afghanistan. Under such a legal framework, women are required to cover their entire bodies and faces in public, and their voices are banned from being heard outside the home.  According to the 

European Union Agency for Asylum (EUAA)

, “the accumulation of the discriminatory measures introduced by the Taliban, which restrict the rights and freedoms of women and girls in Afghanistan, amounts to persecution”. 




Moreover, Afghanistan, under the Taliban’s rule, has violated its international obligations. In 2025,  the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW)

 

Committee

 referred to the situation in Afghanistan as “one of the most severe reversals of women’s human rights ever recorded.” 




“

As a brother to my sisters, who were banned from attending university and saw their dreams shattered while I could do nothing, and as an uncle to Hasina, who tragically felt she had no way out while I could do nothing to save her, I urge the international community to take stronger action,” says Bedil.




Hasina took her own life in August 2026, just days shy of the five-year mark of the Taliban’s takeover of Afghanistan. Her uncle believes that it is time for the international community to take serious action towards ending the Taliban’s systemic oppression of women and girls in Afghanistan.

title: Afghanistan, 25 Years Later: Journalist Emran Feroz on the Legacy of "America's Longest War"
content:
This week marks 25 years since the U.S.-led invasion of Afghanistan, the beginning of what would become the longest war in U.S. history. After installing a pro-Western government in Kabul in December 2001, U.S. and other 

NATO

 troops would remain in the country for the next two decades battling a stubborn insurgency — until a chaotic U.S. withdrawal in August 2021 that saw the Taliban return to power.




“During the 20 years of America’s longest war in Afghanistan, we could clearly see that failure was coming,” says journalist Emran Feroz, just back from a month of reporting in Afghanistan. He says the relative economic and political gains under the Western-backed government were undercut by widespread corruption and violence, particularly in rural Afghanistan. “You had torture prisons next to Burger King and 

KFC

 and Starbucks.”

title: Sparkasse und GLS kündigen (z.B.) ABC Dresden und Rote Hilfe: Debanking gegen linke, solidarische Strukturen durch langen Arm der US-Regierung?
content:
Dossier




„

Im November und Dezember 2025 wurden solidarischen Organisationen und Einzelpersonen Bankkonten gekündigt – ohne Begründung, teils fristlos. Diese Praxis heißt Debanking und bedeutet den Ausschluss aus grundlegenden Bankdienstleistungen. Betroffen sind Initiativen, die sich gegen Krieg, Repression und soziale Ausgrenzung einsetzen. Spenden werden blockiert, Strukturen handlungsunfähig gemacht, Existenzen unter Druck gesetzt. Dagegen hat sich ein Netzwerk aus Betroffenen und solidarischen Unterstützer:innen gegründet. Wir machen Debanking sichtbar, vernetzen uns und bauen politischen Druck auf!…“ 

Meldung von „Debanking stoppen“ vom Dezember 2025

 

 („Debanking stoppen“) des Bündnisses gegen Debanking („Debanking trifft solidarische Strukturen“) – siehe mehr Informationen zur Roten Hilfe, ABC Dresden, Folgen und Widerstand:







Konto bleibt: Rote Hilfe gewinnt auch das Hauptsacheverfahren gegen Sparkasse Göttingen beim Landgericht Göttingen 

 


„

Rote Hilfe gewinnt auch Hauptsacheverfahren gegen Sparkasse Göttingen. Das Landgericht Göttingen hat die Kündigung des Kontos für unwirksam erklärt. Ein wichtiger Erfolg gegen politisch motiviertes Debanking und für die Solidaritätsarbeit der Roten Hilfe. (…) Ein zusätzliches Risiko durch die US-Listung der sogenannten „Antifa Ost“ als Terrororganisation  konnte die Sparkasse nicht plausibel machen. Das OLG stellte zudem klar, dass die Rote Hilfe nicht eine Organisation „Antifa Ost“ finanziert, sondern gemäß ihrer Satzung Beschuldigte und Angeklagte in den entsprechenden Verfahren unterstützt. Die US-Einstufung selbst entfaltet keine unmittelbare rechtliche Wirkung in Deutschland. Dieser Beurteilung des OLG schloss sich das Landgericht heute »vollumfänglich« an.


Damit hat die Rote Hilfe nach den Erfolgen im Eilverfahren nun auch in der Hauptsache Recht bekommen. Für die Rote Hilfe geht es über den eigenen Fall hinaus auch um die Frage, wie weit politische Entscheidungen und Sanktionslisten aus Drittstaaten auf zivilgesellschaftliche Strukturen in Deutschland durchschlagen können

…“ 

Pressemitteilung vom 08.10.2026

 

 („Konto bleibt: Rote Hilfe gewinnt Hauptsacheverfahren“)




OLG Braunschweig hat die Berufung der Sparkasse Göttingen zum Konto von Rote Hilfe (und damit willkürliche Kontenkündigungen) zurückgewiesen 







OLG: Sparkasse Göttingen muss Konto der Roten Hilfe fortführen

„

Das OLG Braunschweig hat die Berufung der Sparkasse Göttingen zurückgewiesen: Das Konto der Rote Hilfe e.V. muss vorerst weitergeführt werden. Für die angeführten Verdachtsmomente sah das Gericht keine ausreichende Tatsachengrundlage. Für die Rote Hilfe e.V. ist das ein wichtiges Signal gegen Debanking und gegen politischen Druck auf zivilgesellschaftliche Strukturen

. 

(…)


Die Sparkasse hatte das Konto am 9. Dezember 2025 gekündigt und stützte sich dabei unter anderem auf Spendenaufrufe des Vereins mit den Verwendungszwecken „unverzagt“ und „Budapest“. Daraus leitete sie gesteigerte Prüfpflichten nach dem Geldwäschegesetz ab, die das Konto für sie unwirtschaftlich gemacht hätten.


Das Gericht hat den Verdacht als unbegründet bewertet. Er habe einer Tatsachengrundlage entbehrt. Die Sparkasse habe die Spendenaufrufe inhaltlich falsch wiedergegeben. Der Verein habe nicht zur „Unterstützung der Antifa-Ost“ aufgerufen, sondern zur „Unterstützung im Antifa-Ost-Verfahren“ und „gegen die Auslieferung und Unterstützung verfolgter Antifas in Ungarn“. Das entspreche dem satzungsgemäßen Zweck des Vereins, Beschuldigten und Angeklagten faire Verfahren zu ermöglichen. Auch eine Verschleierung sah das Gericht nicht. Kurze, prägnante Verwendungszwecke seien bei rund 2.300 Zahlungseingängen nachvollziehbar, um Spenden einzelnen Kampagnen zuordnen zu können, und der Verein habe diese Zuordnung offen vorgenommen. Dass andere Banken dem Verein nach der Kündigung kein Konto eröffnet haben, belege den Verdacht ebenfalls nicht, zumal die Gründe dafür nicht bekannt seien.


Auch die Eilbedürftigkeit hat das Gericht bestätigt. Der Anspruch des Vereins auf Fortführung des Kontos sei weitgehend eindeutig. Würde man den Verein auf das Hauptsacheverfahren verweisen, müsste er zunächst das Konto wechseln und im Erfolgsfall wieder zurückwechseln. Dieser doppelte Aufwand wäre angesichts der Vielzahl von Zahlungseingängen und Mitgliedern so erheblich, dass er faktisch einer Verweigerung von Rechtsschutz gleichkäme. Die Interessen der Sparkasse müssten demgegenüber zurücktreten

…“ 

Pressemitteilung vom 17.09.2026

 




Oberlandesgericht entscheidet: Sparkasse Göttingen muss Konto der Roten Hilfe einstweilen fortführen




„… „

Die Rote Hilfe hat sich nichts zuschulden kommen lassen. Die Kündigung des Kontos hat zu großer Verunsicherung bei zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen geführt. Mit seinem Beschluss schafft das Oberlandesgericht Braunschweig Rechtssicherheit, auch wenn das Verfahren nur vorläufig ist. Kontenkündigungen durch Sparkassen sind unzulässig, wenn keine überzeugenden Gründe bestehen, dass Gesetzesverstöße begangen wurden. Damit setzt das Gericht willkürlichen Kontenkündigungen eine klare Grenze

.“…“ 

Pressemitteilung vom 17. September 2026 von Rechtsanwalt Dr. Jasper Prigge

 

 , der die Rote Hilfe e. V. im Verfahren vertreten hat




Siehe die Vorgeschichte hier weiter unten










Debanking: Der lange Schatten von Donald Trump – und wie Betroffene sich wehren können 

„

Deutsche Banken kündigen vermehrt linken Vereinen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen die Konten. Wir zeigen warum – und wie Betroffene sich wehren können. (…)


Wir 

veröffentlichen Verfahrensunterlagen

 

, die nahelegen: Die Welle an Kontokündigungen hat vermutlich mit US-Präsident Donald Trump zu tun. Und auch mit der Bankenaufsicht BaFin, die deutsche Banken kontrolliert. 




Die Dokumente stammen aus dem 

Verfahren des linken Rechtshilfevereins Rote Hilfe gegen die Sparkasse Göttingen

 

. Die Rote Hilfe hat sich Anfang 2026 

erfolgreich gegen die Kontokündigung der Sparkasse Göttingen gewehrt – vorerst

 

. In einem Eilverfahren erklärte das Landgericht die Kontokündigung für unrechtmäßig. Das Hauptverfahren steht noch aus.




Zudem haben wir mit Anwält*innen und betroffenen Organisationen gesprochen und veröffentlichen Empfehlungen, wie sich Vereine heute gut aufstellen können

…“ 

Beitrag von Jonas Seufert vom 3. September 2026 bei FragDenStaat

 




Sparkasse lehnt Kontoeröffnung für Bund der Antifaschistinnen und Antifaschisten (BdA) Treptow ab 




„

Trifft es eine, trifft es alle? Herausforderungen und Perspektiven von Debanking-Praktiken in Europa




„Kurz nachdem die US-Regierung „Antifa Ost“ als Terrororganisation eingestuft hatte, kündigten im Dezember 2025 mehrere Banken, darunter die GLS Bank, der Roten Hilfe, der DKP und dem Anarchist Black Cross Dresden die Konten. Dies löste in linken Kreisen eine Welle der Verständnislosigkeit aus, die sich in der rasche Bildung eines Netzwerks kristallisierte. Unter „Debanking-Stoppen“ bemüht sich die dezentrale Initiative seit einigen Wochen, den Handlungsspielraum auszuloten, der etwa den GLS-Genoss:innen bzw. Kund:innen zur Verfügung steht. Das Ziel ist ein doppeltes: Zum einen, die politisch motivierten Kündigungen rückgängig zu machen und zum anderen, die Weichen dafür zu stellen, dass sich solche Kündigungen in Zukunft nicht so leicht wiederholen. Dabei ist Debanking kein neues Phänomen, sondern hat Geschichte – und System: Schon lange vor der hier vermuteten Einflussnahme der Trump-Regierung wurde diese Praxis von zahlreichen Banken weltweit angewandt und traf sowohl Organisationen als auch private Kund:innen. (…) Besonders stark betroffen von Debanking sind bis heute Sexarbeiter:innen und Pornodarsteller:innen. Diese Branche gilt für viele Banken als „High Risk“ oder als reputationsschädigend. (…) Als Folge der verschärften Anti-Terrorfinanzierungsregeln nach 9/11 gerieten insbesondere muslimische Aktivist:innen sowie NGOs und Wohltätigkeitsorganisationen ins Visier: Konten wurden gekündigt, ohne dass ein Fehlverhalten vorlag. Die Kategorisierung als „Terrorfinanzierung“ ist für Banken oft schwer eindeutig zu bestimmen und führt zu vorsorglichen Kündigungen, die teilweise auf rassistischen Vorannahmen beruhen. (…) Das Ausmaß dieser Entwicklung zeigte sich besonders in Großbritannien: Nach der Ankündigung einer FATF-Überprüfung verloren zwischen 2015 und 2017 mehr als 300 Wohltätigkeitsorganisationen ihre Konten bei verschiedenen Banken. Eine davon war die gemeinwohlorientierte Co-operative Bank, die unter anderem der Palestine Solidarity Campaign (PSC) und damit verbundenen Organisationen die Konten kündigte. (…) Die möglichen Lösungsansätze, die im Fall der GLS Bank auch im Zusammenhang mit der Genossenschaft gesucht werden, sollen nicht aus dem Blick verlieren, dass das Problem ein weitaus größeres ist. Vielen ist durch die jetzige Situation erstmalig klar geworden, wie anfällig die Finanzinfrastruktur ist, da sie von profitorientierten Unternehmen kontrolliert wird, deren Sitz sich überwiegend in den Finanzzentren der USA und Europas befindet. Auch gilt zu bedenken, dass Banken nicht nur von autoritären Regierungen in den USA instrumentalisiert werden können, sondern auch von europäischen Staaten, insbesondere im Zuge autoritärer oder faschistischer Entwicklungen. Vor diesem Hintergrund sollten Diskussionen zum digitalen Euro auch im Lichte der beschriebenen Debanking-Praktiken geführt werden. Gerade in der Debatte um finanzielle Souveränität braucht es eine europäische Diskussion über Debanking und Solidarität auf EU-Ebene. Die aktuelle Diskussion räumt der Mobilisierung eines breiten Spektrums links engagierter Bürger:innen einen zentralen Platz ein. Doch auch das Debanking marginalisierter Gruppen darf nicht übersehen werden, etwa Geflüchteter, Migrant:innen oder Sexarbeiter:innen, die im öffentlichen Diskurs kaum wahrnehmbare Stimmen haben. Daran lässt sich die (politische) Macht der Banken besonders gut ablesen. Sie fungieren als Testfeld, an dem sichtbar wird, wie Ausschluss von Bankinfrastruktur konkret stattfindet – und worauf sich andere künftig einstellen müssen, denn: Trifft es eine, trifft es alle.“
