author: Joshua Carroll
title: Israel at Risk of Civil War and State Collapse, CIA Report Says
content:
A CIA report has said Israel is at risk of civil conflict and state collapse as its genocide in Gaza and attacks on Iran and Lebanon take their toll.







The unpublished August assessment, uncovered by 

Drop Site News

 and 

Capital & Empire

, found that Israel’s ongoing military campaigns have degraded the political, economic and social fabric of the country. 







Titled Fracture From Within, the report was compiled by the spy agency’s Red Cell, which is tasked with challenging prevailing assumptions within the organisation. The CIA did not respond to a request for comment from the outlets. 




It points to deepening anger over the exemption of Haredi men – often referred to as ultra-Orthodox – from military service, large numbers of heavily armed ex-soldiers returning from committing atrocities in Gaza and a cost-of-living crisis as factors that could converge into conflict. 




An intelligence source told the publications: “Famously the Freikorps of Germany were PTSD-addled veterans with weapons and bloodthirst. I’m not saying Israel post-Gaza is Germany post-WWI but there are certainly aspects of this that ring similar to me.”




A 

2018 rule change

 made it easier for ex-Israel Defense Forces soldiers to obtain and keep guns, and after 7 October 2023 the government allowed 

further mass expansion

 of firearm permits.




Ahead of elections on 27 October, the report also highlights political fractures within Israel, where prime minister Netanyahu is under fire for his failure to prevent the Hamas attacks – amid accusations that he was 

warned about them

 in advance. 




Netanyahu’s government was accused of triggering a constitutional crisis in July by openly refusing to comply with a supreme court ruling that allowed the country’s broadcasting regulator to continue operating. The government 

reportedly wanted to prevent the regulator

 from letting an anti-government critic purchase a major TV channel. 




A previous attempt by Netanyahu’s government to curb the supreme court’s power led to mass protests ahead of October 2023.  




The CIA’s report was written by “Israel experts,” an intelligence source said: “With the upcoming election and the fissures in Israel we should take seriously their conclusion that Israel is one spark away from real internal conflict.”




One scenario in the report involves Hamas or Hezbollah exploiting domestic weakness, while another mentioned tech companies pulling out of Israel, causing more economic strain.

title: Ein Strandkorb als Symbol des abgehobenen Politikers in seiner Komfortzone
content:
Politiker stolpern heutzutage eher über falsche Raumgestaltung oder über Tennisschläger als über Rentenkürzungspläne oder Krankenkassenreformen. * Untertanen ertragen es gar nicht, wenn sie von tatsächlichen oder vermeintlichen Witzfiguren oder gar Dilettanten beherrscht werden.

Natürlich betet ihnen die völlig freie Presse vor, wie sie die Dinge sehen sollen, Max Musterfrau ist leider sehr schnell davon zu überzeugen.

Fällt denn niemandem auf, dass derartige Stilkritik an Ministern deren Amt und deren Pläne immer äusserst gut aussehen lässt?

Wäre es nicht sinnvoller, einmal die Massnahmen selbst ernsthaft zu würdigen, als die mangelnde Würde deren Erfinder zu bemängeln?

Wäre es nicht notwendig, die „Reformen“ auf- und anzugreifen, als deren mangelnde Durchsetzung durch inkompetente Herrschaften anzuprangern?

Nur, weil Hans und Franziska die eigene Herrschaftsmannschaft mit Kreuzchen auf Zetteln selbst küren dürfen, müssen sie deren Vereinnahmung ins grosse „Wir“ doch nicht folgen!

title: Karasu: Democratization is for everyone
content:
KCK Executive Council member Mustafa Karasu discussed developments in Kurdistan, Turkey, and the Middle East during a special program on 

Medya Haber

.




Referring to the ongoing “Peace and Democratic Society” process, Karasu noted that the movement had taken the necessary steps, but that the Turkish state was still resisting. He said that a century-old problem such as the Kurdish issue could not be resolved through old laws, an outdated legal framework, or an old political approach.




Reminding that the existing laws had failed to resolve the issue, leading to decades of conflict, Karasu stressed that new laws guaranteeing freedom must be enacted in order to resolve the problem.




This is the first part of the interview.




Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan sent a message to the Peace and Democratic Integration conference held in London. A notable assessment in this message was that if the republic does not become democratic, democratic integration will not be realized either. How should this be understood?




Now, we speak of democratic integration and unification. The unification of two things: the unification of the Kurdish people with the state and with the Turkish people on a democratic basis. And what is this democratic basis? It will be based on the recognition of the fundamental, democratic rights of the Kurdish people. On one hand, it is integration, and on the other, it is democratic. Without democracy, there could be no integration. In this regard, local democracy is an absolute prerequisite. All obstacles facing the Kurds – regarding their language, culture, and identity – must be removed. Democratic integration is, in fact, the democratization of the republic. Contrary to what some claim – that democratic integration can be achieved without recognizing any of the Kurds’ rights, demands, or legal claims – such a thing does not exist. We do not seek this solely for the Kurds. Rêber Apo does not seek it solely for the Kurds either. We cannot demand democracy only for ourselves. To demand democratization is to demand it for everyone. Rêber Apo has made this clear. It is for the Alevis, for women, for workers, and for the environment. It’s not as if integration is just an agreement between the Kurds and the state. All communities will benefit from this. Democratic integration is necessary for all communities. It is necessary for Alevis as well. The Alevis’ freedom of belief and their democratic rights must be recognized. That is what democratic integration is. There is no such thing as a centralized, all-controlling integration – no such integration exists. Integration does not mean accepting the policies that the Turkish state has implemented up until now. That is not what Rêber Apo means by democratic integration. It is an integration for all oppressed ethnic and religious communities. All of them will be part of this democratization.




Democratization is not tied to certain individuals or a particular group. That is not how it should be understood. The democracy and democratization we understand apply to all communities. It is the democratization of the Republic; it is a democratic Turkey. This must be understood exactly this way. Any other interpretations are pure nonsense. There’s no need for demagoguery. This is a nonviolent solution. Because a nonviolent solution is necessary for Turkey, and it is necessary for us as well. It is not a solution involving the establishment of a separate nation-state. We have abandoned that idea. But democratic integration does not mean turning oneself in to the state; it certainly does not mean giving up the Kurds’ fundamental democratic rights. No one should misunderstand this. Nor does integration mean that someone will go somewhere, become a civil servant, or serve as a state official – democracy isn’t like that, and neither is integration. Integration is a contract with society. It is a compromise reached with society. It is the recognition of society’s fundamental rights. At its core, it is the recognition of local democracy. This is true for Turkey, as well as for Rojava and all other parts of Kurdistan.




Democratic integration is not about someone going somewhere, speaking on behalf of others, becoming a civil servant, or assuming government authority – that is not democratic integration. Do the rights of society not recognize democratic foundations? Is there local democracy? That is integration. Integration must be properly understood everywhere – in every part of Kurdistan. Any practices or approaches outside of this are not integration at all. What could they be? They could be the implementation of entirely old policies. They could be the continuation of policies of domination over the Kurds. In Rojava, we hear education in the mother tongue will be limited to three optional hours a week – could such a thing be possible? It cannot be. The Kurdish people do not accept it, and we fully support that stance. That stance must be maintained. No concessions should be made on that stance. Anyone who makes concessions on that stance will be held accountable – historically accountable. The people had more than ten years of education in their mother tongue – now they are supposed to give up Kurdish and switch to Arabic. Could such a thing be possible? Democratic integration, in general, really needs to be properly understood.




On this year’s August 10, the so-called ‘framework law’ was passed by the Grand National Assembly of Turkey. While the public expected the process to accelerate, it once again proceeded at a snail’s pace, much like previous instances. Many had pointed to the opening of parliament, and now with parliament in session, do you expect any progress or acceleration in the process? What is your forecast?




Serious developments should have followed the August 10 law. That was the expectation of the entire society. Up until the August 10 law, there had been discussion, negotiation, and evaluation. After August 10, it was time to move to implementation. However, even though two months have passed since August 10, there really hasn’t been much progress. We have done and continue to do our part. We have taken steps that no other movement or force has taken in places around the world where similar issues exist. The public is aware of this. We have taken steps and continue our approach. We have stated that we have ended the armed struggle against Turkey. We have fulfilled all the requirements of this. Now, no one in Turkey can claim that the PKK or the Kurdish freedom movement is a threat to them. We have taken every possible step to render such rhetoric meaningless. But all the steps have always remained unilateral.




What steps has the Turkish state taken? Aside from occasional meetings with the Rêber Apo, have any steps been taken? A commission was established in parliament, and it submitted a report. A law was passed. But all of these remained on paper. There have been no tangible results. We have done our part. We have taken every possible step to address the various threats they claim we pose. They can no longer make such statements. There is no longer any justification for failing to take action. But it’s not happening; there’s still foot-dragging. The parliament was supposed to pass freedom laws. How will this problem be resolved? Can progress be made with the old laws, the old legal system, and the old political mindset? Has a situation emerged that transcends the old legal framework and political mindset? After all, this problem arose precisely because of the old laws. Since the current laws have failed to resolve the issue, a decades-long climate of conflict has emerged. Now, the old laws won’t change, the old mindset won’t change, and the old way of thinking won’t change. How will this work? How will this problem be resolved?




Laws guaranteeing freedom must be enacted. Have laws enabling democratic politics been enacted? Are the conditions for free, democratic politics in place? Moreover, people are still being arrested. There are arrests targeting the opposition, and the trustees are still in place. How do they expect this to work out? In this regard, the parliament really needs to take action. And parliament is not just the ruling coalition between AKP and MHP. There are other parties as well. The Kurdish issue is a problem for all of Turkey; it is not the problem of any single party. The opposition is complaining and voicing grievances. Take a step toward resolving the Kurdish issue; fight for it. The opposition can’t just criticize the ruling party but not do anything by itself. If the ruling party isn’t taking the right approach, then the opposition should. It should push for the enactment of democratization laws. It should take on more responsibility. There is a lot of talk about democracy, but practice is needed.




They said that once the laws are passed, the Kurdish issue will be resolved through democratization. Well, then take steps toward resolving the Kurdish issue. Take a clear stance. Otherwise, there can be no democratization. An approach just questioning what AKP or the Kurdish freedom movement is doing is wrong. Aren’t the democratic forces, the freedom forces, the Kurdish people, the workers, and women all responsible for Turkey’s fundamental problem? Aren’t they all suffering because this problem remains unresolved? Doesn’t the suffering endured by women, workers, and everyone stem from the failure to resolve the Kurdish issue? Then everyone must take responsibility. Everyone must join this struggle. They must fight for the passage of laws promoting democratization and freedom. It’s not just about the government being this way or that way.




Sure, we are criticizing the government’s actions as well. We criticize their policies toward the opposition. Not only will such a major problem not be solved by this, but the majority of Turkish society will not be won over either. Securing public support is the most fundamental duty of those who want to solve the issue. The opposition’s approach naturally narrows the base of public support and creates doubts – these are certainly open to criticism, but shouldn’t they feel a sense of responsibility? The opposition must feel a sense of responsibility; the democratic forces must feel a sense of responsibility. In this regard, the law was passed, and after the law was passed, the state naturally had to take steps. A response was needed to the steps we took. It is said that they will lay down their arms and come – how could they not come? There is no law; will they come into this legal environment, or will they enter this political environment? Doesn’t this need to be changed? Shouldn’t there be encouraging approaches and laws emerging on this issue? But there is reticence on this matter.




Everyone knows what kind of world the Middle East is. In the Middle East, it’s impossible to predict what will happen or when. If the Turkish state – or the government – is playing such a game – whether it’s an election ploy, a tactical maneuver, or a stalling tactic – it truly means that no lessons have been learned from the past century. They want to continue using the same methods. There are truly misguided approaches on this issue. Yes, there is a process underway, and Rêber Apo wants to make progress. We, too, are doing our part to address the issues at hand, but honestly, the state is not doing what is necessary. Setting aside Northern Kurdistan, its approach toward Turkey and the other parts of Kurdistan is also incorrect. It still approaches those issues with that same Kurdish phobia. Instead of viewing the Kurds as a brotherly people and seeing relations with them as a way to strengthen itself, the state still adopts approaches focused on how to limit the Kurds’ rights here and there and how to prevent them from gaining rights. These attitudes, of course, must be abandoned.




The law has been passed, and there are high expectations. But no serious steps have been taken so far. What is the parliament doing, and what steps will it take? The parliament needs to take action. A parliamentary committee had prepared a report. That report contained an approach calling for many steps to be taken, along with an assessment. But many reports have been prepared in the past as well, and they came to nothing. Will that report now just sit on the shelf as well? The Turkish state needs to adopt an approach that demonstrates to the entire public that it is serious about this issue. The other day, the president said that if steps are taken, they would take them too. We have already taken steps. The steps we have taken have eliminated everything that would create conflict or problems with the Turkish state. We have taken steps that will encourage and facilitate further action. A more serious approach by the state is truly needed.




The committee formed under the auspices of parliament met a few days ago. It is reported that some work plans were drawn up at this meeting. How do you view the outcomes of this meeting?




Not only did they hold one meeting, they also had another meeting that took place afterward. It was said that the committees would begin working. But how does this committee work? Which committee has been working? We still haven’t seen any committee actually working. We haven’t seen any committee taking practical steps or working to advance the process. Where is the parliament’s monitoring mechanism? It’s still nowhere to be found. Most importantly, there was the Peace and Politicization Committee that Rêber Apo was supposed to coordinate. Why isn’t this committee working? What changes have occurred in the situation of Rêber Apo? Aside from some meetings being held, what changes are there? Moreover, promises were made during previous meetings. Rêber Apo would form a committee, carry out this work, meet with these people, and send others to join them. There’s a problem that needs to be solved. Who will solve it? Rêber Apo, the leader of the organization, as they also call him. Rêber Apo is responsible for this matter. He has taken the initiative. But while a role is expected of him, Rêber Apo is not being given the opportunity to act. Rêber Apo used to assess this during the 2012–2013 period by saying, “There’s an empty pool and they’re telling me to swim.” Rêber Apo needs to be able to take on his role. Without Rêber Apo taking on his role, who will do what? They need to recognize this movement. Without Rêber Apo taking on his role, this movement cannot take a single step. Rêber Apo is not enabled to be and work freely; he is not enabled to serve as the coordinator of the Peace and Politicization Committee; he is not enabled to meet with the press, intellectuals, or various political circles – yet this and that is expected of us. It doesn’t work that way. The approach to Rêber Apo must be correct. If they truly want this process to move forward and reach a conclusion, Rêber Apo must be able to play his role. The press and the public must hear the voice of Rêber Apo directly. Every day, someone speaks on behalf of Rêber Apo. That can’t be it. Rêber Apo must be able to address the Turkish people. He must be able to address the political forces in Turkey. He needs to be able to address the people, the press, and the world. Why did Rêber Apo take these steps? Why is Rêber Apo taking this initiative to continue this struggle, to continue this process? Rêber Apo needs to be able to make these things clear. He is our leader, but our meetings with him are limited. This needs to change.




The law was passed, and the law also stated that these committees would be formed. They met most recently, and these committees were formed. But where are they, and what work are they doing? What kind of work are they engaged in? This business cannot be conducted in such secrecy. Some things may not be made public, but their work must be transparent. The committees must operate openly. They must present to the public what they are doing and what they have accomplished. Rêber Apo must also present the work of his own committee. The parliamentary monitoring committee must present its work. There needs to be openness; there needs to be transparency. Otherwise, how will public support be gained? How will society offer its support? Or how will we believe in it? Things can’t be done behind closed doors like that. We want developments to be transparent. We want progress to be transparent. The main point is that the process needs to be followed and understood by the public. Rêber Apo’s situation needs to change. That’s for sure. We are talking about a serious problem – the Kurdish issue – a centuries-old problem. Rêber Apo is a party to this issue. As Kurdish people, we decided that Rêber Apo is our chief negotiator. The working conditions of our chief negotiator must change. They must change quickly. We’ve done what we set out to do. The meaning and value of what we’ve done must be recognized. If the meaning and value of the steps we’ve taken are truly not recognized, then what will we say? What will we do? How will we proceed? If the value of what we’ve done isn’t recognized, how will we assess it? That’s all I’m saying.

title: Students in Afrin and Aleppo demand a solution
content:
Although the new academic year began a couple of months ago, the situation of nearly 1,000 students studying in Autonomous Administration schools, as well as the teachers working in these schools, remains uncertain.




Dozens of students attending Autonomous Administration schools held a protest in Efrîn over the continued uncertainty surrounding their situation.




The students said they were being systematically excluded as students from Efrîn and Aleppo, stating that this exclusion ranged from being deprived of education to deficiencies in language instruction.




The statement said that students and teachers had not been included in the integration of social institutions or the education system, and called for steps to be taken as soon as possible.




It was stated that a transition process would be prepared within the framework of the Autonomous Administration’s curriculum for students in the ninth and twelfth grades. However, the statement noted that no action had been taken for the nearly 1,000 students in these two grade levels.




The students demanded that their requests be addressed within two weeks, saying that otherwise they would continue taking to the streets.

author: Unknown
title: Call for investigation into boards blocking women prisoners’ release
content:
A protest was held outside the Ministry of Justice in Ankara over the repeated blocking of the release of women prisoners held in Sincan Women’s Closed Prison. Protesters called for an investigation into the Administrative and Observation Boards responsible for postponing release decisions.




The protest, organized by the Federation of Legal Solidarity Associations for Prisoners’ and Convicts’ Families (TUHAD-FED), was attended by representatives of political parties and legal organizations, as well as many others.




At least nine women prisoners at Sincan Women’s Closed Prison are currently being prevented from being released, including women who have been imprisoned for more than 30 years.




Nedime Yaklav, who has been in prison for 34 years, has had her release postponed seven times. Hicran Binici, imprisoned for 33 years, and sisters Nuriye and Devrim Adet, who have been in prison for 32 years, have each had their releases postponed five times. Zeliha Ustabaş’s release has been blocked four times, while Fatma Aslan and Melike Göksu have each had their releases postponed three times. Emine Abiş, who has been imprisoned since 2021, has also had her release postponed three times.




Berfin Babaoğlu, secretary of the Prison Commission of the Ankara Branch of the Lawyers for Freedom Association (ÖHD), read out the statement and said the repeated postponement of women prisoners’ releases could no longer be regarded as isolated cases.




Babaoğlu said sentences imposed by courts could not be arbitrarily extended through the Administrative and Observation Boards, adding that assessing prisoners on the basis of their political identities, views and past positions amounted to “continued political punishment.”







‘Their releases are arbitrarily postponed’




Sihan Kaya, Ankara representative of TUHAD-FED, said the practice had become a serious problem, particularly for political prisoners.




Kaya said that since 2021, the Administrative and Observation Boards have postponed the release of many prisoners despite their eligibility for release. She called for an end to the practice and for prisoners whose releases have been blocked to be freed.




Kaya said at least nine women prisoners are currently facing barriers to their release, with some having had their releases postponed as many as seven times.




‘The practice has spread to other prisons’




Lawyer Fatma Sürücü, an executive of the Ankara Branch of the ÖHD, said the blocking of releases was not limited to Sincan Women’s Closed Prison but had also spread to other prisons.




Sürücü said the current practices effectively deprive prisoners of their right to release, adding that prisoners who meet the conditions for release are also not being freed.




Ministry must take action




Serhat Eren, Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) MP for Diyarbakır (Amed), said there was a “specific and systematic” practice of blocking releases at Sincan Women’s Closed Prison.




Eren said the Administrative and Observation Boards were acting in place of the judiciary by preventing releases and noted that postponement decisions exceeding one year had recently been issued.




He called on the Ministry of Justice to immediately launch an investigation into the Administrative and Observation Boards, adding that legal organizations and prisoners’ families would file criminal complaints if the ministry failed to take action.




The statement called for the release of prisoners who meet the conditions for release, an end to the Administrative and Observation Boards overriding court decisions and the repeated postponement of women prisoners’ releases, and for practices in prisons to be made transparent and subject to legal oversight.




The protest ended with the slogans “Jin, jiyan, azadî” (Woman, life, freedom), “Bijî berxwedana zindanan” (Long live the resistance in the prisons) and “Political prisoners are our honour.

author: Unknown
title: Soma’s deadly ‘fate’: 355 miners killed in 13 years
content:
Another mining accident occurred last Thursday in Soma, Manisa, a district known for the Soma Kömür Işletmeleri A.Ş. disaster in which 301 mine workers lost their lives 12 years ago. Workers had warned the company management about shortcomings in occupational health and safety, yet the accident occurred despite those warnings. This is why such preventable accidents are described as work-related killings. Companies seek to keep their profit margins as high as possible by failing to carry out regular maintenance or fully implement occupational health and safety measures, while facing no meaningful sanctions for these failures. Under such conditions, workers’ health and lives effectively become another cost to be cut.




In a feature article, 

Yeni Ya

ş

am

 underlined that figures covering mining accidents in Turkey since 2013 show that 70 percent of workers killed lost their lives as a result of mine collapses and crushing, poisoning or suffocation. Manisa ranked first in mining-related worker deaths, followed by Zonguldak. The largest number of deaths occurred in lignite and hard-coal mines, followed by marble, chromium and copper mines. The mining sector has expanded steadily since 2010 and is expected to grow further in the coming years, with the state preparing legal frameworks such as the so-called “Super Permit Law” to facilitate that expansion. Alongside the loss of workers’ lives, the sector has also caused ecological destruction. Workers have been killed in mines for years, while those who survive often struggle to receive their wages. Alongside the widely known struggle of Doruk Maden workers, it is estimated that more than 40 miners’ strikes have taken place since 2013.




Land grabs and ecological destruction by the mining and energy sectors




The 1.061 billion tonnes of mining waste produced annually in Turkey is physical evidence of an irreversible rupture in nature’s metabolism. This process of ecological destruction is intertwined with severe labour exploitation, while documented work-related deaths also reveal the human cost of the industry. The collapse of the heap-leach site at the Çöpler Gold Mine in İliç, Erzincan, on 13 February 2024, which killed nine workers, did not only claim the lives of those workers. Millions of cubic metres of cyanide-contaminated waste spread across the area, polluting approximately 300 decares of land. The toxic waste is believed to have reached the Euphrates River through the Çöpler Stream and from there spread into the wider river basin. This is only one example of such destruction. Hydraulic fracturing carried out for mining and oil exploration, exploratory drilling involving core sampling, and mining operations conducted without the consent or approval of local communities all contribute to deforestation. Such activities also dispossess villagers of their land, indirectly displacing rural populations and forcing them to migrate to major cities, where rapid urbanisation often pushes them into precarious employment.




The ecological destruction caused by mining operations is not confined to distant places, nor is it damage that can simply repair itself over time. Mining sectors in Turkey, Congo and similar countries operate in conditions where neither wage security nor occupational health and safety are guaranteed. The damage is not limited to cyanide and other toxic substances contaminating soil and air; it also affects mine workers’ bodies. Slow Death (Yavaş Ölüm), a documentary directed by İlkay Nişancı and presented by Aslı Odman, examines the deaths caused by thermal power plants in Elbistan over a period of 40 years, including the deadly effects of ash falling on residential areas. From this perspective, mining and other environmentally destructive activities do not cause ecological devastation only in the “outside world”; that destruction also takes place directly in the bodies of the workers whose labour sustains these industries. What miners spend during years underground extracting coal and other minerals is not only their physical strength and time, but also years of their lives. This, too, is regarded as a dimension of ecological destruction.




Soma: A graveyard for workers and a landscape of mines




The 

Report on the Struggle Against Extractivism,

 prepared by the Polen Ecology Collective and published in recent months, included data for Manisa compiled by the Health and Safety Labour Observatory (ISIG) covering the period from 2013 to 2025. The data documented the dates of work-related deaths in mines, the mining companies responsible and the types of minerals extracted. According to the figures, 350 workers lost their lives in work-related incidents in Manisa alone over the past 13 years. The collective’s report also documented numerous mining tenders, new mining projects and large-scale mining sites across Manisa, including in forested areas and near residential areas and nature parks, which it said posed the risk of extensive destruction. Updated figures put the number of workers killed in mining-related incidents in Manisa at 355. Imbat Mining operates close to the mine where 301 workers lost their lives in the Soma mine disaster on 13 May 2014. Since 2013, a total of 16 workers have been killed in work-related incidents at Imbat Mining, including those who died in the latest collapse.




Latest situation at Imbat Mining




The Manisa Governor’s Office announced this morning that the bodies of three more workers had been recovered from the collapsed section of the mine. The Governor’s Office said search and rescue operations had been completed. Five workers trapped beneath the collapse lost their lives, while one of the two workers rescued from the mine remains in hospital receiving treatment. Nine people, including the general manager of the company, were detained as part of the investigation launched into the collapse, which occurred on 1 October.

title: Özgür: Fund scandal is biggest fraud in Republic’s history
content:
Questions continue to surround the trillion-lira fund scandal that has shaken Turkey and left hundreds of thousands of citizens facing losses. The fact that the scandal has extended to the Justice and Development Party (AKP) ministers such as Fatma Betül Kaya, members of parliament and their family members has brought relations between the government and capital, as well as networks of economic power, under scrutiny.




The fraud unfolded in plain sight despite warnings from some economists and even direct applications to the Financial Crimes Investigation Board (MASAK) and the Capital Markets Board (SPK), including those made by former MASAK Deputy Chair Dr Ramazan Başak. The delayed investigation and failure to activate regulatory mechanisms have shifted attention beyond the companies involved to the system established by the AKP government, a government that has institutionalised fascism, suppressed the opposition through the judiciary, impoverished the public through its economic programmes, created a capitalist class from its supporters and reshaped oversight mechanisms around its own allies and policies.




The scandal has once again demonstrated the need to focus on the broader picture. Journalist Bahadır Özgür spoke to ANF about this broader picture through the fund scandal. Özgür stressed that the scandal was not a stock-market or financial crisis, but a mechanism of exploitation and wealth transfer produced by the conditions created by the government’s own economic policies. He described it as “the biggest fraud scheme in the history of the Republic, directly backed by political power and involving almost everyone within the government,” adding that fully exposing this mechanism would amount to the unravelling of the political regime itself.




How do you interpret the picture emerging from the fund scandal? Is this a financial scandal, or one of the crises arising from the relationship between the government and capital? Could it bring some of the power struggles within the government itself into the open?




First of all, this is not a financial crisis. It is a mechanism of exploitation and wealth transfer produced by the conditions created by the government’s economic policies. The foundations for fraud on this scale in the stock market were laid first by fuelling consumption through cheap credit, then by introducing the FX-protected deposit scheme to keep the exchange rate under control. As inflation surged, people were driven into the stock market in an effort to protect and increase the value of their savings.




There was a rush into the stock market, particularly after the pandemic. This was actively encouraged by the government. So to speak, companies with little more than a desk and a chair were taken public. This was accompanied by a massive media campaign, including on social media. Ultimately, the conditions for this fraud were created. There is, of course, also the issue of suspicious funds that we believe were channelled into the system through the stock market, although we do not yet know the full extent of this. That is the background to the fund scheme. Now, as to whether this was the product of a conflict within the government: a defining characteristic of this regime is that it consists not only of political parties but also of political and bureaucratic cliques and networks of interests. It is therefore less a coherent and stable structure than a contradictory one.




Another point needs to be underlined. The logic of the regime is not based on building political and economic power through institutions. It is built on families and blood ties. That is why we see family connections in almost every institution. The rent-seeking and wealth-transfer character of the economic system, combined with the contradictions within the political regime, brings tensions to the surface wherever vast amounts of wealth are at stake.




It is said that the AKP has distanced itself from some business circles it previously worked with and is now bringing different groups to the fore. What kind of economic and political realignment do you see behind this change?




I think the main reason was the government’s heavy defeat in the 2024 elections. The government realised that its propaganda apparatus was no longer working. It could no longer generate consent. The external economic and political environment had changed, and it therefore had to adapt. The networks of economic and social relations established domestically were no longer as consolidated as before. There was even a shift towards alternatives to the government. If you lose an election, you have to replace the parts of the machine that are no longer working.




From the inclusion in the case of contractors close to the government in connection with the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality (IBB) operation, to operations targeting celebrities, money-laundering networks and structures encompassing the media, such as Can Holding, I think these are all part of this need for change. Of course, these operations also involve overlapping conflicts between cliques and struggles over the division of property and wealth. I believe that underlying all of this is a new division of labour brought about by changing global and regional dynamics: new trade and energy routes, the massacre in Gaza, developments in Syria, steps taken on the Kurdish question, and the West’s increasingly hard-line and unified policies towards the Iran-Russia-China bloc.




Your articles focus particularly on the flow of money and the links between companies. These relationships show us what kind of system was established around the funds. Where does following the money lead us? How was it possible for such a vast structure to grow under the watch of the Capital Markets Board, the Financial Crimes Investigation Board, banks and other regulatory mechanisms? Should scrutiny focus solely on the companies, or on the regulatory mechanisms themselves?




First of all, the system built around these funds is not limited to the stock market. It has political, bureaucratic and commercial dimensions. It is a vast network for collecting and distributing resources. The regulatory mechanisms are part of it, as are powerful groups within the government. For that reason, it will never be fully exposed. I think fully exposing this system and the unravelling of the political regime are essentially the same thing. There has been no effective intervention by social opposition, and since that does not appear possible at this stage, it is impossible for every aspect of the fund scheme to be brought to light.




The timing of the investigation into the funds is also being debated. Can the fact that the investigation has now emerged on this scale be explained solely by legal and financial considerations, or are the shifting balances of power within the government also important to understanding what is happening? In short, are the economic power balances within the AKP changing?




They are constantly changing. Look at the periods from 2002 to 2007, 2007 to 2012, 2012 to 2016, 2016 to 2024, and now the period since 2024. Across all these periods, we see groups within the ruling bloc being purged and new alliances continually being formed. This is less a characteristic of the AKP itself than of the regime that has been constructed. The one constant is Recep Tayyip Erdoğan. Even someone from the family, his son-in-law Berat Albayrak, was pushed aside. He was also the only one to resign, and he delivered the harshest criticism as he did so. Süleyman Soylu was once described as “the most powerful figure” and “one of the architects of the regime”. His influence is now limited, and he is rarely seen in public. But that does not mean they cannot return. This is why I describe it as an organism. It tries pragmatically to adapt to whatever circumstances make necessary. Yet its capacity to do so is steadily diminishing. As a result, internal conflicts are becoming more frequent, more intense and more openly visible.




What do you see as the most critical question in this case: where the money went, how this structure was established, or who created the political and bureaucratic space that allowed it to take shape?




All of them. The fundamental question is who established and protected this mechanism and who shared the resources it generated. Because, once again, this needs to be emphasised: this is not a stock-market crisis. It is a vast mechanism of wealth transfer that was deliberately constructed. It is directly backed by political power, involves almost everyone within the government, and is the biggest fraud scheme in the history of the Republic.

title: Contro la leva militare. Lotta senza riserve
content:
Il ritorno della leva in Italia si inserisce in un quadro che vede l’incremento del numero dei militari come elemento cardine della politica di riarmo. In un contesto europeo di reintroduzione della leva (

vedi U.N. n. 16/2026

), anche l’Italia sta portando avanti un massiccio piano di rafforzamento dei contingenti militari nazionali che ha caratteristiche complesse, articolate e diffuse.




Dopo aver trascorso la primavera strizzando l’occhio al modello di reintroduzione della leva tedesco e a quello scandinavo, il ministro della difesa Crosetto ha virato verso una formula di leva camuffata che punta ad istituire un nutrito esercito di riservisti. Cerchiamo di procedere con ordine.




Nel corso dell’estate sono stati sfornati da Crosetto ben due disegni di legge.




L’8 giugno il ministro ha pubblicato uno schema di disegno di legge intitolato “Disposizioni per la costituzione di Forze di riserva in materia di personale militare nonché Delega al Governo per la revisione dello strumento militare”.




Il 4 agosto Crosetto ha depositato un ulteriore schema di disegno di legge intitolato “Disposizioni per il rafforzamento e l’adeguamento della capacità di difesa nazionale”.




Il primo DdL è quello più interessante per la questione reintroduzione della leva o provvedimenti analoghi. Si prevede sostanzialmente un poderoso incremento di reclute: 40.000 unità militari in più rispetto alle attuali, a cui va aggiunto un aumento di 2.600 carabinieri. L’incremento è da realizzare entro il 2033 ed è così scaglionato: 5.071 unità per l’anno 2028; 5.321 unità per l’anno 2029; 7.001 unità per l’anno 2030; 7.444 unità per l’anno 2031; 7.500 unità per l’anno 2032; 7.663 unità per l’anno 2033. L’andamento programmato dovrà ogni anno essere verificato in sede di legge di bilancio sulla base delle risorse disponibili.




Per realizzare l’obiettivo, oltre al rafforzamento della già attiva campagna di reclutamento (ricordiamo che dal gennaio 2026 è entrata in vigore la nuova tipologia di ferma volontaria, con retribuzione più alta e maggiori agevolazioni per i congedati che volessero accedere a impieghi nella pubblica amministrazione), viene introdotta una triplice forma di “riserva militare”.




Il disegno di legge prevede infatti la riserva operativa, la riserva specialistica e la riserva territoriale, contingenti richiamabili in qualsiasi momento. Per il periodo di addestramento periodico delle riserve (minimo 30 giorni annui) sono previste retribuzioni di 130 euro nette al giorno e un premio annuale di 1.300 euro per chi svolge tutti gli addestramenti previsti. L’addestramento è funzionale al richiamo alle armi, che potrà avvenire per qualsiasi necessità per cui il Governo ritenga di dover procedere. Inoltre, per tutta la durata del periodo effettivo di richiamo, “il datore di lavoro ha diritto a uno sgravio pari al 100% dei contributi previdenziali e assistenziali dovuti per il lavoratore assunto a tempo determinato in sostituzione del richiamato”.




La riserva operativa impiegherà, fino ai 45 anni di età, militari congedati da non più di 5 anni.




La riserva specialistica impiegherà, fino ai 55 anni di età, militari congedati che abbiano prestato servizio come ufficiali con particolari competenze professionali in campo medico, informatico, ingegneristico etc. Fin qui si tratta di militari congedati che, da “civili”, vengono richiamati alle armi e periodicamente addestrati.




La terza forma di riserva ha caratteristiche un po’ diverse. La riserva territoriale infatti impiegherà non ex congedati ma persone fino ai 35 anni che abbiano come unico requisito il diploma di scuola media inferiore (oggi insufficiente allo svolgimento di un qualsiasi lavoro nel settore pubblico, e non solo) e la partecipazione ad un periodo di ferma militare di 12 mesi.




Attenzione: considerando che la ferma volontaria annuale non c’è più, visto che è stata sostituita dalla ferma volontaria triennale (riforma in vigore dal 1° gennaio 2026), questa riserva territoriale ha un requisito – la ferma di 12 mesi – che somiglia in modo impressionante ad una leva militare. Quindi un servizio di leva introdotto come base per una riserva territoriale. Che sia il ministero a definire con propria decretazione le modalità di reclutamento, non sottoposte nemmeno all’iter istituzionale parlamentare, è assai poco rassicurante riguardo al carattere volontario del reclutamento, soprattutto se si pensa che in contesto europeo la formula di reintroduzione della leva prevede sì volontarietà, ma in caso di insufficienti numeri di volontari si procede con sorteggio fra tutta la popolazione della fascia di età definita. Insomma, una “volontarietà obbligatoria”.




Scopo della riserva territoriale è “generare un bacino di personale radicato sul territorio nazionale, rapidamente impiegabile a supporto delle esigenze funzionali delle Forze armate, incluso quello a supporto delle Forze di polizia, alla gestione delle emergenze e delle calamità, al soccorso e all’assistenza”. Le forme di impiego di queste risorse e il riferimento costante alla territorialità di appartenenza su base regionale rendono questo tipo di riserva sinistramente simile alla Guardia Nazionale, di cui vediamo l’impiego brutalmente repressivo negli Stati Uniti, anche in tempi recenti.




Ricapitolando: per formare la riserva operativa e specialistica avremo ex militari periodicamente riaddestrati e richiamati alle armi; per formare la riserva territoriale avremo “volontari” sottoposti ad una specifica ferma di 12 mesi e poi periodicamente addestrati. Cioè la leva. Visto che c’è l’obiettivo numerico dei 40.000, addirittura con uno scaglionamento annuo numericamente definito, se non si raggiungono gli obiettivi previsti la volontarietà salta e diventa un obbligo. Cioè la leva obbligatoria.




Che si chiami riserva non cambia la realtà della cosa.




L’incremento di 40.000 unità porterà in Italia ad avere, entro il 2033, un rapporto di 1 militare ogni 295 abitanti. Se pensiamo che in Germania l’incremento del personale militare porterà, entro lo stesso termine temporale, al rapporto di 1 militare ogni 320 abitanti, si deduce facilmente che l’Italia punta a raggiungere un numero di militari più elevato della Germania stessa (dati elaborati dall’Osservatorio contro la militarizzazione delle scuole e delle università).




Il sistema della riserva non è qualcosa di inatteso. Crosetto nelle sue dichiarazioni riguardo ad una reintroduzione della leva, ha sempre fatto riferimento alla riserva militare, elemento evidenziato, del resto anche negli interventi ufficiali del generale Portolano, capo di stato maggiore della Difesa. E già nel 2022 il governo Draghi, con la legge n.119, assegnava al Governo le deleghe per istituire tramite decreto una riserva militare di 10.000 unità entro il 2035. Le deleghe nel frattempo sono scadute, ma ci troviamo ora con uno schema di DdL che, sempre puntando all’istituzione di un corpo di riservisti, quadruplica l’obiettivo e ne anticipa i tempi di realizzazione: 40.000 unità entro il 2033. Il DdL di giugno per ora è in giacenza, non ha ancora avviato il proprio iter in attesa di verificare le coperture finanziarie necessarie ad avviare questa poderosa manovra di incremento del contingente militare, ma il quadro è chiaro.




Lo schema del secondo disegno di legge, quello del 4 agosto, è invece già stato approvato in Consiglio dei Ministri ed ha iniziato l’iter istituzionale in Senato. Nel quadro di un generale rafforzamento del sistema Difesa è prevista la creazione di un Vertice interforze con capacità decisionali più rapide e coordinate. Per “esigenze di sicurezza e di difesa energetica nazionale” (sic!) il Ministero della Difesa viene esonerato dalla Valutazione di Impatto Ambientale (VIA) sui territori interessati.




Viene istituito il “Fondo per gli investimenti nella ricerca scientifica e tecnologica militare”, con un finanziamento pubblico che solo per il 2027 prevede una base di 10 milioni di euro per la costituzione del fondo, da alimentare ovviamente negli anni successivi. Vengono estese le tutele giuridiche per i militari impegnati all’estero; viene definito l’ambito giuridico di sistemi come i droni. Inoltre, sul piano economico e produttivo, il Ministero della Difesa potrà acquisire partecipazioni in società e imprese del settore della produzione bellica, stipulare contratti con privati anche senza procedere tramite bando, ma anche rafforzare i sistemi di relazione e scambio con altri stati per produzione e permuta di armamenti e per la realizzazione di infrastrutture militari.




C’è poi un’ampia sezione dedicata allo “Spazio cibernetico di interesse nazionale per la difesa dello Stato” (art.7). Lo spazio cibernetico è definito come “l’insieme delle infrastrutture informatiche, comprensivo di hardware, software, capacità, dati, connessioni fisiche e elettromagnetiche, dei sistemi cyber-fisici OT comprensivi di sistemi attuatori di processo, sensori, sistemi di controllo industriale (ICS), apparecchiature mobili dotate di connessione di rete, nonché dei punti di interconnessione, delle rappresentazioni digitali, delle relazioni fisiche, logiche e cognitive stabilite tra essi, entro il quale il Ministero della difesa opera per adempiere ai propri compiti istituzionali”.




L’ambito è quello del rafforzamento del sistema militare soprattutto di fronte alle cosiddette “minacce ibride”, quelle che agli strumenti e ai metodi di guerra convenzionali affiancano anche quelli meno convenzionali. Con un lessico dal suono sinistro, elaborato col gusto perverso del complotto apocalittico, si fa riferimento a questioni come, ad esempio, il controllo delle piattaforme per esigenze di difesa nazionale, la manipolazione dei processi decisionali, l’utilizzo della comunicazione e della propaganda al fine di alterare la percezione del pericolo esterno e di creare consenso attorno alle scelte belliche: elementi appunto utilizzati come armi nell’ambito prevalente della comunicazione e indirizzati su territori che sono le menti e i comportamenti. Si tratta di modalità di controllo ben note da tempo e ampiamente utilizzate, sia in guerra che in “pace”. Ovviamente i mezzi mutano col mutare delle tecnologie, che sono sempre più sofisticate e che, soprattutto sfruttando le capacità generative della IA, estendono le possibilità di azione e di falsificazione. Lo “spazio cibernetico” diventa così una sorta di territorio di interesse nazionale, su cui estendere il dominio militare.




E anche in questo ambito “cyber” scatta fuori l’elemento che ci riconduce alla leva, alle campagne di arruolamento e all’incremento, su base volontaria o obbligatoria, del numero dei militari.




Il disegno di legge infatti prevede l’istituzione di una nuova figura di soldato, il “cyber militare”, che al periodo di ferma iniziale (leva?) e dopo aver conseguito specifico brevetto, deve impegnarsi in una ferma quinquennale, rinnovabile per ulteriori 8 anni. Una carriera specifica su cui sicuramente si indirizzeranno le campagne di arruolamento, probabilmente destinate ad attirare un interesse largo e diffuso.




Solo per assicurare copertura finanziaria a quanto disposto dall’articolo 7 relativamente al dominio dello spazio cibernetico e all’istituzione della figura dello “specialista cyber militare” è stata prevista una spesa di quasi 50 miliardi nei prossimi 10 anni (1.186.096 subito a partire dal 2027).




A fronte di questo quadro generale, è evidente che l’opposizione alla sempre più dilagante militarizzazione deve crescere ed estendersi ancora.




Il Ministero della Difesa punta ad un poderoso potenziamento di risorse: mezzi, strumenti, ma anche e soprattutto persone: da arruolare per aumentare gli organici effettivi e da coinvolgere a vario livello nella macchina militare secondo la nozione di “difesa totale permanente”.




La reintroduzione della leva, anche attraverso l’istituzione dei contingenti di riserva militare, comporterà un aumento della già insopportabile propaganda militare nelle scuole, che andrà contrastata, con un intervento ancora più fermo e serrato di quanto finora sia stato fatto, per impedire che le campagne di arruolamento abbiano successo.




La questione della leva si rivela sempre più un elemento cruciale per opporsi alle logiche di guerra, di colonialismo e di sfruttamento. Non può esserci spazio per approcci concertativi.




Per dirla più chiaramente: una obiezione di coscienza apertamente richiesta come complementare al servizio militare (come nel caso della legge di iniziativa popolare presentata nell’ambito della campagna “Un’altra difesa è possibile”, 

vedi UN.n.16/2026

), funzionale ad assolvere al compito di “difesa della patria” con modalità che non prevedano l’uso di armi, è solo un modo per consolidare la macchina bellica inserendosi a pieno titolo in quel sistema di “difesa totale” che prevede il coinvolgimento, con ruoli diversificati, di ciascuna componente della società. Analogamente, l’istituzione presso i Comuni, di liste ufficiali di persone in fascia anagrafica di leva o richiamabile che si dichiarano indisponibili al servizio militare e manifestano obiezione al servizio militare è inutile se non dannosa, esponendo pubblicamente nominativi individuali e favorendo la deduzione che chi non esplicita pubblicamente opposizione sia da annoverare fra i disponibili.




Contrastiamo i piani di reintroduzione della leva in modo chiaro, radicale e di massa.




Facciamo crescere l’opposizione al militarismo, alla guerra, alla retorica patriottica, alla guerra!




Non mettiamo i nostri corpi e quelli delle giovani generazioni a disposizione dei massacratori dell’umanità, di chi distrugge le risorse dell’ambiente, di chi propaga morte e distruzione.




No alla reintroduzione della leva in qualunque forma essa si presenti. 




Patrizia Nesti

title: Évènement pour un internet militant et autonome #3
content:
Suite à 2 évènements réussis le 12 septembre à la Kunda et le 27 septembre à la générale, le collectif pour un internet militant et autonome organise un troisième événement dimanche à la Kunda à partir de 16h pour rassembler, réfléchir et s'organiser vis-à-vis des technologies informatiques d'un point de vue autonome




Samedi 12 septembre, une cinquantaine de personnes se sont réunies à l'appel d'un collectif pour un internet militant et autonome. Autistici/Inventati, fournisseur de service camarade basé en Italie, venait d'annoncer sa fermeture définitive suite à sa désignation comme organisation terroriste par les États-Unis.




Les discussions fructueuses et la joie de se rassembler ont incité à réitérer l'expérience autour d'un deuxième évènement deux semaines plus tard à la Générale. Réunissant de nouveau une cinquantaine de personnes, les débats et les volontés se sont fait plus précises et ont permis de dégager plusieurs directions pour la suite :


Une volonté de transmission des savoirs techniques pour rendre les conversations plus compréhensibles, et deux axes de discussion (pour l'instant).




Nous avons donc décidé d'organiser pour la troisième fois un évènement y répondant.




Au programme :




 16h : formation technique au numérique

 17h30 : discussions


 1) S'organiser pour mettre en place des services

 2) Identifier nos besoins

 19h : cantine

 20h : projection/discussion

 23h : fin de l'évènement




Infokiosque et sérigraphie tout le long




N'hésitez pas à venir si le sujet vous intéresse, que vous soyez venu-e ou non aux évènements précédents. N'hésitez pas non plus à venir avec vos propositions

 

!




Retrouvons-nous à la Kunda, 46 Jules Lagaisse 94400 Vitry-sur-Seine, le dimanche 11 octobre à partir de 16h

author: Anonym
title: In Solidarität mit Daniel Viehmann, Strom-Saboteur
content:
DANKE DANIEL




Ein paar Wochen sind vergangen, seit Öko-Saboteur Daniel bundesweit Angriffe auf das Deutsche Stromnetz durchgeführt hat. Dafür hat er selbst gebaute Raketen über Hochspannungsleitungen geschossen, eine Methode, die er selbst erfunden hat. Bei einem der Angriffe in NRW gingen infolge 5 Kraftwerksblöcke (Braunkohle) für mehrerere Tage vom Netz. Es folgte viel Medienaufmerksamkeit und nach einer bundesweiten Fahndung, wurde Daniel festgenommen. Aktuell sitzt Daniel in U-Haft und es drohen ihm bis zu 10 Jahre Knast.




SEINE WORTE




Bis jetzt, haben wir wenig – oder gar keine – öffentliche Solidarität mit Daniel gesehen. Wir fragen uns was hinter dem Schweigen steckt. Für uns gibt es keinen Grund zur Stille oder gar zur Distanzierung. Mit diesem Text wollen wir dieses Schweigen brechen und zeigen das es viele Gründe gibt anzunehmen, dass Daniels Kampf gleichermaßen auch unser Kampf ist.


Die stärkste Begründung für unsere Solidarität steckt in Daniels eigenen Worten. Aus seinen Bekennerschreiben gelangen zuerst nur wenige Sätze an die Öffentlichkeit. Die veröffentlichte erste Seite gibt mehr Aufschluss über Daniels Motivationen. Hier veröffentlichen wir diese Seite (siehe Foto) und rufen dazu auf, wer Zugang zu den fehlenden Seiten seiner Bekennerschreiben hat: Gebt Daniels Worte an die Öffentlichkeit, so dass Daniel für sich selbst sprechen kann.


Was die Presse nicht berichtete, er aber selbst als Gründe für sein Handeln beschreibt: seine Aktionen wendeten sich nicht nur gegen eine fossile Stromerzeugung sondern auch gegen die deutsche Rüstungsindustrie und vor allem deren Teilhabe am Völkermord in Palästina.




EINE ADÄQUATE ANTWORT AUF DIE FOSSILE REALITÄT




„Stromerzeugung aus fossilen Brennstoffen ist ein Verbrechen, das unsägliches Leid nach sich zieht.“




Das ist kein komplizierter Zusammenhang, nichts was nicht lange wissenschaftlich verstanden ist. Die fossile Energieerzeugung ist einer der Hauptverursacher des globalen Klimawandels – all das ist einfach zu verstehen. Genauso einfach ist es, dass um aus dem Kreislauf des Leids aus zusteigen, der Ursprung dessen zerstört werden muss. Genauso logisch ist aus unserer Sicht Daniels Reaktion.


Er hatte also gute Gründe zu tun, was getan werden muss(te). So muss auch die Klimabewegung die Tatsache anerkennen, dass CO2 Emissionen weiterhin Jahr für Jahr signifikant steigen. Nach vielen Jahren weitreichendem bürgerlichen Protest und des zivilen Ungehorsam wird klar, es ist keine realistische Lösung für das Problem. Es ist also eine logische Konsequenz für die Klimabewegung Akte der Sabotage im Kampf einzusetzen.




DIE BEWEGUNG SCHWEIGT




Viele Menschen (auch Gefährt*innen) behaupten Daniel wäre entweder verrückt oder sicherlich einer von Putins Agenten. Auch sei es unlogisch, dass er seinen Namen und Adresse veröffentlicht hat. Jede dieser Argumentation befreit uns von der Pflicht (oder Chance) seine Aktionen ernst zu nehmen. Ist es nicht das was Daniel versuchte umzusetzen genau eine heimliche Sehnsucht die in vielen von uns steckt?




UND DER STAAT WILL KRITISCHE INFRASTRUKTUR BESSER SCHÜTZEN




In Folge Daniels Aktionen stellt Staat und Presse die sogenannte kritische Infrastruktur als stark-gefährdet dar. Es werden Zählungen Sabotage-Verdachtsfällen veröffentlicht, neben Daniel ein Datenleak in Berlin, und russische Drohnenangriffe am Leipziger Flughafen. Auch soll im Zuge des im März in Kraft getretenen KRITIS Dachgesetz vermehrt KI-Überwachung der sogenannten kritischen Infrastrukur (kritsch für wen und für was?) umgesetzt werden.


Unabhängig davon wie gefährdet die sogenannte kritische Infrastruktur wirklich ist, drückt die dargestellte mediale Brisanz rund um Daniels Aktionen auch die Wirksamkeit derer aus. Gesteigerte Überwachung und Repression zeigt Un-Sicherheit & Schwachstellen des Staates. Und so denken wir, wenn die eine Aktion nicht dem Trugschluss verfällt über Forderungen an die Regierenden Zustände verändern zu wollen muss vermehrte Repression erwartet werden. Alles andere hätte keinen ausschlaggebenden Effekt auf den Status Quo. So erschreckend die Unsicherheit für manche auch klingen mag, so sehr glauben wir dass sie nötig ist um tatsächlich die Zerstörung dieser industriellen Zivilisation zu stoppen.




WAS WÄRE ALSO WENN DANIELS AKTION ZÄHLT?




Wichtiger als die ‚Macht‘ die man tatsächlich hat, ist die Macht die unsere Gegner glauben das wir sie haben. Wenn also der deutsche Staat von Unsicherheit seiner kritischen Infrastruktur spricht nachdem Daniel getan hat was er tun musste, so denken wir ist er einen richtigen und wichtigen Schritt gegangen, der uns Mut gibt für alle weiteren Schritte.


Es werden weitere Schritte zu gehen sein, bis erkannt wird, der einzige Weg kritische Infrastruktur zu schützen ist, Infrastrukturen zu etablieren die nicht auf Ausbeutung und Zerstörung der Biosphäre basieren – so gäbe es keinen Grund zu Sabotage.




Wir sind dankbar für Daniels Mut und alles Leid, dass er hin nimmt bei der Repression die ihm jetzt droht. Wir stehen Solidarisch hinter Daniel, zünden ihm Kerzen, ein Licht aus der Ferne.


Er schreibt, er hat es allein getan, ohne fremde Hilfe, niemandem davon erzählt. Doch da draußen ist er nicht allein, wir sind viele die an anderer Stelle (mit ihm) gegen dasselbe Leid kämpfen. Und uns geben Daniels Taten Mut nicht aufzugeben.




P.S.: Eins wollen wir unbedingt klar stellen, dies ist kein Versuch für Daniel zu sprechen. Wir wissen nicht ob Daniel unserem Statement zustimmt oder nicht. Wir sprechen für uns selbst und zu euch, ihr die ihr auch gegen den Klimawandel, die Militarisierung und den Autoritarismus im Allgemeinen kämpft. Wir beführworten alle Bemühungen Kontakt mit Daniel herzustellen und damit ihm eine Kommunikation zur Außen-Welt zu ermöglichen – falls Daniel dies auch in Daniels Interesse ist.




Solidarität mit Daniel, Solidarität mit allen Öko-Saboteur*innen!

title: Συγκεντρώσεις αλληλεγγύης στον παλαιστινιακό λαό, την Τετάρτη 7/10
content:
Την Τρίτη 7/10 συμπληρώνονται τρία χρόνια απο την έναρξη της αιματηρής γενοκτονίας του παλαιστινιακού λαού από το κράτος – δολοφόνο Ισραήλ και τη συμμαχία του με τις  ΗΠΑ και το ΝΑΤΟ. Πάνω απο 75.000 νεκρούς παλαιστίνιους των οποίων το 1/3 αποτελούν παιδιά μετράει η γενοκτονία η οποία 3 χρόνια μετά βρίσκεται ακόμα σε εξέλιξη και το Ισραήλ και οι ΗΠΑ συνεχίζουν την προσπάθεια καθολικής επίθεσης στις χώρες της Μέσης Ανατολής. Την ίδια μέρα, σωματεία, οργανώσεις και συλλογικότητες καλούν σε συγκεντρώσεις αλληλεγγύης στον παλαιστινιακό λαό, σε διάφορα σημεία της χώρας, διαδηλώνοντας ενάντια στην γενοκτονία και κατοχή της Γάζας από το κράτος – δολοφόνο Ισραήλ αλλά και στη πιστή συμμετοχή του ελληνικού κράτους σε αυτήν.

Αθήνα, στις 18.00, στο Πάρκο Ελευθερίας




Θεσσαλονίκη, στις 19.00, στο Άγαλμα Βενιζέλου




Καρδίτσα, στις 19.00, στη κεντρική πλατεία




Ηράκλειο, στις 19.00, στη πλατέια Λιονταριών

Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης στον Παλαιστινιακό Λαό Εργατικών Σωματείων και Συλλογικοτήτων – 

Ένωση Παλαιστινίων Εργαζομένων Ελλάδας




Τρία χρόνια από την εισβολή στη Γάζα – Καμία συνενοχή | 7/10, 6μμ, πάρκο Ελευθερίας







Καμία σιωπή. Αλληλεγγύη στον Παλαιστινιακό λαό




Όλοι/όλες στη συγκέντρωση την Τετάρτη 7 Οκτώβρη 2026, ώρα 6μμ., στο πάρκο Ελευθερίας και στην πορεία προς τις Πρεσβείες ΗΠΑ και Ισραήλ




Η 

Πρωτοβουλία Αλληλεγγύης στον Παλαιστινιακό Λαό Εργατικών Σωματείων και Συλλογικοτήτων

74.900 νεκροί

 Παλαιστίνιοι -στη συντριπτική τους πλειονότητα γυναίκες και παιδιά- και περισσότεροι από 

174.000 τραυματίες

Γάζα

Δυτική Όχθη

ΗΠΑ

Με αμύθητα πακέτα στρατιωτικής βοήθειας, διαρκή αποστολή οπλικών συστημάτων και διπλωματική ασυλία, η Ουάσιγκτον και οι Βρυξέλλες νομιμοποιούν την εθνοκάθαρση στο όνομα της δήθεν «αυτοάμυνας» του Ισραήλ, εξυπηρετώντας τα δικά τους γεωστρατηγικά και οικονομικά συμφέροντα στη Μέση Ανατολή.




Η γενοκτονία του Παλαιστινιακού λαού έχει και τη σφραγίδα όπως έχει και τη σφραγίδα της

κυβέρνηση Μητσοτάκη

 υπέγραψε στο Τελ Αβίβ την απαράδεκτη διακρατική συμφωνία για την «

Ασπίδα του Αχιλλέα

», με προϋπολογισμό άνω των 

3 δισ.

 ευρώ (που σε βάθος χρόνου αναμένεται να φτάσουν τα 

5 δισ.

 ευρώ), με τη γιγαντιαία συμμετοχή ισραηλινών αμυντικών εταιρειών.

Λευτεριά στην Παλαιστίνη, λευτεριά στον Λίβανο.




Η 

7η Οκτωβρίου

 ήταν μια πράξη αντιαποικιακής και αντιιμπεριαλιστικής αντίστασης. Μια συνέχεια της αντίστασης που χρονολογείται από τη στιγμή της ίδρυσης του κράτους του “Ισραήλ” το 1948, αλλά και ακόμη νωρίτερα, κατά τη διάρκεια της βρετανικής αποικιακής κατοχής. Ήταν ένας λαός και ένα κίνημα που ξεσηκώθηκαν ενάντια στην κατοχή. Η ημέρα αυτή θα συνεχίσει να τιμάται ως τέτοια για τις επόμενες γενιές, ακόμη και αν οι σιωνιστές και οι ιμπεριαλιστές προσπαθήσουν με κάθε μέσο να ελέγξουν και να αλλάξουν το αφήγημα. Τα αλεξίπτωτα πλαγιάς που πετούσαν πάνω από τον φράχτη προς την κατεχόμενη Παλαιστίνη, ο φράχτης που περιέκλειε τη Γάζα και γκρεμίστηκε από τους ανθρώπους που εκδιώχθηκαν από τη γη τους πριν από δεκαετίες: αυτές οι εικόνες δεν θα ξεχαστούν και θα παραμείνουν στη μνήμη μας ως σύμβολα της αντίστασης του Παγκόσμιου Νότου.




Η απάντηση της σιωνιστικής οντότητας, με την υποστήριξη των ΗΠΑ, υπήρξε ανελέητη. Από τον Οκτώβριο του 2023 γινόμαστε μάρτυρες μιας γενοκτονίας που μεταδίδεται ζωντανά και πολλών φρικαλεοτήτων που διαπράττονται από τη σιωνιστική οντότητα και τους ιμπεριαλιστές των ΗΠΑ (με την υποστήριξη ευρωπαϊκών κρατών). Η Γάζα έχει ισοπεδωθεί από τους βομβαρδισμούς και, παρόλο που γίνεται λόγος για κατάπαυση του πυρός, συνεχίζουν να βομβαρδίζουν και να πυροβολούν αδιακρίτως. Ο Λίβανος και η Συρία τελούν υπό κατοχή και δέχονται συνεχείς επιθέσεις από τη σιωνιστική οντότητα. Οι κυβερνήσεις αυτών των περιοχών καταστέλλουν την αντίσταση και την εναντίωση στη Δύση και το “Ισραήλ” στα εδάφη τους, ενεργώντας ως εντολοδόχοι των ΗΠΑ. Όλα αυτά συμβαίνουν ενώ το “Ισραήλ” καταλαμβάνει όλο και περισσότερα εδάφη, αποσταθεροποιώντας περαιτέρω την περιοχή.




Το κράτος του “Ισραήλ” και οι ΗΠΑ καταστρέφουν ορισμένες από τις αρχαιότερες περιοχές με συνεχή κατοίκηση στην ιστορία του πολιτισμού, στην Παλαιστίνη, τον Λίβανο, τη Συρία και το Ιράν. Το σιωνιστικό κράτος δολοφονεί και οδηγεί τους ανθρώπους στη λιμοκτονία, καθιστώντας τη γη ακατάλληλη για διαβίωση μέσω συνεχών βομβαρδισμών και πυρών, καθώς και μολύνοντας και δηλητηριάζοντας το έδαφος, τον αέρα και τη θάλασσα με τόνους εκρηκτικών και τοξικές χημικές ουσίες. Η καταστροφή του Λιβάνου και της Παλαιστίνης αποτελεί δυτικό σχέδιο, όπως και η καταστροφή του Σουδάν, του Κονγκό, της Υεμένης και της Κούβας. Εξυπηρετεί τα δυτικά συμφέροντα και τον γεωστρατηγικό έλεγχο για κέντρα δεδομένων, αποθέματα φυσικού αερίου, πετρελαίου, ορυκτών ή άλλων πόρων, καθώς και για την κυριαρχία στις εμπορικές οδούς.




Ο πόλεμος κατά του Ιράν, της Παλαιστίνης, του Λιβάνου, της Υεμένης, της Κούβας, του Κονγκό, του Σουδάν και του Παγκόσμιου Νότου γενικότερα, αφορά την εξουσία, τους πόρους και τον έλεγχο από τα παγκόσμια αρπακτικά. Αφορά τη διασφάλιση ότι η δυτική κυριαρχία θα παραμείνει όπως ήταν τους τελευταίους αιώνες. Αυτοί οι πόλεμοι και οι γενοκτονίες διεξάγονται για να διατηρηθούν η αποικιοκρατία και ο ιμπεριαλισμός στη θέση τους. Αποτελούν έκφραση της βαθιά εκμεταλλευτικής και καταστροφικής καπιταλιστικής παγκόσμιας τάξης πραγμάτων. Πρόκειται για την παλιά στρατηγική της σποράς του χάους και της καταστροφής, με σκοπό την προώθηση των συμφερόντων του δυτικού ιμπεριαλισμού. Το τίμημα το πληρώνουν οι λαοί και τα εδάφη του Παγκόσμιου Νότου. Ωστόσο, όλες οι αυτοκρατορίες καταρρέουν! Πόσος καιρός απομένει, λοιπόν; Πόσα ακόμη δεινά, πόσες ακόμη ζωές, πόση ακόμη γη θα καταστραφούν; Τι χρειάζεται για να πάψουμε να είμαστε συνένοχοι; Και πόσο ακόμη θα περιμένουμε μέχρι να αντεπιτεθούμε, όπως μας έχουν δείξει οι άνθρωποι στη Γάζα και την Παλαιστίνη;




Ακόμη κι αν κατά καιρούς φαίνεται ανίκητο, το τέρας της αποικιοκρατίας, του ιμπεριαλισμού και της δυτικής υπεροχής που αντιμετωπίζουμε δεν είναι. Μπορεί να ηττηθεί. Ο αγώνας εναντίον του διεξάγεται σε πολλά μέτωπα. Στο όνομα της διεθνιστικής αλληλεγγύης και στον αγώνα κατά της αποικιοκρατίας, του καπιταλισμού και του ιμπεριαλισμού, οφείλουμε να συνεχίσουμε και να εντείνουμε τις προσπάθειές μας για την καταπολέμησή του. Πρέπει να αντλήσουμε έμπνευση από όλους εκείνους στον Παγκόσμιο Νότο που αγωνίζονται καθημερινά για την εξόντωσή του. Δεν θα υπάρξει ειρήνη μέχρι την απελευθέρωση κάθε τόπου και κάθε λαού!




Φέτος, με αφορμή την επέτειο της 7ης Οκτωβρίου, διοργανώνουμε μια εκδήλωση με εισήγηση και συζήτηση με τον 

Wessam Sabaaneh

 -Παλαιστίνιο σύντροφο και συγγραφέα, ο οποίος εργάζεται αυτή τη στιγμή σε καταυλισμούς Παλαιστινίων προσφύγων στον Λίβανο- σχετικά με τη γενική κατάσταση στην περιοχή και τις συνθήκες της Αντίστασης. Θα υπάρχει φαγητό, ένα μικρό μπαζάρ και μπαρ. Η εκδήλωση θα πραγματοποιηθεί την 

Κυριακή 4 Οκτωβρίου στις 19:00, στον χώρο

 

Alma

 

(Καλλιδρομίου 79)

.




Την Τετάρτη 7 Οκτωβρίου καλούμε σε διαδήλωση από το Πάρκο Ελευθερίας προς τη σιωνιστική πρεσβεία, στις 18:00.




Για την απελευθέρωση όλων, με κάθε αναγκαίο μέσο.




Από το ποτάμι ως τη θάλασσα, η Παλαιστίνη θα είναι ελεύθερη.

 فعلًا من أفعال المقاومة المناهضة للاستعمار والإمبريالية. وهو استمرار لمقاومة تعود إلى اللحظة التي أُقيمت فيها دولة إسرائيل عام 1948، بل وإلى ما قبل ذلك، خلال الاحتلال الاستعماري البريطاني. لقد كان شعبًا وحركةً ينهضان في مواجهة الاحتلال. وسيستمر الاحتفاء بهذا اليوم على هذا النحو لأجيال قادمة، حتى لو حاول الصهاينة والإمبرياليون بكل الوسائل السيطرة على الرواية وتغييرها. إن صور الطائرات الشراعية التي حلّقت فوق السياج ودخلت إلى فلسطين المحتلة، وصور السياج المحيط بغزة وهو يُهدم على أيدي أبناء الشعب الذين طُردوا من أرضهم قبل عقود، لن تُنسى، وستبقى في ذاكرتنا رموزًا لمقاومة الجنوب العالمي.




كان ردّ الكيان الصهيوني، بدعم من الولايات المتحدة، قاسيًا ووحشيًا. فمنذ أكتوبر/تشرين الأول 2023، نشهد إبادة جماعية تُبثّ على الهواء مباشرة، إلى جانب العديد من الفظائع التي يرتكبها الكيان الصهيوني والإمبرياليون الأمريكيون، بدعم من الدول الأوروبية. لقد قُصفت غزة حتى دُمّرت، ولا يزالون، رغم إعلان وقف إطلاق النار، يواصلون القصف وإطلاق النار بشكل عشوائي. وتخضع لبنان وسوريا للاحتلال وتتعرضان باستمرار لهجمات الكيان الصهيوني. كما تقوم حكومات هذه المناطق بقمع المقاومة والمعارضة للغرب وإسرائيل داخل أراضيها، وتعمل كوكلاء للولايات المتحدة. ويحدث كل ذلك بينما تستولي إسرائيل على المزيد والمزيد من الأراضي، مما يزيد من زعزعة استقرار المنطقة.




إن دولة إسرائيل والولايات المتحدة تدمران بعضًا من أقدم الأماكن المأهولة باستمرار في تاريخ الحضارة، في فلسطين ولبنان وسوريا وإيران. إن الدولة الصهيونية تقتل الناس وتجوعهم، وتجعل الأرض غير صالحة للعيش من خلال القصف المستمر وإطلاق النار وتلويث وتسميم الأرض والهواء والبحر بالجثث وأطنان المتفجرات والمواد الكيميائية السامة. إن تدمير لبنان وفلسطين هو مشروع غربي، شأنه شأن تدمير السودان والكونغو واليمن وكوبا. إنه يتعلق بالمصالح والسيطرة الغربية، وبمراكز البيانات واحتياطيات الغاز والنفط والمعادن أو غيرها من الموارد، أو بالسيطرة على طرق التجارة.




إن الحرب على إيران وفلسطين ولبنان واليمن وكوبا والكونغو والسودان، وعلى الجنوب العالمي عمومًا، تتعلق بالقوة والموارد والسيطرة. إنها تهدف إلى ضمان استمرار الهيمنة الغربية كما كانت طوال القرون الماضية. هذه الحروب وعمليات الإبادة تُشنّ لضمان استمرار الاستعمار والإمبريالية. وهي تعبير عن النظام العالمي الرأسمالي شديد الاستغلال والتدمير. إنها الاستراتيجية القديمة القائمة على زرع الفوضى والدمار من أجل تعزيز مصالح الإمبريالية الغربية. أما من يدفع الثمن فهم شعوب وأراضي الجنوب العالمي.




ومع ذلك، تسقط كل الإمبراطوريات! فإلى متى سيستمر هذا؟ كم من المعاناة، وكم من الأرواح، وكم من الأراضي الأخرى يجب أن تُدمَّر؟ ماذا يتطلب الأمر لكي نتوقف عن كوننا متواطئين؟ وكم من الوقت سيمضي قبل أن نقاوم، كما أظهر لنا أهل غزة وفلسطين؟




حتى وإن بدا الأمر أحيانًا كذلك، فإن وحش الاستعمار والإمبريالية والتفوق الغربي الذي نواجهه ليس عصيًا على الهزيمة. يمكن هزيمته. والنضال ضده يُخاض على جبهات عديدة. وباسم التضامن الأممي، وفي النضال ضد الاستعمار والرأسمالية والإمبريالية، علينا أن نواصل جهودنا ونكثّفها لمواجهته. يجب أن نستمد الإلهام من جميع أولئك في الجنوب العالمي الذين يناضلون كل يوم من أجل تدميره. لن يكون هناك سلام حتى تحرير كل أرض وكل شعب!

3 χρόνια έπειτα από την έναρξη της 7ης Οκτώβρη ένας κύκλος φαίνεται σαν να έχει κλείσει. Η ηρωική αντεπίθεση των μαχητών της Χαμάς, της Τζιχάντ και του PFLP διά γης και ουρανού άνοιξε ένα νέο κεφάλαιο στο Παλαιστινιακό. Οι Παλαιστίνιοι δεν θα είναι ικέτες της ελεημοσύνης του σιωνισμού, δεν θα υποταχθούν στα κελεύσματα του Ιμπεριαλισμού. Την ελευθερία τους θα την κατακτήσουν μόνοι τους κόντρα στην αδικία. Στην αρχή σε πολλούς όλο αυτό φάνταζε σαν μια αποστολή αυτοκτονίας. Πώς γίνεται μία λωρίδα γης να τα βάλει με ολόκληρη την Αυτοκρατορία; Ισραήλ, ΗΠΑ, ΕΕ, ΝΑΤΟ όλος ο οχετός της Γης ενώθηκε για να τα βάλει με τους Παλαιστινίους. Και ηττήθηκε. Από τον κοινό αγώνα Φρουρών-Χαμας-Χούθι-Χεζμπολλά.




3 χρόνια αργότερα η Αυτοκρατορία βρίσκεται σε χειρότερη θέση από ό,τι πριν. Οι αμερικάνοι φεύγουν κακήν κακώς από το Ιράκ, οι βάσεις τους σε όλη την Μέση Ανατολή είναι σε στάχτη, τα αεροπλανοφόρα της σκουριασμένα κάπου μακριά, και οι δυτικόφιλοι σύμμαχοι τους σε απελπισία. Οι Χούθι προελαύνουν, τα διυλιστήρια και οι αγωγοί των Σαούντ πολιορκούνται, ενώ οι οικονομικές αρτηρίες του ιμπεριαλισμού είναι υπό τον έλεγχο της Αντίστασης. Ταυτόχρονα η Ουκρανία έχει καταστεί ένα νεκροταφείο ναζιστών, στρατιωτικού εξοπλισμού και νατοϊκών δολαρίων με την αυτοκρατορία να αδυνατεί να επιτύχει τους διακηρυγμένους της στόχους. Όλες αυτές οι εξελίξεις συνιστούν ένα σημαντικό πλήγμα στην συλλογική δύναμη του ΝΑΤΟ, της δυνατότητας του να παριστάνει τον παγκόσμιο αστυνόμο και ληστή. Γιατί κάθε πλήγμα στο ΝΑΤΟ είναι ανάσα ελευθερίας για κάθε καταπιεσμένο αυτού του πλανήτη.




Όμως ο πόλεμος δεν έχει τελειώσει. Η Κούβα βρίσκεται υπό πολιορκία, η Βενεζουέλα διαπραγματεύεται κάποιου είδους συνθηκολόγηση, ενώ άλλες προοδευτικές κυβερνήσεις της Λ. Αμερικής έπεσαν. Ο ερχομός του Ρούμπιο στην Ελλάδα είναι κομμάτι της συνεχιζόμενης προσπάθειας των ΗΠΑ να ανασυγκροτήσουν την ΝΑ πτέρυγα του ΝΑΤΟ. Οι χώρες-λοχαγοί του ΝΑΤΟ καλούνται να δώσουν ακόμα περισσότερο σε έμψυχο και μη υλικό. Όλα τα χρήματα πρέπει να πάνε υπέρ νατοικής πατρίδος, αποστραγγίζοντας έτσι και την υπόλοιπη κοινωνία. Θα πρέπει να πάνε στους ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕΔΕΣ του στρατού, στους μικρούς και μεγάλους απατεώνες που απλώς θα φάνε τα λεφτά πουλώντας φούμαρα για την πατρίδα και το έθνος. Θέλουν και άλλους νεκρούς για τα αφεντικά, για τα συμφέροντα του Λάτση και του Βαρδινογιάννη, μπας και πάρει πάλι το προβάθμισμα η συμμορία που ονομάζεται ΝΑΤΟ.




Αυτός είναι και ο στόχος της στρατιωτικής εμβάθυνσης Ελλάδας-Ισραήλ-Κύπρου. Τα πρωτοκοσμικοί κανίβαλοι της Μεσογείου αναλαμβάνουν επαυξημένα καθήκοντα τόσο για να νουθετήσουν μία αμφιταλαντευόμενη Τουρκία όσο και για τον Άξονα της Αντίστασης. Το ελληνικό κράτος δεν περιορίζεται πλέον στον στρατιωτικό ανεφοδιασμό της Ουκρανίας και του Ισραήλ, αλλά καλείται να αναλάβει ενεργό ρόλο στα μέτωπα.




Αυτό το σκοπό έχει και η στροφή των αστικών τάξεων προς την ακροδεξιά. Από τον Τραμπ μέχρι την Λεπέν, από το Afd μέχρι τον Κασσιδιάρη, το μέτωπο της παγκόσμιας αντίδρασης επιχειρεί την αποβλάκωση του νατοϊκού πόπολου. Στην Ελλάδα επιχειρούν να σφηνώσουν βαθιά μεσ’ τη συνείδηση την γαλανόλευκη μπας και πάει επιτέλους και πεθάνει για τους ευρωνατοικούς και τους εγχώριους φυσικά δισεκατομμυριούχους. Αλλά και στο εσωτερικό μέτωπο η ντόπια αντεπανάσταση ακονίζει τα μαχαίρια της. Θέλει να επιβάλει μία κοινωνία-στρατώνα με σκοπό την φίμωση των ιδεών και της δράσης της αριστεράς, μία νέα Χούντα. Ταυτόχρονα θέλουν να επικυρώσουν την δύναμη κάθε μικρού και μεγάλου αφεντικού να επιβάλλεται απέναντι στον αδύναμο είτε αυτός είναι ο εργαζόμενος, ο μετανάστης ή όποιον δεν συμβαδίζει με την φασιστική τους νοοτροπία.




Είναι λοιπόν δικό μας καθήκον να βάλουμε φραγμό στα σχέδια του ιμπεριαλισμού και της ακροδεξιάς. Να αγωνιστούμε ενάντια στην στρατιωτικοποίηση και την φασιστικοποίηση των κοινωνιών. Να συμβάλουμε στην ήττα των σχεδίων της ντόπιας και της ευρωνατοικής αστικής τάξης. Για το τσάκισμα της Αυτοκρατορίας και της Νατοϊκής συμμορίας, κομμάτι της οποίας είναι και το ελληνικό κράτος.
