author: Mzi Velapi
title: Memorial service held for victims of the Strand mass shooting
content:
In the early hours of Sunday morning, 27 September, gunmen opened fire on patrons at a shisanyama in Lwandle, near Cape Town, killing ten people. “Five individuals died on the scene while five others succumbed to injuries sustained after being transported to medical facilities. Eleven others are receiving medical treatment for injuries sustained. Lwandle police have opened murder and attempted murder cases,” said the police. The community believes the mass shooting is related to the extortion racket that is ravaging Cape Town townships.




One of the victims, Khululekani Ndlovu, will be laid to rest this weekend. The nine other people killed will be buried next weekend in the Eastern Cape. The Nomzamo Community Hall in Strand, south east of Cape Town, was packed with mourners and members of political parties for the memorial service. 




Speaking to 

Elitsha

, the chairperson of the police board in South Africa, Francina Lukas, said that extortion and business rivalry and lack of opportunities for young people are some of the factors contributing to high crime rates in the townships of Cape Town. She said that the lack of trust the community has in the police contributes to high crime rate.




“The police need to do much more than what they are doing in terms of compliance to make sure that businesses in the township comply with their licenses and bylaws. But the issue of trust is still a burning issue in our communities. So we need to overcome that issue to see that trust in the police is restored,” she said.




Families of the Strand 10




Speaking on behalf of the Sikweza family who lost their daughter, Avuyile, her uncle, Luyanda Macokeni, said she had plans to return to school next year. The 20-year-old passed her matric in 2024. She applied to continue her education next year and had just received responses from two universities offering her a place to study. She was expected to make a choice between the two. “Avuyile is supposed to the one burying us as elders but we are the ones burying her. It’s not God’s will that we are here today, it is because of someone’s will,” he said.




Siyathemba Jilaji was one of the victims who died on his way to the hospital, according to his friend. “He said he was going to change in the car so when the shooting began, I thought he was still in the car. A bullet grazed me under my arm. After the shooting, I went to the car to check for him. But, I didn’t know that he was amongst the bodies that were lying next to the entrance that I ran past,” she said.




Sivenathi Manxiwa’s father, Lubabalo Ndamane, said that he is not going to forgive the person who murdered his son. “I also don’t want to know who they are. Even if they can be arrested, I would not go to court. I leave everything to God and God will deal with him. I want to know what drove him to shoot at the young people who were out enjoying themselves,” he said.




The 10 people who died during the mass shooting in Strand last weekend

. 

Photo from Facebook

.




The police said that the investigation into the mass murder is still ongoing.

author: Unknown
title: This is the exact kind of insufferable I want to highlight here.
content:
A lot of people become insufferable when you point out that “You need to learn a dozen new 6-syllable words derived from Greek to participate in our conversation” and “our entire community is white college-graduates and all our efforts to diversify have failed” constantly overlap for really obvious reasons.

#you would think those 6 syllable words were being taken away

Well, yes, kinda. I’m not cancelling words but I am challenging people to think of possible easier words.

If the best thing we can come up with for “stop doing man/woman and cis/trans binaries!” is ‘exorsexism’, we’re shit at accessible communication. Sorry, not sorry.

If the Germans can call combined oral contraceptives 'anti-baby-pills’, then we can decide to come up with simpler, more intuitive and easier-to-remember words for the concepts that we want a lot of people of all backgrounds to understand.

So many replies and responses are essentially versions of “oh so you want us to reduce language and only use stupid words” and the actual point OP is making is — know your audience.

Creating jargon is absolutely fine. Having new words to describe complex sociological issues is absolutely fine. But MOST people aren’t at a place to intuitively understand jargon. And so if you’re trying to create a mass politic for the left, do you want to sound ‘smart’ or do you want to build a coalition? Because if you want to coalition, you have to know who you’re talking to and what words will be effective and how your message can come across.

Otherwise you’re just being Sheldon Cooper from the Big Bang Theory, and you will turn people off not because you’re wrong, but because you are perceived as a know-it-all condescending prick (regardless of your intent).

It’s not just 'know your audience’. Having one set of words for the in-crowd and one set of words for everyone else would just amplify the effect where a lot of people just do not feel welcome in our spaces because they sound like white academia spaces. So I’m also saying: if we’re creating jargon, why are we constantly creating jargon by borrowing from the academic tradition of 'translate it to greek or latin and slap it all together into one word’? instead of thinking 'what word is easy to remember and easy to understand for the largest number of people’?

Antibabypille is six syllables, but most people would know what it means without anyone explaining the meaning, and after hearing it once or twice they would remember it and be able to use it in a sentence. That’s what good jargon could try to be like.

because language is an art as much as it is a tool. and frankly, because antibabypills has no flair and sounds stupid (not to mention anti is a Greek word, too). kill the max efficiency cop in your mind

This is the exact kind of insufferable I want to highlight here.

Like, get your head out of your ass and consider why you think words from the academic tradition are more aesthetically pleasing and what that says about biases on which cultural traditions are valuable and which lack 'flair’ or are 'stupid’.

I bet you think AAVE or rural accents in the workplace are 'unprofessional’.

title: On Saturday, as tens of thousands of people took to the streets of Madrid to protest against the…
content:
On Saturday, as tens of thousands of people took to the streets of Madrid to protest against the country’s deepening housing crisis, the retired schoolteacher was among a small group who had sought to take the protest one step further. “At first we were 10 tents,” she said, gesturing to the sprawling encampment set up in the central Puerta del Sol plaza behind her. “Now, we’re more than 300 tents, and it keeps growing.” Days earlier, many across Spain had watched in shock as news channels showed Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman with a disability, being evicted from the home where she had lived for seven decades. The shock soon gave way to anger as the octogenarian was shown being brought out of her home on a stretcher, flanked by protesters on one side and police officers on the other.

Maricarmen, 87, waits at home for police to arrive before being evicted from the home where she lived in Madrid, Spain, Wednesday, Sept. 23, 2026. (Fernando Sánchez/Europa Press via AP)

Housing campaigners seized on the moment. “The whole country has seen that housing speculation has no mercy on anyone,” said Alicia del Río of the Madrid Tenants’ Union. “We’re not sad, we’re angry. And we’re not going to stop until we change things.” Abascal’s lawyers reportedly reached a deal for her to return home on Monday evening. “If this agreement we have reached is signed, it will obviously be a better and happier outcome for everyone,” her lawyer, Beatriz Duro, told reporters, saying it could “help to change the paradigm when it comes to housing in general”. At the encampment earlier on Monday, many described the days of nationwide protests and the encampment as a turning point in a movement that had long simmered as rents rose by 80% within a decade, while the cost of homes climbed by 63%. “We need stability,” said David Iglesias, 25, as he described how the ever-soaring prices had forced people to put their lives on hold to try to keep a roof over their heads. “People who want to have children should be able to do so, even if they are renting. People who dream of becoming musicians or barbers should have the chance to do so and not have to worry that they need to work, work, work to pay for housing,” he said. “It’s an endless loop that is undermining the mental health of young people.” As he spoke, a large banner flapped nearby, reading: “You can speculate on watches, jewels, cryptobros and Ferraris. But not on our fucking homes.” […] It was a nod to the informal camp slogan, launched by housing campaigners and oft-repeated by protesters in recent days: “Either the rentier economy falls, or the government does.”

[Video]: “Hundreds of protesters across Spain took part in pot banging demonstrations to demand political action over soaring rents, evictions and the shortage of affordable housing. The protests come ahead of a parliamentary vote on Friday on measures to strengthen tenant protections.”

title: uncritical support to the french high school protestors btw. mort tu cochons

author: Andrea DiP
title: Redes, moral, identificação e mais: o que as eleições revelam, mas não aparece nas urnas
content:
No próximo domingo (4), os eleitores brasileiros irão votar em seus representantes para os cargos de presidente, governadores, senadores e deputados. Apesar da possibilidade da decisão para os cargos executivos ser definida apenas em um segundo turno e estender os prazos das campanhas eleitorais, a pauta política não deve se restringir apenas às vésperas de votação. Entender e acompanhar a atuação de cada cargo e partidos é fundamental para o desenvolvimento do país nos próximos anos.




Além do presidente e governadores de todas as unidades da federação, também serão definidas 513 cadeiras na Câmara e 54 das 81 do Senado. Para a cientista política Tathiana Chicarino, entrevistada no 

Pauta Pública

 desta semana, em um cenário de crescente personalização da política, os papéis dos partidos e do Legislativo muitas vezes ficam em segundo plano. Na conversa com Andrea Dip, ela também chama atenção para a forma como escândalos políticos e de corrupção ocupam o debate eleitoral, principalmente em período de campanha, e acabam transformando a política em espetáculo.




Coordenadora do curso de sociologia e política da Fundação Escola de Sociologia e Política de São Paulo (Fesp-SP) e pesquisadora do Observatório de Conflitos Online da Universidade Federal do ABC (UFABC), Chicarino afirma que “as eleições já têm um teor bastante personalizado e passa a ser consumida numa lógica entre bem e mal, com um enredo como se fosse uma novela ou um folhetim, e isso é muito despolitizante” e acrescenta que a política precisa ser trazida novamente para o debate público.




Leia os principais pontos da conversa e ouça o podcast completo abaixo.























































EP 236


											Eleições 2026 além da disputa presidencial – com Tathiana Chicarino							













2 de outubro de 2026


					·
				


				Cientista política explica o papel dos partidos, das redes sociais e do Congresso nas eleições de 2026





























































0:00




-:–



















15




15
































































Veja mais episódios desta série










Às vésperas das eleições, sob as atuais denúncias e conflitos envolvendo o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), os debates sobre as propostas políticas ficaram em segundo plano. Porém, a composição do Supremo depende diretamente de quem ocupa a presidência da República e o Senado Federal. Por que o Congresso Nacional é peça central na disputa de poder? E qual a importância de entendermos a atuação de cada cargo político e da relevância dessas eleições?




A gente costuma dizer que desde por volta de 2013, embora tenham eventos anteriores a isso, como a crise econômica de 2008, de 2010 em diante, inaugurou-se uma “década crítica” em que uma série de crises, de hegemonia e escândalos, vão perpassando nossa política institucional. Tivemos junho de 2013, Lava Jato; 2018, eleição do Bolsonaro, e agora mais uma eleição que, de novo, reforçamos sua importância, que se insere nessa conjuntura um pouco mais ampla.




Olhando para o STF, podemos até traçar um pouco antes, com o Mensalão. Em toda a dinâmica de espetacularização que o poder judiciário vem tendo no Brasil, a partir dos anos 2000, o Mensalão é um momento muito importante. Historicamente, a gente dá muito mais atenção às eleições dos cargos majoritários: presidência da república, governo de estado e prefeituras. As eleições já têm um teor bastante personalizado, então, quem é o candidato? O que aquele candidato representa em oposição a uma outra personalidade política?




No nosso período de construção de um sistema partidário no Brasil, por volta dos anos 1930, quando começamos a estruturar partidos políticos, temos um período de ditadura. Depois uma quadra democrática, a primeira com certa estabilidade – mas bem longe de ser Estado [Democrático de Direito]. Tem Juscelino Kubitschek quase não assumindo; Jânio Quadros renunciando; golpe [de 1964]… Quer dizer, os partidos, que estavam se estruturando, tendo alguma capacidade de articulação nacional e também de identificação, isso também é interrompido ali com a ditadura. Que depois vem a Arena e o MDB. Com a redemocratização, em 1979, abre-se uma lei orgânica de partidos e aí a possibilidade de criação de vários partidos.




O Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT), partido com a maior identificação partidária, é criado nesse contexto. De lá para cá, temos muitos partidos. É claro que, com algumas legislações de cláusula de desempenho – a chamada cláusula de barreira também –, se tenta diminuir o número de partidos políticos. Ainda assim, são muitos partidos e as pessoas mal conseguem identificar quais partidos são e qual a diferença entre um e outro. Vira tudo uma coisa grande, homogênea e disforme, chamada Centrão, e, do outro lado, o PT.




Mas, quando a gente fala de cargos do legislativo, é fundamental entendermos essa estrutura partidária. Porque, para deputados estaduais, federais e vereadores, nós votamos no partido, não votamos na pessoa em primeiro lugar. Nós votamos no partido e dizemos quem gostaríamos que ocupasse a cadeira que o partido porventura venha a ganhar.




O nosso trabalho é quase ranquear os candidatos. Assim, fica muito difícil para as pessoas entenderem as crises institucionais, que se estendem. Além das pessoas conseguirem pouco identificar o papel dos partidos no legislativo, essa eleição ainda foi completamente capturada por todo o discurso de escândalo político e de corrupção. É uma eleição bastante complexa desse ponto de vista.




Com as redes sociais, temos visto um crescimento justamente nessa personificação de quem ocupa os cargos políticos e menos destaque no peso institucional partidário, mesmo em projetos políticos, na composição do Congresso. Porque, na verdade, as campanhas políticas não acabam nunca, elas continuam online ininterruptamente e de uma maneira totalmente personificada. Então, quais são os efeitos e riscos dessa personalização e dessa espetacularização da política?




A espetacularização da política não é de agora, mas ela se intensifica. Então, o que seria essa espetacularização da política? É a gente consumir a política como uma mercadoria, e, sendo uma mercadoria: “eu vou escolher aquilo que mais me convém, se serve mais para mim, se tem mais status’. Enfim, ela passa a ser uma dinâmica bastante individualizante e muito pouco responsável, na qual as pessoas “se tornam muito pouco responsáveis por aquilo que consomem”. E política não é assim.




O político que está lá, eleito por nós, não é o nosso funcionário. Não é assim que funciona a política. A política tem como base interação e coletividade. Então, uma vez que votei, consumi, pronto, paguei, minha responsabilidade acabou. A espetacularização é exatamente isso: consumir a política a partir da mercadoria, da imagem do espetáculo, enquanto uma passividade. “Eu sou a plateia e o espetáculo está ali, e eu estou consumindo aquele espetáculo”.




Porque a lógica algorítmica das plataformas vai tracionar ainda mais esse tipo de conteúdo e adicionando a isso, uma camada de personalização, que tem relação com o histórico da construção da política no Brasil, especialmente em um sistema presidencialista.




Não importa o meu perfil – se eu estou em um coletivo ou partido político – as redes tracionam ainda muitos conteúdos que são individualizantes, de indivíduos personalizados. Então, esses dois elementos, a personalização e a espetacularização, ganham ainda mais fôlego, mais ênfase nesse contexto de plataformização, e aí coloca-se uma terceira: o escândalo.




A escandalização da política, que também temos passado em alguns momentos de lá para cá – e eu estou falando dessa década crítica de 2013 – tendo como marco importante esse processo de escandalização. A política passa a ser consumida numa lógica entre o “bem e o mal”, entre o “mocinho e o bandido”, tem um enredo que acompanha-se como se fosse uma novela, um folhetim. Isso é muito despolitizante, porque a política fica capturada nesse contexto pela moral. Então, “a moral diz o que é certo, o que é errado, o que é o bom, o que é o mal” e aí as pessoas ficam até um pouco confusas. “Nossa, mas ele era bonzinho, agora não é mais?”




E por quê? Porque a política é tratada dessa maneira, a partir da moralização. Também temos outras questões, como o corte neoliberal nas nossas vidas como um todo, na nossa vida, no trabalho e também na política, que puxa para uma superindividualização. Tudo isso que estamos vivendo.




Agora, como sair disso? A política precisa ser trazida novamente para o debate, a política, política mesmo, a discordância, a busca por consensos, ainda que sejam consensos temporários. Porém, dentro dessa década tem sido complexo trabalhar isso. Em termos, como de Antonio Gramsci (1891-1937), estamos passando por uma crise de hegemonia. Nessa década crítica em que é muito difícil encontrarmos um sentido de direção política.




Por isso que a eleição é importante, mas ela é um momento. Se tratarmos a eleição como algo que vai resolver todos os nossos problemas, ano que vem, vamos voltar aqui e falar “nossa, e as instituições, hein?”




Inclusive vimos isso acontecer na passagem de Bolsonaro para Lula em 2023. Quando Lula é eleito, então pensa-se que “acabou a extrema direita no Brasil”; depois quando Bolsonaro é preso, pensa-se “acabou a extrema direita e o bolsonarismo no Brasil”. Mas estamos vendo que não é assim. Como se deu a movimentação da direita, nesse caso?




É interessante trazer essa questão do Bolsonaro, enquanto a vitória eleitoral em 2018. Eu falo muito isso: “ele não é como um raio de luz que apareceu no céu azul, de repente. Nossa, ninguém estava vendo e, de repente, um candidato de extrema direita é eleito”. A construção já vinha acontecendo nas redes, desde pelo menos 2010. Por uma rearticulação das chamadas “novas direitas”, articulando-se com uma direita mais tradicional, uma direita muito radical, uma direita das “viúvas da ditadura”.




Todos esses movimentos ajudaram a rearticular essa direita, que passa a não ter mais vergonha e encontra em Bolsonaro um projeto político viável, do ponto de vista eleitoral. E isso não aconteceu só no Brasil; também pode-se pensar isso nos Estados Unidos, em outros países em que a extrema direita também passa a ter essa viabilidade eleitoral. Mas não foi uma derrota em 2018. Eles elegeram uma série de senadores, deputados, governadores, e em 2022 também, com muita estratégia, com táticas muito claras.




Então, isso está acontecendo de forma sistemática desde 2010. Em 2018, tem esse momento importante da vitória à presidência da República. De fato, a cadeira de presidente importa, tem muito poder, tem capacidade de desarticular projetos políticos que estão em andamento, em disputa, tem um processo de desinstitucionalização muito grande, de rompimento de política pública. O retrocesso é muito grande; perder uma presidência da República é algo muito importante, mas não resolve todos os problemas. – Como eu estava falando – o Jair Bolsonaro perde em 2022, é preso, julgado e, ainda assim, existe uma força política e social bastante expressiva.

title: Uca: Kurdish and Yazidi demands must remain on Germany’s agenda
content:
Kurdish politician Feleknas Uca said the rise of the Alternative for Germany (AfD), the spread of anti-immigrant rhetoric and growing military spending were threatening social peace in Germany. She stressed the need for a strong left-wing alternative to right-wing populist policies that blamed immigrants for social problems.




Feleknaz Uca spoke to ANF about recent political developments in Germany, the demands of the Kurdish and Yazidi communities, the future of Shengal, developments in Rojava and efforts to achieve peace in Turkey.




What do you think about the latest election results and the rise of the AfD? In particular, what impact are calls for “remigration” and attempts to blame immigrants for the country’s problems having on society?




I find the results of the latest state elections and the high level of support that the AfD has reached across Germany deeply concerning. As someone with a migrant background myself, I am particularly troubled, and at times even frightened, by some of the AfD’s rhetoric and positions. I find it dangerous when people are collectively portrayed as a “problem” simply because of their origin, religion or migrant background, and when migration is used as a tool for an exclusionary election campaign.




We should not underestimate the impact that this kind of political rhetoric has on our society. If people are constantly given the impression that migrants or foreigners are responsible for the economic crisis, problems in the labour market or everything else that is currently going wrong in our country, it fuels fear and prejudice and divides our society.




We must not forget our history, particularly in Germany. Our past shows us how vigilant we must be when people are marginalised because of their origin, religion or identity and incited against one another. In my view, our history places a particular responsibility on us to defend democracy, human dignity and a society based on mutual respect.




At the same time, we need to look at the realities of our country. People with migrant backgrounds are an extremely important part of our society and labour market. They work in hospitals and the care sector, as doctors, tradespeople, business owners and scientists, and in many other fields. International students and skilled workers also make an important contribution to our country.




So, I would like to ask a very simple question: what would our everyday lives actually look like if all these people suddenly disappeared? Just take our hospitals. What would happen if doctors, care workers and other staff with migrant backgrounds did not turn up for work tomorrow? Who would care for the patients? Who would treat us?




Of course, we need to discuss the challenges surrounding migration and integration. We need to debate solutions, and different political views are part of democracy. But in my view, collectively blaming groups of people for our country’s problems can never be the answer.




For me, therefore, these election results are about more than percentages. The question is what kind of social climate we are creating and what kind of Germany we want to live in together. I want a Germany where people are not marginalised or pitted against one another because of their origin, religion or name, where we can discuss problems openly and seek solutions together.




I find the statement about “remigration” extremely dangerous. When a leading AfD candidate speaks of an “offensive on remigration and deportation” and says that “appropriate means” are needed to achieve this, we must listen very carefully and confront what such rhetoric means.




Of course, we live in a democracy. Everyone has the right to vote freely, and I respect that right. But I believe it is particularly important for voters to look carefully at what a party and its representatives are saying and at the political thinking behind those statements.




I can understand why people may be disappointed or angry with current politics. But voting for a party simply as a protest or expression of anger does not automatically solve those problems. We should therefore ask ourselves not only what we are voting against, but also what kind of politics we are supporting with our vote.




That is precisely why we cannot simply accept this kind of rhetoric. We need to discuss it, scrutinise it critically and remain aware of the consequences that political demands can have.




Die Linke (The Left), in particular, has demonstrated in recent years that it can take clear positions not only on social and economic policy but also on fundamental issues such as migration, internal security and foreign policy. I believe Germany needs a strong political left that puts social issues on the agenda and brings different sections of society into the political debate.




In my view, one of the most critical challenges of our time is the widening gap between rich and poor. Wealth and economic influence are increasingly concentrated in a small number of hands, while many people struggle with rising rents and living costs and find it difficult to make ends meet despite working hard. At the same time, we also need to critically examine the influence of powerful economic interests on political decision-making.




Public spending priorities must also be openly debated. As more funding is allocated to defence and security, affordable housing, healthcare and care services, nurseries and schools, women’s shelters, railways and public transport must not be neglected.




A strong left can therefore enrich democratic debate in Germany. It should place social inequality and fair distribution at the centre of the discussion and make clear that social problems cannot be solved by pitting people of different backgrounds or ways of life against one another.




How do you view the approach of Germany’s democratic parties towards the Kurdish and Yazidi communities? Beyond election periods, what responsibility should German politics assume regarding the demands of these communities, the future of Shengal and developments in Rojava?




There is one point I particularly want to emphasise: this responsibility does not belong solely to Die Linke. All democratic parties in Germany need to engage seriously with the Kurdish question and the demands of the Kurdish and Yazidi communities.




We want genuine and sustained dialogue with the Kurds, and not only during election periods. Parties should not reach out to the Kurdish community for their votes before elections, only for Kurdish concerns and political demands to be pushed into the background again afterwards. Those who want to engage in dialogue with the Kurdish community must also be prepared to take their demands seriously on a lasting basis and take concrete steps to address them.




I believe this should also involve politicians visiting the regions concerned, seeing the situation on the ground for themselves and meeting local people as well as political and social actors. Developments concerning the Kurdish question and peace initiatives in Turkey, as well as the role of Mr. Öcalan, should be closely followed. If political parties welcome such developments, their support should not be limited to statements.




Peaceful political dialogue must also be supported in practice, with efforts made to help create the conditions for a lasting political solution.




The same applies to the Yazidis, particularly the situation in Shengal. The genocide against the Yazidis has been recognised by the German Bundestag. From our perspective, however, this must go beyond recognition and commemoration. Political actors must also engage with the current situation and future of Shengal. This includes reconstruction, the security of its people and the development of a long-term political and legal framework for the region.




The Yazidis need concrete support to build a future in their own homeland where they can live safely and determine their own future.




Developments in Rojava also need to be followed more closely on the ground. Political delegations could visit the region, hold meetings, observe social and political developments first-hand and directly assess where support is needed.




Political responsibility should therefore not be expressed solely through statements, messages of solidarity or parliamentary resolutions. It also requires a presence on the ground, direct engagement, sustained dialogue and concrete political initiatives.




We expect this not only from Die Linke but from all democratic parties. Kurdish and Yazidi communities should not be regarded simply as groups whose votes are sought during elections. Their concerns, political demands and participation in social life must be taken seriously on a lasting basis, both before and after elections.




What do you think about the growing number of wars around the world and Germany allocating more of its budget to military spending? How does this affect social spending?




As wars, military interventions and violent conflicts escalate around the world, policies aimed at peace are becoming increasingly important. At the same time, we are witnessing a massive military build-up to which ever greater financial resources are being allocated. That money is then unavailable for other areas of public spending, including social security, education, healthcare and infrastructure.




This raises a fundamental question: does constantly increasing military expenditure really bring greater security and peace? Instead, more resources should be invested in diplomacy, disarmament, international cooperation and civilian conflict resolution. Peace policy is not solely the responsibility of the left; it is a shared responsibility of society and politics as a whole.




Drawing on your own political experience, how do you assess internationalist solidarity, the role of the women’s movement in building peace, and the recent attacks targeting left-wing politicians such as Elif Eralp and Ferhat Koçak?




For many years, both in the European Parliament and the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, I fought for peace, human rights, justice and coexistence on equal terms. Women’s and children’s rights, and particularly strengthening the women’s movement, were always central to this work. I also consistently opposed violence and worked towards a world in which conflicts are resolved through dialogue and political solutions rather than weapons.




I believe it is particularly important today not to separate these struggles from one another. The far right, racism, xenophobia, the marginalisation of minorities and attacks on women’s rights are not problems confined to individual countries or particular sections of society. They concern all of us and therefore require a collective response.




My own experience has shown me how crucial international solidarity is. Ethnic and religious minorities, migrant communities, women’s movements and democratic social forces need to come together more closely and stand side by side across national borders. Closer cooperation is also needed between left-wing and socialist parties across Europe and democratic actors around the world.




We are living through a period in which military build-up and military solutions are once again being pushed to the forefront. We need to offer a political alternative to this: an international movement centred on peace, social justice, human rights and equality.




For me, women’s equality is an indispensable part of this process. Women should not merely participate in political processes; they must have equal rights in shaping them and assuming responsibility. The experience of many women’s movements has shown that lasting peace and democracy are impossible without women’s participation and freedom.




This is precisely why we need strong international cooperation between democratic, left-wing and socialist forces, women’s movements, minorities and migrant communities now more than ever. Our goal should not be a world that is constantly arming itself, but one in which conflicts are resolved through political means and people can live as equals, freely and peacefully, regardless of gender, origin, religion or ethnicity.




At the same time, I do not think it is right that Elif and Ferhat are currently being targeted in this way following the Berlin state elections. In my view, these attacks are an attempt to shift the political agenda and redirect attention towards these two individuals.




What we should instead be looking at are the election results and the growth of the AfD. What would happen if an AfD mayor were elected in Berlin tomorrow? Would there be such a strong reaction then as well?




Elif and Ferhat can be criticised, but these attacks do not resolve the underlying political problems.

title: Ill prisoners in Van unable to access treatment
content:
According to a report published by the Human Rights Association (IHD), there are at least 1,400 ill prisoners in prisons across Kurdistan and Turkey. Of these, 335 are seriously ill prisoners. Despite calls and applications for their release, sick prisoners are not being released, while the conditions under which they receive treatment are becoming increasingly difficult.




For ill prisoners, hospital examinations, access to the infirmary, and obtaining medication have turned into processes that can take days. Decisions issued by the Forensic Medicine Institute (ATK) are also making prisoners’ living conditions even more difficult.




Van (Wan) is one of the cities where this situation is particularly prevalent. There are 30 seriously ill prisoners in the city’s prisons. Requests for transfers and releases made on behalf of the prisoners have gone unanswered, and prisoners are not being released even when hospital medical boards issue reports stating that they “cannot remain in prison.”




The families of seriously ill prisoners in Van’s prisons, including Necdet Koç, Botan Karsu, and Burhan Adsız, are demanding that their relatives be given access to medical treatment and provided with adequate healthcare conditions.




Attorney Mehmet Salih Coşkun, co-chair of the IHD Van Branch, said that seriously ill prisoners face serious problems accessing treatment and that healthcare conditions in prisons further worsen their health. Coşkun said prisoners’ access to treatment is being obstructed by arbitrary and administrative practices and spoke to our news agency about the problems they face.




“Sometimes prisoners are not transferred to hospital at all”




Coşkun said that one of the most fundamental problems faced by sick prisoners is the difficulty of accessing medical treatment. He said that transfers to hospitals are sometimes not carried out at all and sometimes delayed, explaining: “The main problem for all prisoners, especially sick prisoners, is the difficulty of accessing treatment. They say that transfers from the prison infirmary to hospitals are sometimes not carried out at all and sometimes take place very late. When hospital transfers do take place, there are allegations that examinations are conducted while the prisoner is handcuffed. It has been reported that this practice of requiring handcuffed examinations is imposed both by doctors and by law-enforcement officers.”




Coşkun added: “In particular, regarding allegations that doctors are imposing handcuffed examinations, we visited the administrations of both public hospitals in the city with a delegation consisting of representatives from the IHD, the Association of Lawyers for Freedom (ÖHD), the Human Rights Foundation of Turkey (TIHV), the Van-Hakkari Medical Chamber, the Health and Social Service Workers’ Union (SES), and the Bar Association. We also held discussions to ensure that such violations do not take place at the hands of doctors.”




“Our applications are being rejected”




Coşkun said that almost all seriously ill prisoners referred to the Forensic Medicine Institute receive negative decisions. He said the ATK issues reports stating that seriously ill prisoners can remain in prison, drawing attention to the following: “The ATK, which is the only institution authorized to assess whether a prisoner can remain in prison, has unfortunately issued numerous reports stating that seriously ill prisoners can remain in prison. Recently, many institutional and individual applications made in Van have also received negative responses.”




Coşkun continued: “Botan Karsu’s health condition is very serious. His treatment needs to continue in Diyarbakır, but his requests for transfer are repeatedly rejected. Keeping a person in so-called ‘well-type prisons’ constitutes a violation in itself, while his right to access treatment is also being obstructed. These violations can only be resolved by implementing a correctional system that respects human dignity. In addition, the authority to issue reports determining whether a prisoner can remain in prison should not be limited to the ATK; the way should also be opened for such reports to be obtained from fully equipped hospitals.”




Released and arrested again




Reşat Adsız, whose brother Burhan Adsız is 95 percent disabled, said that his brother has not been released despite his serious health problems and called for the immediate release of ill prisoners.




Burhan Adsız is being held in Van F-Type High-Security Prison. He has cirrhosis and is 95 percent disabled. Adsız was arrested in 2015, and on December 17 of the same year, the Medical Board of Van Yüzüncü Yıl University Dursun Odabaş Medical Center issued a report stating that he “cannot remain in prison.”




Following the report, Adsız was released. However, after his sentence was upheld, he was detained and arrested again in 2023. The ATK subsequently issued two reports concerning Adsız: the first stated that he “cannot remain in prison,” while the second stated that he “can remain in prison.”




Days in intensive care




Reşat Adsız said that every time he visits his brother, Burhan Adsız’s health appears to have deteriorated further, and that this is also reflected in his physical appearance. He said that other sick prisoners in prison are experiencing similar problems and that it is unconscionable for his brother not to be released despite his serious health problems. He said: “His condition has been the same for months; he is not being taken to the hospital. His illness is progressing severely. Every time we visit him, his condition is worse. Now both his stomach and his lungs hurt. He has great difficulty walking, speaking, and even eating. He is not in a condition to remain in prison and needs to be released as soon as possible.




We do not understand why he has not been released despite the reports that have been issued. When he was first released, he received treatment for days and spent time in intensive care. Now he is almost unrecognizable and has lost a great deal of weight. Something must be done to prevent this situation from continuing.”

title: 6 OCTOBRE : ACTE III
content:
Mardi 6 octobre, on y va déter, équipés et solidaires : grève nationale et blocage total

 

!




 

 

 

 




Wesh l'équipe, faut qu'on parle de ce qui se passe en ce moment, parce que c'est hyper grave.




Le gouvernement Lecornu vient de présenter son projet de budget pour 2027, et c'est une énorme cure d'austérité : 54 milliards d'euros d'économies sur notre dos.




Concrètement, ils veulent supprimer 1 588 postes de profs (alors qu'on est déjà souvent plus de 35 par classe

 

!), et geler les 

APL

 ainsi que les allocations familiales. Bref, c'est une attaque directe contre la jeunesse et les familles les plus pauvres.




Depuis fin septembre, on s'est mobilisés en masse dans les lycées. Mais la réponse de l'État est ultra-violente. En quelques jours, il y a déjà eu plus de 5 000 interpellations (rien que le jeudi 1

er

 octobre, ils ont arrêté 1 949 personnes

 

!).




Le pire, c'est qu'il y a déjà au moins 170 élèves blessés. À Tours et à Argenteuil, des lycéens de 16 ans ont été gravement touchés à l'œil par des tirs policiers, et à Saint-Denis, un autre a fini à l'hôpital pour une suspicion de fracture du crâne.




Face à cette violence, on ne peut plus juste attendre gentiment. Les syndicats officiels (comme la 

FIDL

 ou l'Union étudiante) et les partis politiques comme 

LFI

 nous demandent de faire des marches pacifiques ou d'attendre sagement les élections de 2027.




Mais on sait très bien que les marches déclarées ne suffisent plus. Ce qui marche vraiment, c'est le blocage strict et le rapport de force.




La preuve : la ministre a déjà dû reculer sur la tarification des 

BTS

 et des Prépas grâce à la pression de la rue

 

!


Pour tenir le coup, la rue n'est pas un choix politique, c'est une nécessité.




On doit s'organiser, se protéger et faire bloc.







 🛡️ 

GUIDE

 

DE

 

SURVIE

 : 

DE

 

LA

 

RUE

 À 

LA

 

GAV

 




Pour que la solidarité soit notre meilleure arme face à la répression, voici les règles d'or et techniques de défense collective (defco).




 En manif : "Be Water" et protection collective




Matos de base

 : Du sérum phy pour les yeux, des fringues sombres et neutres (pas de marques visibles), un masque de protection 

FFP2

, des lunettes de protections, et surtout le numéro d'un groupe d'anti-répression ou d'un proche écrit au marqueur sur le bras.




Technique du parapluie

 : Les parapluies ne servent pas qu'à se cacher. Ouvrir plusieurs parapluies à l'avant et sur les côtés du cortège crée un mur visuel instantané. Ça bloque les caméras de surveillance, empêche les flics de cibler des personnes et protège des tirs de gaz lacrymo ou de 

LBD

.




"Be Water" (Sois l'eau)

 : Pas de position fixe si on est encerclés ou dépassés. On reste mobiles, fluides et spontanés. Si une charge arrive, on reflue ensemble sans paniquer, et on se reforme plus loin. On évite de rester statique face aux nasses.




 En cas d'interpellation : La base légale de la Defco




Si tu te fais choper par les flics, active immédiatement le mode "Défense Collective". En garde à vue (

GAV

), tu as des droits fondamentaux que la police essaiera de te faire oublier.




Applique la règle des 3 piliers :




Le Droit au Silence

 : C'est ta meilleure arme. À 

TOUTES

 les questions (sauf ton identité de base : nom, prénom, adresse), ta seule et unique réponse doit être : «

 

Je n'ai rien à déclarer

 

». Ne cherche pas à te justifier ou à raconter ton histoire "pour sortir plus vite", ça sera retenu contre toi ou tes potes.




L'Avocat·e choisi·e 

 ou commis·e d'office : Exige un·e avocat·e dès le début. Aucune audition ou interrogatoire ne peut commencer sans sa présence. Si tu as le nom d'un avocat anti-rep ou d'un collectif sur ton bras, donne-le. Sinon, demande l'avocat d'office.




Le Médecin

 : Demande à voir un médecin, même si tu penses n'avoir rien. C'est capital pour faire constater d'éventuels coups ou violences policières subis pendant l'interpellation, et ça laisse une trace officielle. Pareil si tu as des médicaments à prendre (pense à en avoir avec toi). Ne dis rien au médecin qui puisse être utilisé contre toi.




Ne rien signer à l'aveugle

 : Ne signe aucun document (procès-verbal, déclaration) sans l'avoir lu attentivement. Si tu n'es pas d'accord avec ce qui est écrit ou si on a déformé tes propos, refuse de signer.




Rappel crucial pour les mineurs (90% des interpellés en ce moment) 

 : Les flics ont l'obligation de prévenir tes parents ou tuteurs légaux immédiatement. La présence d'un avocat est obligatoire pour les mineurs pendant les auditions. Ne te laisse pas impressionner par leurs coups de pression.




 Que faire si mon pote se fait arrêter

 

?




La solidarité ne s'arrête pas quand les flics embarquent quelqu'un.




Si tu vois ton pote se faire choper, suis 

DIRECTEMENT

 ces étapes pour le sortir de là :




Prends les infos en direct 

 : Note immédiatement l'heure exacte, le lieu précis de l'arrestation, la tenue qu'il portait, et essaie de capter le matricule (

RIO

) des flics ou leur unité (

BAC

, Brav-M, 

CRS

).




Note son identité complète 

 : Note son nom, prénom, sa date de naissance complète et le numéro de téléphone de ses parents (surtout s'il est mineur, c'est super important).




Alerte le groupe légal 

 : Contacte tout de suite le collectif légal ou la "legal team" de ta ville ou de ton mouvement si vous en avez mis un en place. Transmets-leur toutes les infos pour qu'ils puissent chercher dans quel commissariat il a été envoyé.




Préviens ses proches

 : Si ton pote est mineur, appelle immédiatement ses parents pour qu'ils soient au courant avant que la police ne les appelle (ou s'ils font traîner les choses). Dis-leur de demander tout de suite un·e avocat·e pour leur enfant.




Fais du soutien psy au comico

 : Ne le laisse pas tout seul. Dès que vous savez dans quel commissariat il est retenu, rassemblez-vous en groupe devant. Faire du bruit et être présents montre aux flics qu'il n'est pas isolé et ça donne de la force à ceux qui sont à l'intérieur.




Mardi 6 octobre, on y va déter, équipés et solidaires : grève nationale et blocage total

 

!

author: Unknown
title: Appel à s'opposer à la facturation électronique obligatoire
content:
Paysan.nes, artisan.es, commerçant.es, auto-entrepreneur.euses, associations et petites entreprises : refusons de faire un pas de plus vers un monde autoritaire et sans contact

 

! Quelques explications sur la réforme de la facturation électronique obligatoire, les raisons et les moyens de s'y opposer.




Refusons de faire un pas de plus vers un monde autoritaire et sans contact




L'obligation de facturation électronique, dont la mise en application débutait en ce mois de septembre 2026, suscite de vives inquiétudes et oppositions chez nombre de paysan.nes, artisan.es, commerçant.es, auto-entrepreneur.euses, associations et petites entreprises touchées par la réforme.




En effet, à compter du 1

er

 septembre 2026, l'ensemble des entreprises (y compris exemptées de 

TVA

, et quels que soient leur taille, chiffre d'affaires, forme juridique ou régime d'imposition) ainsi que certaines associations (assujetties à la 

TVA

) sont sommées de s'inscrire sur une plateforme électronique agréée privée afin de recevoir des factures électroniques - sans cela elles ne pourront plus régler leurs factures. Parallèlement, l'émission de factures électroniques s'applique dès cette même date aux moyennes et grandes entreprises. D'ici le 1

er

 septembre 2027, l'obligation d'acquérir un logiciel compatible pour émettre les factures sera étendu aux 

PME

, 

TPE

 et micro-entreprises : elles ne pourront plus émettre de facture par un autre moyen.




Traçabilité et automatisation : un nouveau système au service de l'État 




La facturation électronique n'est pas le simple passage d'une facture papier à un «

 

fichier 

PDF

 

» envoyé par mail. Il s'agit d'un nouveau pas vers un système de transaction automatisé, qui consiste dans la centralisation numérique de l'ensemble des données de transaction auprès de l'administration fiscale. Cette collecte massive de données relatives à l'activité des entreprises du pays en temps réel ouvre non seulement la voie à davantage de traçabilité et contrôle social des structures les plus vulnérables, mais également à de nouvelles possibilités d'automatisation de la finance et de pilotage de l'économie par l'

IA

.




 

 

 

 

Les plus petites structures et les travailleurs indépendants en danger

 

!




L'accumulation des démarches administratives à distance, que l'État prétend réduire à un «

 

simple clic

 

», représente en réalité une profonde transformation des pratiques dont les impacts se font ressentir surtout sur les acteurs économiques les plus fragiles. Comme le résume la 

Confédération Paysanne

 dans un 

communiqué

 du 26 août 2026 :







 En effet, cette réforme nous impose des contraintes disproportionnées, loin des objectifs de simplifications. La charge administrative supplémentaire, pour des fermes sans service dédié, est loin d'être marginale et risque de provoquer de nouvelles victimes parmi les paysan.nes déjà affaibli.es. La réforme engendre des coûts directs et indirects : abonnements aux plateformes privées, mise à niveau ou acquisition de logiciels compatibles, coûts de formation ou d'accompagnement, temps non productif consacré à la transition. Ces coûts, absorbables pour les grandes entreprises, représentent un poids disproportionné pour les petites structures, déjà fragilisées par les fluctuations économiques, l'inflation et les charges croissantes

 [

1

]

.







 




Chantage et pression financière pour forcer à la bascule numérique




Au nom de la «

 

simplification administrative

 

» et de la lutte contre la fraude fiscale ici orientée vers les plus pauvres, l'État renforce en réalité ses moyens de contrôle sur des petites structures en exigeant d'elles de rendre traçable l'intégralité de leurs échanges marchands, sous la menace de sanctions financières plus que persuasives

 [

2

]

. Cette pression et cette criminalisation financière pour forcer à la bascule numérique des facturations s'attaque à la survie même des structures et se déploie donc à marche forcée sans débats ni moyens pour s'y opposer.




Explosion des inégalités et risques accrus de renoncement à son activité 




Nombre de petites entreprises n'ont à l'heure actuelle que très peu recours à l'informatique et fonctionnent essentiellement par des échanges directs de factures de personne à personne. L'obligation numérique va accentuer les inégalités entre les personnes qui peuvent «

 

s'adapter

 

» d'un côté, et celles qui subissent la «

 

fracture numérique

 

» de l'autre - qui seront même pour certaines contraintes d'abandonner leur activité, ou de l'exercer de manière parallèle et précaire. Une enquête du Défenseur des droits de 2025 démontre en effet que plus d'un usager sur deux ne parvient pas à réaliser ses démarches en ligne, quel que soit son âge ou sa catégorie socio-professionnelle

 [

3

]

. Ce constat est partagé par l'association 

Solidarité Paysans

, 

qui qualifie même cette réforme de «

 

remembrement administratif 

 [

4

]

 

» .




Quant aux personnes qui revendiquent le droit à la déconnexion pour des raisons politiques, conscientes des ravages écologiques, sanitaires, sociaux occasionnés par l'informatisation du monde

 [

5

]

, la nouvelle perte d'autonomie engendrée par cette réforme aura pour conséquence toujours plus de perte de sens au travail.




Un système de facturation indirect qui profite au privé et qui fragilise la sécurité des données




Les réels bénéficiaires de cette réforme seront sans surprise les sociétés privées impliquées dans la gestion des plateformes électroniques de facturation, là où jusqu'à présent il y avait nul besoin d'intermédiaire : banques, cabinets comptables, multinationales de l'informatique et autres start-ups éditrices de logiciels… Ainsi, un nouveau marché de service payant se met en place, offrant des perspectives lucratives grâce à la collecte des données transactionnelles, véritable carburant du déploiement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.




Du point de vue de la confidentialité des données générées sur les plateformes, la centralisation numérique de volumes massifs d'informations financières expose les entreprises à des risques accrus de cyberattaques. Cela s'est déjà confirmé avec 

le cas de la fuite de données de Welyb

, une plateforme collaborative très utilisée par les cabinets comptables français, victime d'un incident de sécurité le jour même de l'entrée en vigueur de la facturation électronique.




Impasse écologique et crise climatique




L'incitation à l'équipement en terminaux numériques ainsi qu'à la production et au stockage massif de données est une gabégie écologique et financière. En 2025, le sommet de l'

IA

 et le sommet Choose France ont soulevé plus de 200 milliards d'euros afin de déployer plus d'une soixantaine de datacenters sur l'ensemble du territoire d'ici 2035, énergivores en ressources, voraces en terres et très polluants (pollution chimique aux 

PFAS

, îlots de chaleur impactant la faune et la flore, pollution sonore…). Alors que l'urgence climatique se fait toujours plus ressentir, les records de chaleur et sécheresse enregistrés depuis juin 2026 l'ayant encore rappelé, il s'agirait plutôt de dénoncer la fuite en avant technologique, et de s'orienter vers une nécessaire 

désescalade numérique

 [

6

]

.




Contre cette réforme inutile et délétère, rejoignez la contestation

 

!




De nombreuses contestations se font entendre : à l'échelle locale (comme c'est le cas en 

Ardèche

, en Ariège, dans le Tarn, en Corrèze, ou encore dans le 

Pays de Redon

 [

7

]

), des collectifs de citoyen.nes se montent, organisent des réunions publiques pour informer la population, et tentent de se mobiliser pour refuser collectivement la facturation électronique. Plusieurs organisations professionnelles ont exprimé leur opposition à la réforme, comme la 

Fédération Nationale des Marchés

 de France

 [

8

]

 ou la 

Confédération des Commerçants de France

 [

9

]

. À l'échelle nationale, plusieurs pétitions ont été lancées, 

dont l'une est très médiatisée

 [

10

]

 et est actuellement en voie d'examen par la commission des affaires économiques. Un recours collectif en justice contre la généralisation de la mesure est également considéré.




Nous pouvons, dès aujourd'hui :

 informer et nous regrouper afin de lutter contre l'individualisation et d'avoir plus de poids collectivement,

 refuser de nous inscrire sur les plateformes - nous disposons d'un délai de 3 mois après une éventuelle mise en demeure concernant la non-inscription sur les plateformes pour nous organiser (de plus, le gouvernement a annoncé qu'il n'y aurait pas de sanctions jusqu'à fin décembre),

 demander aux plateformes des engagements qu'elles ne pourront tenir (protection des données, lutte contre le changement climatique, etc)

 

; écrire à la 

DDFIP

 pour expliquer notre refus (demandez-nous des modèles de lettre type),

 interpeller les élus au niveau local et national, afin d'ouvrir un véritable débat public et d'obtenir un moratoire sur cette obligation.




Refusons de céder au matraquage de l'administration, ne cédons pas plus de terrain à l'empire de la Tech, aux logiques d'informatisation, de standardisation et centralisation.




Défendons la simplicité, l'autonomie, et la sobriété dans un monde qui tend à se complexifier.




Plus nous serons nombreux et nombreuses à mettre du sable dans les rouages de leur machine, plus nous aurons de la force

 

!




Non à la facturation électronique Grand Est


nonfegrandest@proton.me




Version page par page pour lecture sur écran :




 

 

 

 Télécharger le fichier PDF

 

 




Version cahier imprimable en brochure en recto-verso




 

 

 

 Télécharger le fichier PDF

 

 










[

1

] 

«

 

Facturation électronique : une réforme à adapter aux réalités du monde agricole

 

», communiqué de presse de la Confédération paysanne, 26 août 2026.







[

2

] 

En cas de non-respect, elles s'exposent à une mise en demeure, puis à une amende de 500 euros si aucune plateforme n'a été choisie dans les trois mois, portée à 1 000 euros par trimestre tant que la situation n'est pas régularisée. Le défaut d'émission d'une facture électronique est puni de 50 € par facture

 

; le défaut de transmission à l'administration fiscale des données de vente à des particuliers puni de 500 € par transmission.







[

3

] 

«

 

 Relations des usagers avec les services publics : quelles difficultés d'accès aux droits

 

?

 

», Enquête du Défenseur des droits, 13 octobre 2025.







[

4

] 

«

 

Facturation électronique : un remembrement administratif qui ne dit pas son nom

 

», Association Solidarité Paysans, 16 juin 2026.







[

5

] 

Manifeste contre la gestion et la numérisation de nos vies

, Collectif Écran Total, Éditions La Lenteur, 2026.







[

6

] 

«

 

10 propositions pour une désescalade numérique

 

», 

https://www.desescaladenumerique.org

, lire aussi l'appel 

«

 

Vers une Désescalade Numérique

 

»

 paru sur le site Rebellyon, collectif Désescalade Numérique Lyon, mars 2025.







[

7

] 

«

 

Pendant les foins, c'est intenable

 

» : les agriculteurs en colère contre le passage au tout-numérique

 

», Reporterre, 20 août 2026.







[

8

] 

«

 

Facturation électronique – Communiqué de la Fédération Nationale des Marchés de France

 

», 3 septembre 2026.







[

9

] 

«

 

Non à la facturation électronique payante pour les commerçants

 

», communiqué de la Confédération des Commerçants de France, 29 octobre 2024.







[

10

] 

Pétition «

 

 Facturation électronique obligatoire, c'est non

 

!

 

» n°5174 lancée par une «

 

simple vendeuse de cartes postales

 

», le 18 février 2026.

title: Assemblée ouverte de la caisse de solidarité Kaliméro
content:
Kaliméro est une caisse et une assemblée solidaire des prisonnier·e·s de la guerre sociale. La prochaine aura lieu le jeudi 8 octobre à 18h et se tiendra au 19, rue burnouf à Paris (19

e

).




La prison est un des rouages de ce système basé sur l'exploitation et la domination que nous voulons raser au sol, c'est pourquoi nous envoyons des mandats à celles et ceux accusé·e·s d'actes de révolte dont nous sommes solidaires.




Une caisse de solidarité a besoin de continuité. Nous n'avons ni sponsor, ni mécène, aussi avons-nous convenu d'un rendez-vous par mois pour collecter des sous pour alimenter la caisse. Ces rencontres sont également l'occasion d'échanger sur nos pratiques face à la répression, d'assurer le suivi des différentes histoires et de discuter des situations qui se présentent. Elle est également un moment de discussion autour des possibles moyens d'esquive, de résistance et d'auto-organisation offensive contre la machine judiciaire et carcérale.




Dans un souci de régularité, ces rencards ont été fixés le 2

e

 jeudi de chaque mois.




Pour envoyer de l'argent, pour demander des informations, ou pour être tenu·e·s au courant des prochains rendez-vous de la caisse et être inscrit·e·s sur la mailing-list de Kaliméro, écrivez à kalimeroparis(at)riseup.net

title: Benjamin Péret à l'honneur avec Nedjib Sidi Moussa et Rémy Ricordeau
content:
La Librairie Publico met Benjamin Péret à l'honneur avec Nedjib Sidi Moussa et Rémy Ricordeau




PREMIERE

 

PARTIE

. Présentation de l'ouvrage de Benjamin Péret : «

 

De la conquête à l'insurrection de l'Algérie (1830-1954)

 

» par son postfacier, Nedjib Sidi Moussa. Présence de Jean-Jacques Lebel (sous réserve).




«

 

Un livre essentiel pour comprendre que la violence de la colonisation qui se déroule sur plus d'un siècle est un élément majeur pour appréhender les difficultés actuelles des rapports entre la France et l'Algérie.


Tous les amoureux du surréalisme en général et de Benjamin Péret en particulier auront à coeur de lire ce texte inédit du poète qui n'a eu de cesse que de dénoncer l'ordre capitaliste et colonial

 

».




SECONDE

 

PARTIE

. Diffusion du film documentaire sur Benjamin Péret de Rémy Ricordeau (en sa présence) : «

 

Je ne mange pas de ce pain là – Benjamin Péret poète c'est-à-dire révolutionnaire

 

» (2015).




«

 

Bien que le poète Benjamin Péret ait été avec André Breton un des principaux animateurs du mouvement surréaliste, il reste méconnu du grand public. En retraçant ses divers engagements poétiques et politiques, qui ont été une constante de toute sa vie, ce film se propose de le faire redécouvrir au sein d'une aventure intellectuelle collective qui aura durablement marqué le 

XX

e

 siècle. 


Éternel réfractaire à l'autorité quelle qu'elle soit, les combats qu'il a menés dans le monde des idées et celui de la politique l'ont été au service d'une conception de l'émancipation humaine qui supposait à ses yeux la liberté la plus absolue : celle de l'expression sensible comme celle, concomitante, de la pensée critique. 


Novateur, dans sa démarche poétique autant que dans sa réflexion politique, les fulgurances dont il a nourri son œuvre demeurent aujourd'hui d'une brûlante actualité

 

».

author: Unknown
title: Le temps du soulèvement : l'appel d'une jeunesse insurrectionnelle
content:
À Saint-Denis, Paris, Nantes, Lyon, Rennes, Bordeaux, Lille, Toulouse, mais aussi à Niort, Sens, Saintes ou Saint-Nazaire : des dizaines de milliers de lycéen·nes et de jeunes précaires se lèvent, s'auto-organisent et débordent le cadre.







 Ce n'est plus une simple colère scolaire, c'est le soulèvement méthodique d'une génération à qui l'on a tout confisqué : les moyens dans l'éducation, les espaces de fête, l'air respirable et l'avenir…




 À Rennes, l'embrasement gagne du terrain. La colère a franchi un cap : les premières barricades à l'université s'érigent et les accès se verrouillent. Face aux flics et au mépris des institutions, les étudiant·es refusent de courber l'échine. Leurs revendications sont claires : stop au sous-investissement chronique qui laisse les bâtiments tomber en ruine et fin du massacre de leurs conditions d'étude et de vie — un constat d'urgence rappelé sans détour par Héloïse Lefebvre Milon, secrétaire générale de l'Union Étudiante. Face à la précarité organisée et à l'austérité budgétaire, la jeunesse rennaise a choisi l'offensive et l'action directe.




 




 Face à la contestation légitime, la réponse du pouvoir n'est plus politique, elle est violente et militaire. Depuis quarante-huit heures, le bilan de la sauvagerie policière glace le sang : à Saint-Ouen-l'Aumône, Eden, 14 ans, a eu




 À Tours, 







 Privée de moyens, d'écoute et d'avenir, l'évidence s'impose : nous sommes face au cri de révolte d'

une jeunesse qu'on étrangle







.




 Quand l'État tire sur les adolescent·es, il perd toute légitimité. L'illusion du dialogue social est morte.




 




 

 À Lyon comme ailleurs, la réponse de la rue commence à s'ajuster à la violence subie : le commissariat et les symboles de l'autorité ne sont plus des sanctuaires inviolables, mais 

 qui n'a plus rien à perdre. La peur a changé de camp.







 




 Allons-nous continuer à regarder nos petit·es frères et sœurs, nos camarades et nos enfants se faire massacrer par une police en roue libre

 

?




 




 Finie la comédie des négociations. Quand une République tire sur ses enfants pour faire respecter son ordre pourri, la seule issue légitime, c'est l'offensive et le blocage intégral. À bas leur paix sociale : arrêtons le pays, immédiatement.







réécriture de l'article de IndyMédia.




https://nantes.indymedia.org/posts/169547/le-temps-du-soulevement-lappel-dune-jeunesse-insurrectionnelle/

title: Trump'tan İran açıklaması: “Karar verme aşamasındayım”
content:
Fotoğraf: The White House/Wikimedia Commons Public domain

ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran'la savaş ve ABD'nin İran'a yönelik politikası hakkında açıklamalarda bulundu.

Trump, Ohio eyaletinde düzenleyeceği miting için Beyaz Saray'dan ayrıldığı sırada basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtladı. İran'la savaş konusunda ABD'nin hangi aşamada olduğunun sorulması üzerine Trump, İran'a yönelik saldırıları savunarak, “İran'ı resmen yerle bir ettik” dedi.

Trump, İran konusunda henüz nihai kararını vermediğini belirterek, “Şimdi İran konusunda karar verme aşamasındayım. Tek soru şu: Biz bu süreci kolay yoldan mı yoksa zor yoldan mı halledeceğiz?” ifadelerini kullandı.

Trump, açıklamalarında ABD'deki yaz-kış saati uygulamasına da değindi.

Yılda iki kez saatlerin ileri ve geri alınmasını eleştiren Trump, uygulamanın sona erdirilmesi gerektiğini savundu. Konuyla ilgili yasa tasarısının Senato tarafından kabul edilmesi çağrısında bulunan Trump, saat değişikliğinin ülke ekonomisine yük getirdiğini ve insanların yaşam düzenini bozduğunu öne sürdü.

Trump, “Yılda iki kez saatleri ileri ve geri alma gibi saçma bir uygulamadan kurtulmak istiyoruz” dedi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: AKP'li belediyeden depremzedeye icra takibi: Ödediği tazminatı faiziyle geri istedi
content:
Antep — Şahinbey ilçesinde 6 Şubat 2023 depremlerinde hasar gören Güvenkent 1 Sitesi B Blok'a ilişkin davada, kusurlu bulunarak depremzedeye tazminat ödeyen AKP'li Şahinbey Belediyesi, kararın usulden bozulmasının ardından parasını geri istedi. Belediye, ödediği 204 bin liranın faiziyle iadesi için depremzede H.Y. hakkında icra takibi başlattı.

Maraş merkezli 6 Şubat depremlerinde Antep'in Şahinbey ilçesindeki Güvenkent 1 Sitesi B Blok'ta bulunan yapının orta hasarlı olarak tespit edilmesi üzerine H.Y. adlı yurttaş, Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesi, Şahinbey Belediyesi, Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı ile Afet ve Acil Durum Yönetimi Başkanlığının hizmet kusuru bulunduğu gerekçesiyle dava açtı. Depremzede, taşınmaz bedeli ve değer kaybı ile maddi ve manevi zararlarının karşılanmasını istedi.

Gaziantep 3. İdare Mahkemesinde görülen davada alınan bilirkişi raporunda, meydana gelen zararda, Şahinbey Belediyesi yüzde 15, Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesi yüzde 5, Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı yüzde 3, AFAD yüzde 2 oranında kusurlu bulundu.

Konut bedeli için yıpranma payı düşülerek, yüzde 20 oranında kaçınılmazlık indirimi uygulayan mahkeme, belirlediği 136 bin 991 lira 40 kuruş bedelin, idarelerin kusur oranları doğrultusunda davacıya ödenmesine hükmetti.

İdare Mahkemesi, idarelerin kusurunun 'kast' değil, 'ihmal düzeyinde' olduğunu ve üçüncü kişilerin kusurunun daha ağır bulunduğunu belirterek, davacıya ayrıca 50 bin lira manevi tazminatın kusur oranları doğrultusunda ödenmesine karar verdi.

Mahkeme, Şahinbey Belediyesinin toplam 112 bin 194 lira, Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesinin 37 bin 398 lira, Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığının 22 bin 438 lira, AFAD'ın ise 14 bin 959 lira tazminatı, başvuru tarihinden itibaren işleyecek yasal faiziyle davacıya ödemesine hükmetti.

Davalı idareler, karara karşı Gaziantep Bölge İdare Mahkemesi 9. İdari Dava Dairesine istinaf başvurusunda bulundu. İstinaf, bilirkişi raporunun yetersiz ve kusur oranlarının yeterince gerekçelendirilmemiş olması nedeniyle Gaziantep 3. İdare Mahkemesinin kararını kaldırdı.

Kararda, "Mahkemesince, dava konusu taşınmazın davacı ile mülkiyet ilişkisi netleştirilmeden, yapıların natamam olup olmadığı hususunda araştırma yapılmadan, yetersiz gerekçe içeren ve bu haliyle hükme esas alınması mümkün olmayan bilirkişi raporuna istinaden verilen istinafa konu kararda hukuka uyarlık bulunmadığı sonuç ve kanaatine varılmıştır" denilerek, dosyanın yeniden karar verilmek üzere mahkemesine gönderildiği belirtildi.

AKP'li Şahinbey Belediyesi, kararın istinaf tarafından kaldırılmasından önce depremzedeye yasal faiziyle 204 bin 639 lira ödedi. Ancak Belediye, mahkeme kararının kaldırılmasının ardından ödediği paranın iadesi için icra takibi başlattı. Söz konusu tutarın yıllık yüzde 31 oranında ve değişen oranlarda yasal faiziyle tahsil edilmesi istendi.

Depremzedenin avukatları, para iadesini reddederek icra takibine itiraz etti. Şahinbey Belediyesi ise "itiraz edilen takibe karşı itirazın iptali davası" açtı. Şahinbey Belediyesi, Gaziantep 9. Asliye Hukuk Mahkemesinde açtığı davada, "dayanaksız kalmış ödemenin, kamu zararına fırsat vermemesi için geri alınması" gerektiğini savundu.

Depremzede H.Y'nin avukatları, cevap dilekçesinde, Şahinbey Belediyesinin Gaziantep 3. İdare Mahkemesinin kararı doğrultusunda müvekkiline ödediği 204 bin 639 lira 61 kuruşun, kararın istinaf incelemesinde kaldırılmasını gerekçe göstererek iadesi için "ilamsız icra takibi" başlattığını belirtti.

Avukatların dilekçesinde, Gaziantep Bölge İdare Mahkemesi 9. İdari Dava Dairesinin kararının tam yargı davasını esastan sonuçlandıran bir ret kararı olmadığı, eksik araştırmaların tamamlanması amacıyla dosyanın ilk derece mahkemesine gönderilmesine ilişkin bir kaldırma kararı olduğu belirtildi. Bu nedenle belediye lehine kesinleşmiş ve icraya elverişli bir iade alacağının bulunmadığı ifade edildi.

Depremzede H.Y'nin avukatları, ANKA Haber Ajansından Mehmet Oflaz'a yaptıkları değerlendirmede, "Şahinbey Belediyesi, ödemiş olduğu tazminat miktarının iadesini fahiş bir faiz talebiyle birlikte icra yoluyla talep etmektedir" dedi.

Avukatlar, "Şahinbey Belediyesinin deprem nedeniyle fazlasıyla mağduriyet yaşayan vatandaşa icra takibi başlatması vicdana ve hukuka aykırılık teşkil etmektedir. Gaziantep'te açmış olduğumuz davalarda davalı sıfatıyla bulunan Gaziantep Büyükşehir Belediyesi, Şehitkamil Belediyesi ve Nurdağı Belediyesinin bu şekilde bir tutumu yok iken, Şahinbey Belediyesinin kararı yanlış yorumlayarak ödemiş olduğu tazminatın iadesini talep etmesi, davacı sıfatı bulunan vatandaşların belediyedeki işlerini zorlaştırması ve vatandaşları davadan feragate zorlaması kabul edilemez" açıklamasında bulundu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Эррико Малатеста - Социальная защита против преступности
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Социальная защита против преступности

Дата

: 2 сентября 1921

Дополнительная информация

: 

Источник

: Umanità Nova, год 2-й, №122




 Надо признать, что мы, анархисты, обрисовывая будущее общество, каким мы его желаем, – общество без хозяев и без жандармов, – в общем сделали дело слишком уж простым. 




 В то время как мы упрекаем противников в том, что они не умеют абстрагироваться от условий настоящего и считают невозможными коммунизм и анархию, – потому что воображают, будто человек должен остаться таким, каков он сегодня, со всеми своими эгоизмами, своими пороками и своими страхами, даже после того как будут устранены причины этих недостатков, – мы, со своей стороны, обходим молчанием трудности и сомнения, предполагая уже полностью достигнутыми те морализующие результаты, на которые мы рассчитываем от уничтожения экономических привилегий и от торжества свободы. 




 Так, если нам говорят, что будут люди, которые не захотят работать, мы тотчас же пускаемся в пространные рассуждения, чтобы доказать, что труд, то есть упражнение своих способностей и удовольствие от производства, есть условие человеческого благосостояния, и что поэтому нелепо думать, будто здоровые люди захотели бы уклониться от необходимости производить для сообщества, если бы труд не был, как сегодня, угнетён, эксплуатируем и презираем. 




 А если нам противопоставляют преступные, антиобщественные наклонности и привычки одной части – пусть даже самой малой – населения, мы отвечаем, что, за исключением редких и спорных случаев врождённого недуга, о которых надлежит позаботиться врачам, преступления имеют социальное происхождение и исчезли бы с изменением общественных учреждений. 




 Быть может, этот преувеличенный оптимизм, эта 

упрощенчество

, могли иметь свою долю пользы, когда анархическое общество было поистине хорошей мечтой, поспешным предвосхищением, и нужно было подталкивать к возможно более высокому идеалу и внушать энтузиазм, подчёркивая контраст между сегодняшним адом и желанным раем завтрашнего дня. 




 Но времена изменились. Государственное и капиталистическое общество находится в полном кризисе – распада или переустройства, – в зависимости от того, смогут ли революционеры и сумеют ли они дать почувствовать влияние своих концепций и своей силы; и, быть может, мы накануне первых попыток осуществления. 




 Итак, нужно немного оставить идиллические описания и картины будущего, далёкого совершенства, и смотреть на вещи такими, каковы они сегодня и каковы они будут – насколько возможно предвидеть – в ближайшем завтра. 




 Поговорим о преступности. 




 Вне всякого сомнения – это признают теперь даже самые упорные консерваторы, – что наибольшая часть преступлений, прямо или косвенно, имеет социальное происхождение; и даже та малая часть, которая берёт своё начало в природных факторах, может быть нейтрализована и исправлена соответствующими учреждениями. 




 Но социальные условия – с одной стороны, нищета и невежество, а с другой – богатство и власть с их специфическими последствиями физической и моральной деградации, – помимо того что порождают непосредственные преступные деяния, производят также привычки, душевные состояния, неспособности, которые не могут внезапно и полностью исчезнуть, как только изменятся условия, их породившие. 




 Следовательно, нужно считаться с остатком преступности; остатком, который, как мы надеемся, будет устранён более или менее быстро, но который тем временем обяжет массу трудящихся к действиям по защите. 




 Отбросив всякую мысль о наказании и мести – а ведь именно эта мысль ещё преобладает в уголовном праве, – и вдохновляясь только необходимостью защиты и желанием исправлять и помогать, мы должны искать средства для достижения цели, не впадая в опасности авторитаризма и не вступая в противоречие с системой свободы и воли, на которой мы хотим основать новое общество. 




 Проблема не легка и не допускает абсолютных и общих решений, применимых ко всем случаям, ко всем местам и ко всем временам. 




 Для авторитариев, для государственных людей вопрос прост: Законодательный корпус, чтобы классифицировать преступления и предписывать наказания, полиция, чтобы разыскивать преступников, магистратура, чтобы судить их, корпус тюремщиков, чтобы заставлять их страдать. И, как естественно, законодательный корпус стремится с помощью уголовных законов защищать прежде всего сложившиеся интересы, которые он представляет, и обезопасить государство от попыток «ниспровергателей»; полиция; живущая подавлением преступлений, заинтересована в том, чтобы преступления совершались, становится провокатором и развивает в своих людях зверские и извращённые инстинкты; магистратура живёт и процветает тоже благодаря преступлению и преступникам, служит интересам правительства и господствующих классов и приобретает в упражнении своего ремесла особую ментальность, которая делает из неё машину для осуждения возможно большего числа людей к возможно более тяжким наказаниям; тюремщики либо уже нечувствительны, либо становятся нечувствительными к страданиям заключённых и, в лучшем случае, пассивно соблюдают правила, без единого проблеска человеческого сочувствия. Результаты видны в статистике преступности. Меняют уголовные законы, реформируют полицию и магистратуру, изменяют тюремные системы… а преступность продолжается и сопротивляется всем попыткам уничтожить или ослабить её. И это верно для прошлого и настоящего, и мы полагаем, что это будет верно и в будущем, если радикально не изменить понятие преступления и не упразднить все органы, живущие на розыске и подавлении преступности.

title: Aydın’da 9 katlı binada yangın: Mahsur kalan 5 kişi dumandan etkilendi
content:
Aydın — Efeler ilçesinde gece saatlerinde 9 katlı binanın 2’nci katında yangın çıktı. Yangın sırasında binada mahsur kalanlar itfaiye ekipleri tarafından tahliye edilirken 5 kişi dumandan etkilendi.

Yangın, saat 00.40 sıralarında Umurlu Mahallesi Adnan Menderes Bulvarı’nda bulunan 9 katlı binanın 2'nci katındaki dairede çıktı. Henüz bilinmeyen nedenle başlayan yangını görenler durumu itfaiye ekiplerine bildirdi. Alevler kısa sürede büyürken duman binanın içerisine yayıldı.

İhbar üzerine olay yerine çok sayıda itfaiye, polis ve sağlık ekibi sevk edildi. Apartmanda mahsur kalan yurttaşlar, ekiplerin çalışmasıyla tahliye edilirken, 5 kişinin dumandan etkilendiği öğrenildi.

Dumandan etkilenen yurttaşların bazıları ambulansta sağlık kontrolünden geçirilirken, bazılarının ise çevredeki hastanelere kaldırıldığı belirtildi.

İtfaiye ekipleri yangını söndürürken olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

author: Jim McIlroy
title: Snap protest demands Labor pressure US to stop its war on Cuba, Venezuela
content:
The Australia-Cuba Friendship Society (ACFS) and the Australia-Venezuela Solidarity Network (AVSN) called a snap rally on October 3 to demand the United States stop threatening and blockading Cuba, Venezuela and Latin America.

It was part of an international day, called by the US United National Anti-War Coalition, to defend the sovereignty of Latin America, particularly Cuba and Venezuela.

US peace organisation CODEPINK said on September 30 that it had information that the US Army Reserve was preparing to invade Cuba, in three to four months’ time. The US Southern Command is allegedly massing military police, engineers, medical units, battlefield surgical capacity and major logistics forces.

The rally demanded that the federal Labor federal government call on the US government to stop its invasion plans of Cuba and lift the 60-year blockade, and end the 10-year blockade on Venezuela.

It also called for Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and Cilia Flores’s release from the notorious US Federal Prison in Brooklyn, where they have imprisoned for eight months on trumped-up charges of drug trafficking.

Coral Wynter, from AVSN and Socialist Alliance (SA), told the rally: “All of Latin America is now under threat from a resurgence of the 19th century Monroe doctrine, with fascist-leaning, US-dominated puppet governments agreeing to US military bases and foreign interference.

“The US commits silent genocides on the people of Latin America with its illegal sanctions. We cannot let this happen. We cannot remain silent in the face of imperialist aggression. History is written by people who rise up and fight for justice,” Wynter said.

Other speakers included Patrick Newbold from ACFS and Red Spark, and myself from AVSN and SA.
