Debattenbeitrag von 

Rote Wende Leipzig







Von der revolutionären Sozialdemokratie Liebknechts und Bebels über die USPD und KPD durch die historische Zäsur des faschistischen Massenmordes auch an deutschen Kommunisten bis hin zu den sogenannten „K-Gruppen“ der 1970er und 1980er Jahre – so liest sich die historische Selbstverordnung der kommunistischen Bewegung in einem kürzlich erschienen LCM-Artikel, in dem darüber hinaus viel vom sogenannten „Kontinuitätsproblem“ roter Gruppen die Rede ist, denen sich lebendig entwickelnde, politische Bezugspunkte aus dem eigenen Land mit Verbot der KPD 1956 quasi abhanden gekommen worden wären. Damit steht der Autor bei weitem nicht alleine da: Erst im Sommer dieses Jahres durften wir staunend dem Vortrag einer bundesweiten, kommunistischen Struktur entnehmen, dass man in Deutschland ja leider Gottes keine direkten historischen Bezugspunkte zum Sozialismus hat. Es hätte kein plakativeres Beispiel dafür geben können, dass „bundesweit“ in unserer Bewegung auch heutzutage noch in den meisten Fällen ein Synonym für „westdeutsch“ bleibt.




Die Tatsache, dass es von 1949 bis 1990 einen sozialistischen Staat in Deutschland gab, wird in öffentlichen Beiträgen von bzw. Diskussionen mit den meisten roten Organisationen geflissentlich ausgespart. Das Verhältnis unserer im Aufschwung befindlichen Bewegung zur eigenen sozialistischen Geschichte ist dadurch maßgeblich von einem erstaunlichen Ausmaß an Ignoranz geprägt. Dabei ist diese Ignoranz kein Zufall, sondern Konsequenz aus über 35 Jahren harter antikommunistischer Arbeit: Neben der totalen wirtschaftlichen und politischen Annexion der DDR wurden nach 1990 Tonnen von Büchern und Archivmaterial vernichtet, stolze DDR- Bürger aus sämtlichen Führungspositionen in Kulturbetrieb, Bildungswesen und Medienlandschaft entfernt und in den Städten hunderte Symbolbauten, aber auch einfache Wohnsiedlungen abgerissen und dabei teilweise ganz bewusst der Eindruck der Vorkriegszeit architektonisch wieder hergestellt (z.B. Innenstadt Dresden, Museumsinsel Berlin).




Das „demokratische Erfolgsprojekt deutsche Einheit“ war gleichzeitig ein überaus erfolgreiches Programm des BRD-Monopolkapitals, die Erfolge des Sozialismus im eigenen Land so schnell wie möglich zu verleugnen und (im wortwörtlichen Sinne) verschwinden zu lassen. Wie für unsere Genossen in anderen Ländern der Welt auch muss doch aber der politische Kampf für Partei, Revolution und Sozialismus dort ansetzen, wo er historisch zuletzt geschlagen wurde. Und das wurde er in Deutschland weder von der KPD, noch von den westdeutschen „K-Gruppen“ der 1970er, sondern bis 1990 von einem sozialistischen, ostdeutschen Staat mit 40-jähriger Geschichte.




Objektiv betrachtet war diese eine Erfolgsgeschichte, nur leider wird sie selten objektiv betrachtet. Wer der DDR wegen Vorbehalten gegenüber Honecker, dem MfS, der Mauer o.ä. absprechen will, ein erfolgreicher, sozialistischer Staat gewesen zu sein, argumentiert nicht marxistisch, sondern eher wie ein arbeitsscheuer Linkspartei-Fan, der ernst gemeinte Argumente gerne mit „In meinem Sozialismus gibt es aber…“ einleitet. Fakt ist, dass die DDR praktisch bewiesen hat, dass das, was wir heute als recht abstrakte ökonomische Forderungen auf die Straßen bringen, innerhalb deutscher Verhältnisse funktioniert: Sozialistisches Eigentum, Betriebe in Arbeiterhand und eine staatlich gelenkte und überaus produktive Planwirtschaft – all das hat es bis 1990 in unserem eigenen Land gegeben.




Kommunisten in anderen Staaten würden ihre Niere für die praktischen wie ideologischen Möglichkeiten verkaufen, die es in sich birgt, den Sozialismus im eigenen Land nicht aufbauen zu müssen, sondern wiederaufbauen zu können. Deutsche Kommunisten schreiben trotzdem Texte über „Kontinuitätsprobleme“.




Doch warum tun sie das? Entgegen der weitläufigen Meinung vieler (westdeutscher) Genossen ist die kategorische Ablehnung der DDR unter denen, die sie tatsächlich erlebt haben, nämlich eine eher seltene Einstellung. Selbst hinter einem polemischen „

wollen wir nicht wieder

“ steckt bei den meisten Ostdeutschen Urhebern keine gefestigt antikommunistische Haltung, sondern eine Verbindung von einigen subjektiven Unzufriedenheiten aus DDR-Zeiten mit Ergebnissen der mächtigen, bundesdeutschen Ideologieproduktion.




Darunter kommen jedoch auch heutzutage noch Elemente einer ostdeutschen Identität zum Vorschein, die von der Annexion und dem damit verbundenen Verlust der Lebensgrundlagen ebenso materiell geprägt wurde, wie von zahllosen positiven Erinnerungen an das „Damals“ und die sich primär in Abgrenzung zum hyperindividualisierten Kapitalismus westdeutscher Prägung definiert. Dass sich das Erbe der DDR in den Köpfen ihrer ehemaligen Bewohner und deren Nachkommen bisher kaum in Affinität für zeitgenössische kommunistische Politik geäußert hat, liegt nicht an ostdeutschen Köpfen, sondern primär an der zeitgenössischen kommunistischen Politik. Eine Bewegung, die sich so extrem daran orientiert, was der neue heiße Scheiß an westdeutschen linken Hochschulen ist und entsprechend von A wie Anglizismen bis V wie Veganismus vieles verkörpert, was ostdeutschen Proleten als Inbegriff westdeutscher Abgehobenheit gilt, wird dieses Proletariat niemals organisieren und seine historische Prägung entsprechend auch nicht für sich nutzen können.




Ein wesentliches Element der Nutzbarmachung der oft eher instinktiven als politisch bewussten Opposition von Millionen von Ostdeutschen gegenüber der heutigen BRD ist ein simples Argument unserer Bewegung, das vor lauter Fachdebatten manchmal ins Hintertreffen gerät: Das gute Leben. Die Sicherung eines höchstmöglichen Lebensstandards für die Arbeiterklasse war staatliches Ziel der DDR, Wohnungswesen, Bildungs- und Gesundheitssystem praktische Antworten auf einige der drängendsten sozialen Fragen unserer Zeit. Beispiele wie das bedarfsorientierte Gesundheitssystem oder die mehr als doppelt so vielen Wohnungen pro 10.000 Einwohner mehr als heute (mit 3-5% des Einkommens als Miete) fallen hierbei unter das bereits angebrachte Argument der DDR als historischer Beweis für den Wahrheitsgehalt kommunistischer Theorie. „Das gute Leben“ ist als politisches Argument noch niedrigschwelliger nutzbar: Den Menschen ging es im Sozialismus besser, folglich wird es ihnen auch in einem noch zu erkämpfenden Sozialismus besser gehen.




Die Ebene, auf der wir Menschen mit diesem Argument dazu bewegen können, sich mit sozialistischer Politik zu identifizieren, braucht keine historische (z.B. Russland 1917) und auch keine internationalistische (z.B. „schau doch mal nach Rojava“) Abstraktion von ihrer Alltagserfahrung. Es ist die Ebene der grundlegendsten alltäglichen Bedürfnisse: Soziale Absicherung und keine Obdachlosigkeit. Kultur, Sport und Arbeit eng verbunden in Betriebssportgemeinschaften und Kulturhäusern, nachbarschaftliche Kollektivität statt Vereinzelung und Einsamkeit, Jugendorganisationen statt Social Media- Sucht etc.




Das Erbe der DDR, lebendig in den Erinnerungen ihrer Zeitzeugen, ist nicht nur historisches Beispiel für die volkswirtschaftlichen und sozialpolitischen Erfolge des Sozialismus, sondern auch dafür, weshalb es sich für jeden einzelnen Arbeiter gerade heutzutage wieder lohnt, dafür zu kämpfen.




Zwischen unseren aktuellen Parteiaufbaubestrebungen und der Möglichkeit, das Erbe der DDR als gemeinsame historische Verpflichtung aller deutschen Kommunisten zum sozialistischen Wiederaufbau zu begreifen, liegen weder ein den Massen unterstellter Anti-DDR-Dogmatismus, noch unsauber argumentierte Analysen über eine vermeintliche „Ausbeuterklasse“ aus SED-Funktionären. Von diesem erstrebenswerten Ziel trennen uns in erster Linie Unwissen, in zweiter Linie politische Feigheit. Unwissen über all die Erfolge des DDR-Sozialismus, dessen tatsächliche politische und ökonomische Beschaffenheit und deren Übereinstimmungen mit unseren heutigen politischen Forderungen. Aber auch politische Feigheit, der Tatsache ins Auge zu sehen, dass die eigene Un- bzw. Fehlinformiertheit oft keine „abweichende Analyse“, sondern ganz im Gegenteil gewünschtes Ergebnis antikommunistischer Propaganda ist, die man dadurch aktiv mitverbreitet.




Um an dieser Stelle den Bogen zum Einstieg in unseren Artikel zu spannen: Nicht nur vereinzelt auftretende Fehlanalysen kommunistischer Gruppen zum Thema DDR machen sich indirekt dem Mitwirken am BRD-Ideologieapparat schuldig. Wir reden der herrschenden Klasse tatsächlich sogar am ehesten dann nach dem Mund, wenn wir die DDR gar nicht erst erwähnen. Den Palast der Republik abzureißen war ein Kinderspiel für den BRD-Antikommunismus, sogar selbstbezeichnende Sozialisten 40 Jahre sozialistische Herrschaft im eigenen Land vergessen zu lassen sein Meisterstück. Es gehört zu unseren historischen Aufgaben im Parteiaufbauprozess, die künstlich geschaffene Lücke zwischen unserer Bewegung und diesen 40 Jahren sozialistischer Herrschaft zu schließen – fernab von hängengebliebener Nostalgie und ignoranter Verteufelung.




Wer von der DDR nicht lernen und ihr Erbe nicht für sich nutzen will, soll vom Aufbau des Sozialismus in Deutschland schweigen.







Der Beitrag 

Wer hat Angst vor der DDR?

 erschien zuerst auf 

Lower Class Magazine

.

author: Luis Cosme Pinto
title: Melhor do mundo
content:
Faltam 28 minutos pro domingo virar segunda e o vagão só esvazia na estação Guilhermina-Esperança. O ambulante me cumprimenta com a cabeça, senta e acomoda a sacola preta entre as pernas. Estico o pescoço e vejo, lá dentro, algumas cocadas.




Parece que o dia foi bom, mesmo assim quero perguntar das vendas. Daria, com muito prazer, um pouco do meu tempo, do meu sono e até parte do que tenho na carteira para saber não só das cocadas. Quero conhecer, um tiquinho que seja, este trabalhador. Quem vende cocadas até o último trem do domingo tem muito pra contar.




Dou sorte. Mesmo tendo falado o dia inteiro de suas cocadas, que são gostosas, que desfazem na boca, que são baratas, que são mineiras e que vêm direto do Vale do Jequitinhonha, ele ainda quer falar.




Ajeita o boné, pigarreia.




— Meu nome é Getúlio. Getúlio Pereira da Silva. G. P. S. Nunca me perco. Entendeu? (rimos os dois) Mas sou conhecido como Raimundo. Eu explico: Pro ambulante, o marketing é tudo. Entro no vagão e anuncio: “Chegou a melhor cocada do mundo, a cocada do Raimundo”. Eu experimentei essa publicidade porque a rima é boa e eu sempre adorei o nome Raimundo. Tem passageiro que comenta. “Olha aí o Raimundo”. Então, deixa ficar. Virei Raimundo. Quer provar uma? É de graça que hoje esvaziei a sacola três vezes.




Aceito e me delicio com a doce mistura de coco e rapadura.




— Cremosa, né?




— Maravilhosa, Raimundo. Respondo com a boca ainda cheia e uma lasca de coco entre os dentes.




— Tem uns que reclamam da confusão. A gente grita mesmo. O jogador não pede a bola? O motoboy não buzina? O feirante não zoa? Por que a gente não pode? Ninguém é obrigado a saber da vida dos outros, mas será que eles sabem que, por trás de uma cocada, tem uma criança com fome, às vezes doente? Que tem aluguel, um monte de boletos, agiota te ameaçando?




— Quantos filhos você tem?




— Três. Olha aqui no celular. Anderson, Henrique e a caçula, a Marcela.




— Eu não peço nada, eu ofereço. Quem quer, quer. Quem não quer, não quer.




— Muita gente compra?




— Compra. E sabe por quê?




— Por quê?




— Porque o produto é bom e barato. E tem mais (ele sussurra): pobre não tem medo de gastar. Ele me vê e pensa: amanhã eu posso tá desempregado, posso ter que trabalhar como camelô. Então, eu ajudo agora e, se depois eu tiver no sufoco, alguém vai dar uma força.




— Mas dizem que é barato porque é clandestino.




— Mentira. É barato porque não tem intermediário; no supermercado o preço é maior porque eles têm muito mais despesas e também querem mais lucro. Aqui é diferente, vou no depósito e pago à vista.




— Então, por que é proibido?




— Porque é fácil mexer com o pobre. Eu garanto pro senhor. Meu produto não deve nada ao do supermercado. Eu ando de metrô e de trem todo dia e pago a passagem, viu? Eu sou camelô e passageiro ao mesmo tempo e garanto: a gente não atrapalha ninguém. Sabe o que atrapalha?




— O quê?




— O 

atraso e a superlotação

. Tem que botar mais trens para circular. Só que a empresa ou o governo não quer gastar. É simples: com o trem cheio ganham mais. Agora, com a privatização, o que já era ruim ficou pior. Os vigilantes vêm pra cima como se o camelô fosse um bandido. Eu não sou bandido, sou empreendedor.




— Você manda bem, Raimundo. Já tinha falado de marketing, publicidade, agora empreendedor.




— Estudei um pouco. Empreendedor, eu ouvi essa no tempo que tinha passeata, sindicato. Durante um protesto, um cara subiu no caminhão e disse bem assim: Camelô é empreendedor e empreendedor é quem faz o Brasil crescer, nunca esqueci.




— Já tomaram sua mercadoria?




— Já, mas não desanimo. Toda profissão tem risco e eu adoro esse meu trabalho. Só que as autoridades não dão valor. Eles podiam cadastrar a gente.




— Como seria?




— Um número certo de ambulantes em cada trem, todo mundo com crachá, uniforme. Trabalho organizado.




Última estação. Getúlio levanta e me olha.




— Ué, não vai descer?




— Vou voltar. Vim até aqui para te ouvir.




A porta fecha e a gente acena um pro outro.




A voz feminina se impõe.




— Diamante Negro na promoção: é 3 por 5, que eu não brinco.

author: Wanessa Celina
title: A “bancada” anti-indígena que vai às urnas neste domingo
content:
Nas duas últimas legislaturas no Congresso Brasileiro, 370 deputados e senadores foram responsáveis por propostas de lei que enfraquecem os direitos indígenas — e 270 deles disputam reeleição neste ano. Ao todo, esses políticos atuaram em 252 projetos, a maioria incidindo negativamente sobre o direito à terra para esses povos.




As informações são baseadas em um levantamento da 

Agência Pública

 a partir da nova plataforma lançada pelo Conselho Indigenista Missionário (Cimi), o 

Congresso Anti-Indígena

.




Entre os projetos de lei que afetam os indígenas, estão propostas que buscavam anular decretos de demarcação de territórios e outros que alteram a Constituição Federal, para que as decisões sobre a demarcação sejam feitas pelo Congresso Nacional — justamente onde estão os políticos que atuam contra a demarcação de mais terras.




Para Cleber Buzatto, missionário do Cimi Regional Sul, essa atuação mostra que o principal interesse é impedir as demarcações e também explorar as terras.




“Isso demonstra uma articulação dos setores anti-indígenas, seja do ponto de vista político, mas, também, dos grupos econômicos que têm interesses sobre as terras, portanto, se organizam e atuam de forma bastante enfática e violenta contra os direitos indígenas no Congresso Nacional por meio de um conjunto amplo de partidos e parlamentares”, explica Buzzatto.




Entre 513 deputados e deputadas federais eleitos em 2022, apenas cinco se autodeclaram indígenas, menos de 1% do total. Como a 

Pública

 

mostrou

, neste ano, o movimento indígena lançou 47 pré-candidaturas para tentar mudar esse quadro

.

 “É importante que os próprios povos [indígenas] consigam acessar espaços nessas casas legislativas, especialmente no âmbito da Câmara dos Deputados, que é onde tem mais candidatos indígenas disputando as vagas, até para que essa diretriz seja coerente com a defesa de fato dos direitos e dos interesses dos projetos de vida e futuro dos povos indígenas”, afirma.




Atualmente, segundo dados do Cimi, 291 propostas legislativas que impactam os direitos indígenas tramitam no Congresso Nacional. Entre elas, 204 têm efeitos negativos, segundo o levantamento.




PL, de Bolsonaro, é o principal partido a votar em propostas anti-indígenas, aponta levantamento




A partir da análise de mais de 41 mil votos, a plataforma identificou, dentre os partidos políticos, 19 que votaram sempre ou quase sempre em projetos que vão contra os povos indígenas. Apenas oito partidos votaram favoravelmente.




O Partido Liberal (PL), do candidato à presidência Flávio Bolsonaro, fica em primeiro lugar tanto entre os partidos cujos políticos mais propuseram propostas anti-indígenas, quanto entre os parlamentares que mais votam em projetos contrários aos direitos desses povos. São 95 proposições e 6.630 votos desfavoráveis segundo a classificação do Cimi. Em seguida, está o MDB, com 47 proposições, e o Partido Progressista (PP), com 42. Já entre os partidos cujos políticos tiveram mais votos em projetos contrários aos direitos indígenas, após o PL, está o PP, com 3.232 votos, e, em terceiro lugar, o União, com 3.063.




Por outro lado, o Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT), do presidente e candidato Lula, é o que mais teve propostas e votos em projetos classificados como favoráveis aos indígenas, com 4.971 a favor e 71 proposições. Em seguida, está o PSB, com 1.127 votos a favor, e o PDT, com 1.114 votos. O PCdoB, mesmo com apenas 11 deputados na Câmara, tem 100% dos votos direcionados a pautas consideradas favoráveis aos indígenas. Após o PT, entre os partidos que mais propuseram propostas favoráveis, estão o Psol, com 31 propostas.




Políticos que fizeram mais propostas com efeitos negativos aos direitos indígenas, segundo o levantamento







Deputado federal Marcos Pollon (PL-MS)

























Candidato à reeleição para deputado federal pelo Mato Grosso do Sul, o deputado tem um total de 26 propostas classificadas como contrárias aos direitos indígenas, sendo 24 delas sobre o direito territorial dos povos tradicionais. O deputado é o terceiro-secretário da Frente Parlamentar 

Invasão Zero

, grupo criado em 2023 que defende o direito à propriedade contra o Marco Temporal.




Entre as principais propostas do deputado está o PL 2145/2023, que altera o “Estatuto do Índio” para impedir o reconhecimento de determinadas áreas como de ocupação tradicional. Já o PDL 521/2025 impede a atuação da Força Nacional em apoio à Funai na Terra Indígena Rio dos Índios (RS) e o PL 4039/2024 obriga a União a indenizar não indígenas em áreas que ocorreu esbulho por indígenas e que não eram demarcadas.




A reportagem procurou a assessoria do deputado, que afirmou, 

em nota

, não reconhecer o Cimi como “autoridade para julgar meu mandato” e que seu trabalho para os povos originários é para que eles “tenham reconhecido o direito de propriedade das terras que ocupam e possam produzir e prosperar nessas áreas, sem violência no campo.”. O deputado também cita que atuou como consultor jurídico em 2015 durante a Comissão Parlamentar de Inquérito (CPI) do Cimi, criada para investigar as ações do órgão no estado. A CPI foi 

anulada

 pelo Tribunal Regional Federal da 3ª Região (TRF3), que a Assembleia Legislativa de Mato Grosso do Sul não tinha competência para realizar a CPI.







Senador Luis Carlos Heinze (PP-RS)






















Com 15 propostas classificadas como anti-indígenas, todas elas com relação ao direito territorial, o senador Luis Carlos Heinze, que teve passagem na Câmara dos Deputados e no Senado, ocupa o segundo lugar entre os políticos que mais propuseram leis contra os indígenas.




Vale lembrar que em 2014, durante um evento com agricultores no Rio Grande do Sul, Heinze, que era deputado, foi gravado dizendo que 

“índios, quilombolas, gays e lésbicas tudo não prestava”.




Entre as propostas de autoria do senador, estão três Propostas de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) que transferem do Poder Executivo para o Congresso Nacional a atribuição de demarcar terras indígenas, as PECs 61/2023, 319/2004 e 59/2023.




Questionado sobre sua posição diante a classificação que suas propostas são contrárias aos povos indígenas, Heinze em 

nota

 à 

Pública 

afirma que “suas propostas não são contrárias aos povos indígenas”. Segundo o senador, sua atuação  “é pautada pelo respeito e defesa do direito de propriedade e da segurança jurídica no campo, garantindo a proteção aos produtores que possuem o título legítimo de suas terras” e também defendeu a inclusão dos povos originários “deve passar pela autonomia e pelo desenvolvimento econômico”.







Senador Zequinha Marinho (Pode-PA)

























Concorrendo à reeleição no Senado, Zequinha Marinho é autor de 13 proposições legislativas que interferem no direito territorial dos povos indígenas.




Além de criar a PEC 10/2024, que modifica o artigo 231 da Constituição Federal para “permitir aos índios [sic] produzir e comercializar livremente sua produção”, que abre brechas jurídicas para a entrada do agronegócio em territórios reservados, o senador é também assina a PEC 59/2023, que retira o poder do Ministério da Justiça e da Presidência da República para decidir sobre demarcações, colocando o tema sob crivo dos parlamentares.




A reportagem procurou a assessoria do senador, que não respondeu.







Deputada Coronel Fernanda (PL-MT)

























Com 13 proposições classificadas como contrárias aos indígenas, e concorrendo para a reeleição na câmara dos deputados, a deputada Coronel Fernanda apresentou propostas que também podem gerar danos ao meio ambiente.




O PDL 466/2023, de sua autoria, suspende o decreto nº 11.367/2023, que recriou o Plano de Ação para Prevenção e Controle do Desmatamento na Amazônia Legal (PPCDAm), enfraquecendo ferramentas de proteção ambiental e de enfrentamento à grilagem.




Também é de sua autoria o PDL 380/2024, que suspende resolução do Conselho Nacional de Política Indigenista que recomenda ao Governo Federal a inclusão do tema da demarcação das terras indígenas como eixo do Plano Clima.




Procurada, a assessoria da deputada não respondeu.

author: Unknown
title: It’s not just ‘know your audience’. Having one set of words for the in-crowd and one set of words…
content:
queershephard

:

queeranarchism

:

queeranarchism

:

A lot of people become insufferable when you point out that

“You need to learn a dozen new 6-syllable words derived from Greek to participate in our conversation” 

and 

“our entire community is white college-graduates and all our efforts to diversify have failed” 

constantly overlap for really obvious reasons. 

#you would think those 6 syllable words were being taken away

Well, yes, kinda. I’m not cancelling words but I am challenging people to think of possible easier words. 

If the best thing we can come up with for “stop doing man/woman and cis/trans binaries!” is ‘exorsexism’, we’re shit at accessible communication. Sorry, not sorry. 

If the Germans can call combined oral contraceptives 'anti-baby-pills’, then we can decide to come up with simpler, more intuitive and easier-to-remember words for the concepts that we want a lot of people of all backgrounds to understand. 

So many replies and responses are essentially versions of “oh so you want us to reduce language and only use stupid words” and the actual point OP is making is — know your audience. 

Creating jargon is absolutely fine. Having new words to describe complex sociological issues is absolutely fine. But MOST people aren’t at a place to intuitively understand jargon. And so if you’re trying to create a mass politic for the left, do you want to sound ‘smart’ or do you want to build a coalition? Because if you want to coalition, you have to know who you’re talking to and what words will be effective and how your message can come across. 

Otherwise you’re just being Sheldon Cooper from the Big Bang Theory, and you will turn people off not because you’re wrong, but because you are perceived as a know-it-all condescending prick (regardless of your intent).  




It’s not just 'know your audience’. Having one set of words for the in-crowd and one set of words for everyone else would just amplify the effect where a lot of people just do not feel welcome in our spaces because they sound like white academia spaces. 

So I’m also saying: if we’re creating jargon, why are we constantly creating jargon by borrowing from the academic tradition of

 'translate it to greek or latin and slap it all together into one word’? 

instead of thinking 'what word is easy to remember and easy to understand for the largest number of people’?

Antibabypille is six syllables, but most people would know what it means without anyone explaining the meaning, and after hearing it once or twice they would remember it and be able to use it in a sentence. That’s what good jargon could try to be like.

author: Unknown
title: Xebat Andok: The process needs to become more inclusive of society
content:
KCK Executive Council member Xebat Andok gave an in-depth interview to Stêrk TV.




The first part of the interview can be read 

here

. 




The Peace and Democratic Society Process has been ongoing for two years. But when we look at the Turkish side – specifically the role that the media is playing – even their rhetoric hasn’t changed. Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan is being directly targeted. At the same time, they are not granting him any means to defend himself. Is their still an opposition to the Peace and Democratic Society Process?




Yes, there are certain circles, both inside and outside the country, that oppose the process. One has to look at the Turkish state’s media and their rhetoric. Then again, state officials have made various statements from time to time. They said that they would change the narrative of their media. But to this day, we haven’t really seen much of that. They act opportunistically from time to time. Sometimes people wonder if they’ll make some changes, but then they revert to their default settings. The reason for this isn’t that journalists perceive these issues correctly or speak about them in that way. No, that’s not the source of the problem. Essentially, everyone knows that journalism in Turkey is dependent on the Turkish state in every respect. It is primarily the state itself that coordinates them and sets their daily agenda. Therefore, if they truly wanted to – if they genuinely sought to prepare Turkish society for this process – they could change the language of the media to some extent.




If there were an independent media, they would express their own independent views. But there is no such thing. But the source is still the state’s approach. In other words, because the state’s approach is flawed, the media’s approach is the same. The free press, for instance, is not like that. The free press has truly changed its rhetoric and its approach. There are, of course, shortcomings, but at least, in order for the process to succeed, it’s trying to act in accordance with the spirit of the process. People can at least see and feel this effort. But nothing like this is seen in the Turkish press. In fact, they play the exact opposite role. There are different approaches – different approaches from international powers. There are also differences among social forces, among the Kurds, and within Turkey itself. Not everyone takes this approach. Who wouldn’t want Turkey to become more democratic? There are those who take this approach. Among the Kurds, too, there are those with different views. They identify themselves in different ways. But ultimately, there are approaches that, through their actions and words, do nothing but harm the Kurdish and Kurdistan cause. However, they are not very numerous. They do not play a decisive role and are not able to disrupt the process.




Then again, there is also the level of the international powers. They are, after all, responsible for the emergence of the Kurdish issue. It is these international powers that created the Kurdish issue alongside the Turkish nation-state mentality. And they see themselves as the masters of the world. Kurdistan is a highly strategic location. All of these powers are in the Middle East. And they have a mindset of interventionism. They have their own views and practices regarding the process. They exert a great deal of influence on the process to ensure it becomes even more uncertain or progresses even slower so that it cannot achieve its own objectives in a short time. There are certain efforts and projects aimed at worsening the situation, as well as numerous different promises regarding the dynamics of the Kurdish people. Because they form a very large force, and everyone acknowledges this. Their numbers are estimated at around 60 million. They are scattered all over the world. But now, they are asserting their existence. They no longer accept their absence and are fighting back. They are acting without a state or a defined identity. They have immense potential to harness this dynamic for their own purposes. Therefore, to prevent the emergence of measures that are misguided – that do not serve the Kurdish people, the peoples of the region, or even the states in the region – the Turkish state must approach this issue with a more trustworthy stance from the outset. If this does not happen, there are far too many factors that will undermine this process.




Following the call of Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan, many efforts were carried out in the political and social spheres, as well as within political parties. Patriotic and democratic circles conducted numerous activities. They held meetings, conferences, and rallies. How do you assess these efforts?




There is indeed a sense of momentum. One cannot allege that there is no ownership of the process. There is genuinely a sense of ownership. But this needs to be even greater because this is a very crucial process. If it succeeds, it will bring about many changes. If it fails, it will lead to very different outcomes. With this awareness, everyone must see themselves more responsible for this process and be actively involved in it. There are some shortcomings in this regard. Of course, discussions about the process are taking place, but there is a need to engage in it even further. Some discussions are taking place in the form of conferences, workshops, and similar formats. These are necessary, and it is good for them to occur among academics, representatives of civil society, and similar circles. But this should not be limited to these settings. If it remains limited to these, then the discussions will remain confined to an elite circle.




There is a need for the process to become more inclusive of society. All segments of society must see themselves as part of this process and feel included in it. For this reason, there is a need for these discussions and debates on the process to be conducted more with the public. Society must have more information about the process. It must understand it, organize itself accordingly, and engage in activities based on that understanding. This aspect is somewhat lacking. Again, for example, rallies, there really aren’t enough rallies and such mass social actions. More could be done. A much larger number of people could demand peace. People might call for concrete steps to be taken. There is a process underway; therefore, we need to see a direct demand regarding this process. Because this process is about Turkey’s democratization. It is about resolving the Kurdish issue. From the perspective of society and social forces, this is the case. But from the perspective of the Turkish state, it is about a ‘Turkey Without Terrorism.’ Because not everyone understands this process in the same way.




Since we understand things differently, we need to be more active in accordance with our own understanding and observations. There are shortcomings in this regard. In some circles, a great deal of skepticism and doubt is being voiced. But how effective is it to solely voice skepticism and doubt? It is more appropriate for people not to prioritize things that do not benefit society. Whatever is beneficial to society should be the standard for people. They should take it as their basis. What can be achieved regarding the state simply by voicing doubts and skepticism? Since you have so many doubts and skepticism, you are deriving them from the state itself. Those who harbor the most doubts and skepticism should be the most active. Since they do not trust the state and say that the state is playing a game, they must fight against this and achieve something. Voicing doubts and suspicions, undermining the public’s trust in this process, saying that nothing will come of this no matter what, and acting on that basis is a wrong stance. One should not adopt this stance. It serves no purpose.




On the other hand, there are those with overly high expectations. They think as if this were an easy process. As if, after years of war, the parties had suddenly come to their senses, launched a process, and this process would easily lead to success. No, it’s not like that. People should not harbor such expectations. Rêber Apo made this clear from the very first day. He said, “Do not give in to excessive anxiety and doubts; nor should you give in to excessive enthusiasm, excitement, or unrealistic expectations.” Expectations regarding this process will be shaped by the extent of our struggle, as well as by the expectations of democratic and patriotic forces. That is how it is. This process is a process of struggle. We are demanding our very existence. Therefore, those who want democracy, those who want freedom, those who want the social problems resolved, and those who want the Kurdish issue resolved must all join hands and make themselves part of this struggle.




Rêber Apo is the chief negotiator, but we cannot place the entire burden of the struggle on his shoulders. Rêber Apo is also conducting a struggle; that is a separate matter, but the primary role he currently plays – on behalf of the freedom movement, on behalf of the Kurdish people, and on behalf of democratic forces – is negotiation. However, the struggle is everyone’s responsibility. We will strengthen our struggle. We will organize ourselves in every respect. We will educate ourselves as much as necessary, raise our consciousness, organize, and become active. We will move beyond this passive or minimally active stance. We will place ourselves at the heart of this struggle. We will wage a powerful struggle that will compel the Turkish state to undergo change and transformation. In this way, we will ensure that Rêber Apo can negotiate with greater confidence and that this issue is resolved. In other words, there is a general stance and a sense of momentum. But we need to focus more on this and overcome existing shortcomings. We need to make the process more inclusive. A general sense of trust must be established in society. Society must weave itself into this process. Everyone must actively engage in this process.




In addition to the Kurdish issue and the search for its resolution, there are also social, political, and economic crises in Turkey. Most recently, a financial crisis has emerged, and AKP officials are also implicated in this financial crisis. In your view, why are these problems arising? How should they be interpreted? How should democratic, pro-peace, and revolutionary forces address these issues? What do they need to do to resolve them?




Even though these social problems may seem to be detached from each other, they are directly linked to the Kurdish issue – that is, all social, economic, and even issues of violence and the like are linked to the prevailing of the Kurdish issue. Whatever social problems the Turkish state and Turkish society face, they are directly linked to democratization and the Kurdish issue. The issue of funds is a matter in and of itself. One can discuss this topic separately. Ultimately, it is a matter of speculation – making money without putting in the work. Consequently, the issue is also linked to ethics and has many aspects that need to be addressed. But this is a separate issue and discussion. The Turkish state has reached such a state that the issue is no longer just about funds. The discussion regarding the funds has been ongoing for a couple of days. Alongside this, the central referees committee issue has emerged, and their chairman was arrested following allegations of match-fixing. Corruption is at its peak. It’s as if everyone is taking whatever they can from whoever they can.




There seems to be neither a principle nor a rule. It is a world where whoever has the power takes whoever they want, wherever they want, and whoever can profit from whichever angle they choose. Yet existence, in and of itself, is something governed by rules. Within the universe, in all things within the universe, everything has a rule and procedures. Why is this state so lawless? Why is gang activity so prominent within this state? Why is lawlessness so prominent? Why is self-interest so prominent? Why do things that arise outside the rules and order of being a state take such center stage? These issues need to be addressed. When looking at the Turkish state, one can see a state that is rotten from within. Moral issues are surfacing far too frequently. Thinking only of oneself, pursuing one’s own interests at all costs, and doing anything to make money. This atmosphere is naturally having an effect on society.




As a result, we witness a multifaceted and unchecked decay. When we observe this, Rêber Apo’s distinction between the “normative state” and the “non-normative state” comes to mind. What is a normative state? It is a state with clearly defined procedures. Essentially, it is a state for which the law has established a framework, and where the state bureaucracy and those governing the state base their actions on these principles. Can there be a state without rules? If so, it would be like the Turkish state. That is why the distinction between the “normative state” and the “non-normative state” is extremely important. Everyone within the state must act in accordance with legal procedures. When this is done, there is no room for mafia and gang activity. Yes, the state cannot be a fully democratic institution because its nature is different, but at the very least, it can be an institution free of irregularities, where the law prevails, personal interests are curbed, and corruption is eliminated. In its current state, the Turkish state is a non-normative state – a state without rules. It is said that the AKP is conducting operations against this, but all this has taken place during the AKP era. It presents itself as a savior while being the source of the problem. Today, all the resources are in the hands of Erdoğan and those around him. All the information is in their hands.




All the speculation and similar activities are being carried out by these individuals. They are the ones profiting. This is why a state that operates outside the norm is emerging. So what is the connection between this and the Kurdish issue and democratization? How will this irregular state approach the Kurds fairly? This state, which operates like the mafia – a state where no rules remain, a state that acts according to whoever holds the power – moves entirely in the direction of the ruling elite’s self-interest from top to bottom, and everyone follows in its wake. This is how they develop the approach that there are no Kurds, Kurds have no rights, and Kurds are terrorists. They are adopting this approach against women, against Alevis, against Circassians… In short, they are adopting it against all forms of difference.




If the state were a normal state – and, based on that, a state governed by the rule of law – the problems we’ve been discussing – the funding issue, the arbitration problem, and various forms of self-interest – would not arise. Why? Because everyone would act in accordance with the law. Those who do not act in accordance are held directly accountable. Holding power does not become a matter of everyone getting rich or everyone wielding great authority. The issue of funding is also part of this. All these things that corrode the state are directly linked to democratization and directly linked to the resolution of the Kurdish issue. Those who want these problems to be resolved and for the state to become a normal state must make this assessment. Why is this state like this? Why are so many gangs, so much organized crime, and so many coups emerging within this state? One needs to dig a little deeper into the roots of these issues. Social forces must also address these issues. Because the Turkish state does not recognize the Kurds, its policy toward the Kurds has been one of denial and annihilation for a century. It still acts this way toward the Kurds and attacks them. Everything is being legitimized. Consequently, all the sources of this decay and corruption are linked to the wrong approach to the Kurdish issue and policies of denial. They are also related to the issue of democratization. If a solution emerges on this point, solutions to all these problems will also emerge.




Another very important issue has been under discussion in recent days. There have been developments in Southern Kurdistan, Iraq, and Şengal [Sinjar]. The KDP and PUK peshmerga forces have formed a common command. There have been some steps toward democratic integration in Şengal. In Iraq, international coalition forces are withdrawing. There are very diverse discussions regarding these issues. How do you assess these matters?




The so-called coalition forces have withdrawn from Iraq. Iraq presented this as a kind of success from its own perspective. Even though there was this slight military withdrawal, it still remains impossible for these hegemonic powers to completely abandon Iraq or the region and withdraw from their operations there. Because, according to a widely accepted assessment of the current situation, what is unfolding within the systems of capitalist modernity is the Third World War. Wars are continuing in various other places as well, but the main center of this war is the Middle East, and to some extent, it is also in Kurdistan. The Third World War is underway. Just as a new world system and a regional system were established following the First and Second World Wars, now, in the wake of the Third World War, they will establish a new order and a new design here, in our region, and even in Kurdistan. This is not a personal matter. But the pieces have not yet fully fallen into place. The consequences of the Third World War have not yet fully emerged, but they’ll take shape without dragging it out too long. For example, relations between Russia and Europe – whichever direction they take – will inevitably take shape. After that, a different kind of war might emerge. For instance, certain developments may occur in the Chinese region. As a result, today this area is viewed as a place where everyone acts in their own self-interest. Everyone wants to act in accordance with their own interests. A new system is needed. Similarly, in the US sphere, since Trump came to power, the US has already been intervening everywhere. But within the battlefields and the context of the Third World War, the most strategic region is the Middle East. It appears they will strive to be as successful as possible regarding the Middle East. How this will turn out is another matter.




But their plan is to redesign the Middle East within the framework of the Abraham Accords. This is clearly evident. If they succeed in this, it will mean the success of Israel’s hegemony in the region. The goal of capitalist modernity – everything it is doing and intends to do in the Middle East within the framework of the Third World War – is essentially for this purpose. Again, likely after the Third World War, once some time has passed, they will reorganize global institutions and organizations. There is the United Nations, the World Bank, the IMF, and similar institutions. All of these were established after the Second World War. Since they need a new world system, if they succeed, they will restructure themselves on a global scale with new institutions and organizations after the Third World War. This is also evident. Neither the hegemonic powers nor the regional powers have given up on Iraq. It is not like no one will interfere in Iraq anymore.




So what about the situation inside Iraq? There is the eventuality of a sectarian war breaking out. A civil war, for instance, might break out. The issue of Southern Kurdistan and the issue of Iraq are increasingly coming to the forefront. In conclusion, one cannot say that because the coalition forces have withdrawn, that from now on, there will be peace and stability will prevail. Perhaps this is laying the groundwork for a new move by international powers. Let different forces emerge, let them fight, and then let different interventions take place. These scenarios are also possible. Among them is the situation in South Kurdistan. The South Kurdistan administration also constantly speaks of certain dangers on the rise. The Kurdish people are one; they are a single people. And this people has not yet fully resolved its existential issues, but it has managed to have its existence recognized.




Southern Kurdistan has a certain level of status, including a legal status. But these states, which view the Kurds as a problem from their own perspective and pursue policies of annihilation against the Kurdish people, have not abandoned their policies. For this reason, the Kurdish people’s stance must be united. You mentioned that the Peshmerga have united. Yes, it seems so. But the extent to which they unite is a separate issue. Rêber Apo stated decades ago that the Kurdish people’s defense forces must unite. He articulated this most clearly in the fifth volume of his prison writings. He has always outlined this matter. Because there is a people facing existential challenges. All the occupying powers are coordinating their efforts. Most recently, the interior ministers of Iran and Turkey held a meeting and said that they, as the four states occupying Kurdistan, have to act together and develop a common strategy.




Therefore, it is clear that a common defense of society is needed. Society cannot remain defenseless. And it seems that both the South Kurdistan administration and the government view their future as somewhat uncertain. But the solution lies in relying on their own people, adopting a collective stance, and achieving social organization and unity. On this basis, both a common defense and, from the Kurds’ perspective, the unity of a democratic government are necessary. Furthermore, a common diplomatic approach is necessary. Everything compels the Kurds to establish themselves as an institution and structure within the framework of their own national stance. Rêber Apo has been calling for a national congress for years. But certain forces still refuse to prioritize this or bring it to fruition. The Kurdish people face the imperative that unity must be achieved in South Kurdistan, and it is of the utmost importance to do everything together and act in unison throughout all of Kurdistan.




Coming towards an end of our conversation, there was coverage of a march that was held in Amed against violence against women perpetrated by men. Kurdish people’s leader Abdullah Öcalan has brought about major changes in Kurdish society, particularly in the social sphere as it pertains to men. Given that the perpetrator of the violence is a man himself and that men organized this march in opposition to it, how do you think this should be evaluated?




We haven’t seen the outcome of the march yet. We’ll see later. I’m very hopeful. This is essentially an act of self-criticism. It appears that men within our society – at least those who seem more conscious, who are aligning themselves with democratic standards or seeking to do so – organized and participated in this action. But still, men’s general stance toward women is one of self-criticism. This action should be understood as an act of self-criticism against the violence men perpetrate against women. What we have learned from Rêber Apo and the philosophy of freedom is that every man must adopt a self-critical stance toward women. Because there is a real need for this. There is nothing else that will lead humanity to freedom and democratization. As I mentioned earlier, women are the segment of society that is being under the heaviest attack. It is not workers, nor laborers, nor Kurds. No one is being as much targeted as women are.




Thousands of women around the world are killed every day. Womanhood is an identity, and this identity is being targeted. Who is doing the killing? Men are doing the killing. Why is this happening? Every man must reflect on this and question how it comes to pass. Even when one looks at the animal kingdom, one won’t find a male that forms relationships in this way. Relationships in the universe are not like the relationships between women and men in society. Those relationships are symbiotic. They nourish one another; they help one another grow. This, then, is the fundamental relationship of nature from which we come. The relationship between women and men should be one of mutual empowerment. It should be one of mutual growth. It should be one of mutual beautification. But when one looks back from the animal kingdom to the human realm, one sees that men systematically kill women. The man has been killing the women for tens of thousands of years, and he kills her everywhere in the world. This indicates a departure from our true nature.




The relationship between women and men is currently not a symbiotic one. How does a woman view a man? What does a woman see in the man as he is today? And to what extent does a man benefit from a woman – from her potential, her nature, her strength, and her closeness to life? To what extent does the modern man receive his share of a woman’s richness, wholeness, beauty, and potential? A lot is lost there because the man does not build his relationship with the woman in this way. He views her as his property. He views her as a tool. He sees himself as superior to her. Within the framework of gender bias, there are many more things one could add to this. The man has deprived himself of the woman’s richness, intelligence, spirit, emotions, thoughts, and potential. A man has emerged from whom the woman can gain nothing. Because the man has strayed so far from his true self. He has strayed so far from his true self that he has nothing left to offer the woman.




Facing women is only a man who is tyrannical, cruel, anti-democratic, who sees himself as the owner of everything, places himself at the center of everything, and views women as nothing. The only thing a person can do against such a man is to fight back. Indeed, this is why women are at the forefront of the most fundamental struggles taking place all over the world today. Women are waging their own struggle against men. That is why the women’s struggle exists everywhere in the world. This struggle is also changing men. That is the reality of the situation. As men, we need to step out of our current position of masculinity. We must elevate ourselves to a level where women can comfortably and sincerely, as comrades, with love and respect, greet us, say hello to us, and live alongside us. But since this is not the case in the current situation, relationships have strayed far from the essence of symbiotic relationships – from free and egalitarian relationships. Most relationships proceed within the framework of biologism, within the framework of interests, and within the framework of men’s “interests.” Consequently, relationships have also deteriorated. Men need to examine how they structure their relationships with women. We have to tell ourselves to step away from a power-oriented position. We need to step away from an anti-democratic stance. We must be more humble. We have to try to understand women. We must make self-change and transformation the foundation of living alongside women. Otherwise, living with this kind of masculinity is truly very difficult. On this basis, men face a profound task of change and transformation.




Women are already doing this on their own front. When a woman refuses to accept this male power, she is simultaneously asserting the demand for men’s change and transformation. She tells the man to change himself. As people who want to be free, who want to live according to our true selves, and who want to free ourselves from this anti-democratic stance, we must bring about this change and transformation within ourselves. It is evident that the people carrying out this action in Amed are on this front. We hope that this front will continue to grow and expand. In other words, that more of us will reach our true human essence. This is a good effort. But at the same time, fundamental work must also be done from a societal perspective. It is necessary to address the current state of masculinity. The current man must change and transform.

L'idée est de lire des extraits de productions traitant le sujet de l'inceste, avant d'en parler toustes ensemble. On pourra bien sûr élargir l'échange vers d'autres thèmes.

title: Lancement du numéro 51 de DISSONANCES
content:
Pour fêter le lancement du numéro 51 de 

DISSONANCES

 sur le thème «

 

bizarre

 

», la Librairie Publico accueille l'équipe et les auteur.e.s




Née en mai 2002, 

DISSONANCES

 (revue de création & critique littéraires) a pour objectif de promouvoir la littérature vraiment vivante (non calibrée commercialement) :


1) une partie «

 

création thématique

 

» y est ouverte (à tout le monde) par appel à textes (ces derniers étant anonymisés avant comité de lecture afin d'empêcher tout copinage lors des choix)


2) une partie «

 

critique

 

» (entretiens, recensions, cartes blanches) rend compte de ce qui se fait là où ça se passe c'est-à-dire chez les indépendants




Indépendance et alternativité sont si essentielles pour Dissonances qu'elle a fait le choix de ne se financer que par ses ventes : ni subventions ni publicité. Une place importante est accordée à l'image (par carte blanche à des artistes visuels), dans le même esprit.




Au programme de la soirée :


– apéro-rencontre avec les auteur·e·s & l'équipe


– présentation de la revue & du numéro


– lecture (par leurs auteur·e·s et/ou l'équipe) des textes du dossier


– débat


– libations finales (car tout cela se fête)

 

!

title: [Le Mans] Manifestons nos solidarités anti-fascistes contre l'ouverture d'un local du R-haiNe au Mans samedi 3 octobre
content:
Manifestation anti-fasciste contre l'ouverture du R-haiNe d'un local en centre-ville du Mans pour en faire son siège départemental et une permanence parlementaire. Nous pensons nécessaire de nous opposer largement à cette tentative d'implantation fasciste au Mans et autour. Première étape d'une lutte qui parviendra à fermer ce local du R-haiNe

 

!




 

 

 

 

Samedi 3 Octobre à 15h15 à Lafayette :
Manifestons nos solidarités anti-fascistes contre l'ouverture d'un local du Rassemblement Nazional au Mans

 

!




_




Depuis 2023 le Rassemblement Nazional a choisi 

la Sarthe comme porte d'entrée stratégique pour tenter de conquérir le Nord-Ouest de l'État français,

 qui lui résiste... et 

nous ne cesserons de lui résister

 

!

 Alors le R-haiNe investit d'importants moyens financiers et humains pour s'implanter localement, 

parachutant des élu⸱es (1) et l'argent public européen qu'il a détourné par millions.




Le R-haiNe louait déjà un local au Mans depuis au moins 2025, mais il ne l'ouvrait pas au public. Depuis peu 

il loue un local au 147 rue Gambetta,

 remplaçant l'association 

LGBTQIA

+ Homogène. Cette dernière en est partie après avoir subi deux fois des 

dégradations de sa vitrine :

 détériorations de son affichage et collages d'

auto-collants «

 

Europe Jeunesse Révolution

 

» avec croix celtique.

 Le slogan et le symbole du 

Groupe Union Défense (

GUD

),

 qui est lié au 

FN

/

RN

 depuis sa création (2) et 

dont 2 membres ont assassiné Federico Martín Aramburú en 2022.




Créé par des nazis et des colons,

 le R-haiNe est un 

parti fasciste qui veut à nouveau déporter et exterminer

 certain⸱es d'entre nous, comme en attestent les 

écrits judéophobes de son président Jordan Bardella (3).

 Face au danger de sa prise de pouvoir, 

nous avons toustes intérêt à nous opposer massivement et efficacement au R-haiNe pour le faire reculer puis disparaître (4).




Samedi 3 Octobre le R-haiNe ouvrira un local au Mans pour en faire son 

siège départemental

 et la 

permanence

 de l'euro-députée Angéline Furet.




Samedi 3 Octobre nous nous rassemblerons à 15h15 à Lafayette au Mans pour manifester nos solidarités anti-fascistes.

 Cette manifestation sera la première étape d'une lutte qui parviendra à 

fermer ce local du R-haiNe

 

!




Nous invitons toustes les individu⸱es et les organisations à 

nous rejoindre et à partager cet appel.




Les fascistes n'ont pas gagné. 

Ensemble nous pouvons infliger une défaite au 

RN

 dont il ne se remettra pas

 

!




L'Assemblée Générale anti-fasciste de la Sarthe (agantifasciste72@systemli.org) et le Collectif Rêvolutionnaire Autonome Anarchiste Anti-fasciste du Mans et des Environs (

CRAAAME

title: Mobilisation des lycéens de quartiers populaires : où sont les autonomes ?
content:
Depuis une semaine, les blocages d'établissement se multiplient en région parisienne. La mobilisation lycéenne s'étend désormais à toute la France (notamment à Grenoble, Lyon, et Lille). De ce qu'ils nous disent, les jeunes dénoncent des conditions d'étude déplorables, les mettant en parallèle avec des politiques répressives au sein des établissements sur les retards alors que les élèves doivent composer avec les galères de transport, sur les vêtements (crocs, voile), et sur l'usage du téléphone (“nous n'avons pas les mêmes priorités” - cf un lycéen).




Pourtant, nous n'avons pas eu vent à ce jour de tentatives sérieuses de soutien à la mobilisation de la part des autonomes. Pourquoi

 

? Leur lutte n'est pas assez pure ou ne répond pas à nos exigences

 

? Sans doute cela résulte-t-il plutôt de notre séparation sociale et raciale, c'est-à-dire de classe, avec la jeunesse des quartiers ghettoïsées de la République.




Il s'agit pourtant simplement d'y aller et d'essayer de réellement comprendre. De quoi ont-ils besoin

 

? Allons leur demander. Comment les aider

 

? Allons voir ce qu'ils font et disent. Qu'attendons-nous

 

? Déjà une semaine que le mouvement a débuté, avec des centaines de jeunes en action et une répression policière qui n'est que trop familière aux habitants des quartiers populaires : arrestations, tirs de lacrymo et de 

LBD

, saturation de l'espace public par la police.




De ce que les jeunes nous disent, ils cherchent du soutien, notamment financier et face à la répression policière et judiciaire. En parallèle, les militants professionnels type 

RP

 

NPA

 et 

LFI

 sont au rendez-vous pour les soutenir (présence médiatique mais aussi sur le terrain). Que pouvons-nous proposer de mieux est une question à discuter, même si c'est une question qui préoccupe peu les lycéens eux-mêmes. Ce qu'ils veulent, c'est du changement, et c'est la question centrale qu'ils se posent à l'heure actuelle. Nous sommes en retard, ne loupons pas le rdv.




A Utrillo, les élèves ont écrit ce communiqué, que nous transmettons tel quel pour témoigner du ras-le-bol général dans les bahuts :




"Bonjour à tous et à toutes aujourd'hui nous, élèves du lycée Maurice Utrillo, nous nous révoltons aujourd'hui pour nos droits. Toute l'année nous travaillons dans de mauvaises conditions, vous nous forcez à nous lever tôt pour au final avoir un manque de personnel. Aujourd'hui nous nous révoltons pour les bonnes causes :




 on a des profs racistes sexistes,

 les toilettes insalubres et punaise de lit,

 la cantine, on mange de la merde 


et lorsque nous nous plaignons on nous dit je cite «

 

si on est pas content nous avons qu'à rester chez nous

 

». 


Nos emplois du temps on n'en parle même pas des élèves assis sur une chaise de 8h à 19h vous trouver ça normal

 

? Le lycée s'effondre sous vos yeux mais vous préférez vous préoccuper de nos téléphones et comment nous nous habillons. Vous trouvez ça normal vous

 

?"

title: Podcast de l'émission « Médias et antifascisme » du 11 septembre 2026 avec Pierre Salmon
content:
L'émission «

 

Médias et antifascisme

 

» présente tous les deuxièmes vendredis du mois à 11h30 sur Radio Libertaire (89.4 

FM

 en Île-de-France et anarchiste.info/radio/libertaire) recevait le 11 septembre 2026 l'historien Pierre Salmon coauteur du nouveau livre «

 

La guerre d'Espagne 1936‐1939. La démocratie assassinée

 

» sorti le 12 mars 2026 aux éditions Tallandier : 

https://www.anarchiste.info/radio/libertaire/emission/medias-et-antifascisme/2026/09/11/

.




 

 

 

 




Nous évoquions avec Mariama des émissions "Pas de Quartiers" et "La Rage Dedans" la montée du franquisme à la faveur notamment des guerres coloniales menées par l'Espagne à Cuba et au Maroc.


Nous analysions comment Franco s'est soulevé contre la République grâce à des forces structurées de longue date. Nous récusons donc la mythologie véhiculée notamment par Le Figaro Histoire qui dans son numéro d'août‐septembre 2026 martèle que la République espagnole n'était qu'un instrument entre les mains de l'Union Soviétique.




Nous abordions de plus des sujets d'actualité concernant justement Cuba et le Maroc. Le blocus imposé à Cuba par les États‐Unis d'Amérique et l'arrivée de plusieurs dizaines de milliers de personnes dans la ville espagnole de Ceuta nous permettent de comprendre certains enjeux internationaux.




Le gouvernement de Pedro Sánchez, qui a reconnu en 2024 l'État de Palestine et qui refuse aux États‐Unis d'Amérique l'accès à son territoire pour bombarder l'Iran est en effet particulièrement fragilisé par la situation. La décision début août du roi du Maroc de nommer l'autoroute qui mène au Sahara occidental «

 

 Autoroute Donald Trump 

 

» nous montre d'ailleurs d'importantes rivalités internationales.




Donald Trump a en effet durant son premier mandat comme président des États‐Unis d'Amérique reconnu le «

 

 Sahara marocain 

 

», territoire considéré pourtant par les Nations Unies comme non autonome et à décoloniser. Le Maroc a de son côté reconnu l'État d'Israël dans la foulée, renforçant la tension avec l'Algérie dont s'est récemment rapproché Pedro Sánchez pour obtenir des hydrocarbures dont le prix a flambé depuis le début des attaques israélo‐américaines en Iran.




Nous essaierons dans notre épisode du 9 octobre prochain d'alerter sur le colloque de l'Observatoire de la Petite Sirène qui doit se tenir le 16 octobre au Palais du Luxembourg à Paris : 

https://www.observatoirepetitesirene.org/colloque-2026

. Prétendant soustraire les enfants à l'influence des «

 

idéologies

 

», cet «

 

observatoire

 

» s'oppose surtout aux transitions de genre pour les mineur•e•s.




Sa codirectrice Céline Masson gère aussi le «

 

Réseau de Recherche sur le Racisme et l'Antisémitisme (

RRA

)

 

» qui a fait annuler le colloque «

 

Palestine et Europe : poids du passé et dynamiques contemporaines

 

» qui devait se dérouler au Collège de France en novembre 2025. En avril dernier le Collège de France a également annulé le colloque de l'Observatoire de la Petite Sirène qui s'est donc rabattu sur le Palais du Luxembourg à cause de la sénatrice Jacqueline Eustache-Brinio auteure avec Bruno Retailleau de la proposition de loi sur l'interdiction des transitions de mineur·e·s en 2024.

title: Hakemler soruşturmasında karar: MHK Başkanı Ferhat Gündoğdu dahil 5 kişi tutuklandı
content:
“Hakemler dosyası” soruşturması kapsamında gözaltına alınan 7 kişiden, MHK Başkanı Ferhat Gündoğdu’nun da aralarında bulunduğu 5 kişi tutuklandı. İki kişi ise yurt dışı çıkış yasağı uygulanarak adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakıldı.

İstanbul’da “Hakemler dosyası” olarak bilinen soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan 7 kişi, emniyetteki işlemlerinin ardından dün adliyeye sevk edildi. Savcılık işlemlerinin ardından tutuklama talebiyle sulh ceza hakimliğine sevk edilen MHK Başkanı Ferhat Gündoğdu, Ferdi Karadoruk, Yunus Yıldırım, Alican Sağlar ve Emre Kosif’in tutuklanmasına karar verildi.

Ahmet Şahin ve Sebahattin Şahin ise yurt dışına çıkış yasağı uygulanarak adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakıldı. Soruşturma kapsamında tutuklanan isimler;

Ferhat Gündoğdu (Merkez Hakem Kurulu - MHK Başkanı)

Ferdi Karadoruk (TFF Faal Futbol Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği Başkanı)

Yunus Yıldırım (TFF MHK Eski Üyesi)

Alican Sağlar (TFF Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul Şubesi Teşkilat Sorumlusu)

Emre Kosif (TFF Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul İl Hakem Kurulu Başkanı)

Adli kontrol kararı verilen isimler;

Ahmet Şahin (TFF MHK Eski Başkan Vekili)

Sebahattin Şahin (MHK Üyesi ve TFF Eğitim ve 4. Bölge Sorumlusu)

İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı Yasa Dışı Bahis ve Spor Suçları Bürosunun koordinasyonunda, İstanbul Emniyet Müdürlüğü Mali Suçlarla Mücadele Şubesi ekiplerince yürütülen “Hakemler dosyası” soruşturmasında bazı şüpheliler hakkında “eziyet” ve “resmi belgede sahtecilik” suçlamalarına ilişkin iddialar bulunduğu belirtilmişti.

Soruşturma kapsamında yapılan açık kaynak araştırmaları ile MASAK ve HTS incelemeleri, müşteki ve tanık ifadeleri ve bilirkişi tespitlerinin ardından MHK Başkanı Ferhat Gündoğdu ile MHK üyesi bazı hakem ve gözlemcilerin suçla bağlantısı olabileceği değerlendirilmişti.

Bunun üzerine İstanbul, Ankara, Elazığ ve Manisa’da belirlenen adreslere operasyon düzenlenmişti. Operasyonlarda Ferhat Gündoğdu, TFF Faal Hakemler Derneği Başkanı Ferdi Karadoruk, eski TFF Merkez Hakem Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ahmet Şahin, eski TFF Merkez Hakem Kurulu Üyesi Yunus Yıldırım, TFF Eğitim ve 4’üncü Bölge Sorumlusu Sebahattin Şahin, TFF Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul Şubesi Teşkilat Sorumlusu Alican Sağlar ile TFF Hakemleri ve Gözlemcileri Derneği İstanbul İl Hakem Kurulu Başkanı Emre Kosif gözaltına alınmıştı.

Soruşturma kapsamında Süper Lig hakemi Yasin Kol ile Süper Lig yardımcı hakemi Göktuğ Hazar Erel’in de İstanbul Emniyet Müdürlüğü Mali Suçlarla Mücadele Şubesi ekipleri tarafından gözaltına alındığı bildirilmişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Ataşehir Belediyesine operasyon: Başkan Vekili Murat Güneş dahil 13 kişi gözaltında
content:
Fotoğraf: Ataşehir Belediyesi

İstanbul — Ataşehir Belediyesine yönelik operasyonda Belediye Başkan Vekili Murat Güneş ile 12 kişi gözaltına alındı.

Ataşehir Belediye Başkanı Onursal Adıgüzel’in tutuklanmasının ardından belediye başkan vekilliğine seçilen Murat Güneş, sabah saatlerinde düzenlenen operasyonda gözaltına alındı.

Operasyon kapsamında Güneş ile birlikte 12 kişinin daha gözaltına alındığı bildirildi.

Ataşehir Belediye Başkanı Onursal Adıgüzel, belediyeye yönelik soruşturma kapsamında nisan ayında tutuklanmış ve görevden uzaklaştırılmıştı. Bunun üzerine 30 Nisan’da Belediye Meclisinde başkan vekilliği seçimi yapılmıştı.

CHP’nin adayı Murat Güneş, üçüncü turda 22 oy alarak AKP’nin adayı Serdar Orhan karşısında Ataşehir Belediye Başkan Vekili seçilmişti.

Güneş, CHP listesinden seçilen 6 belediye meclis üyesinin AKP’ye geçmesinin ardından 1 Ekim’de açıklama yapmıştı. Seçmen iradesine yönelik müdahaleleri takip ettiklerini belirten Güneş, “Ataşehir’in geleceğine Ataşehir halkı karar verir. 18 Meclis üyemizle beraber görevimizin başındayız” ifadelerini kullanmıştı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

content:
